question: framer-style-animation
prompt: Generate a landing page with smooth Framer-like transitions between sections. In a single-page self-contained HTML.
content:
<!DOCTYPE html>
<html lang="en">
<head>
  <meta charset="UTF-8" />
  <title>Framer-like Smooth Landing Page</title>
  <meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1.0" />
  <style>
    :root {
      --bg: #030711;
      --bg-soft: #050a18;
      --bg-softer: #070d1f;
      --accent: #4f46e5;
      --accent-soft: rgba(79,70,229,0.12);
      --accent-alt: #22c55e;
      --text: #e5e7eb;
      --muted: #9ca3af;
      --radius-xl: 26px;
      --transition-fast: 220ms cubic-bezier(.33,.02,.11,.99);
      --transition-med: 420ms cubic-bezier(.33,.02,.11,.99);
      --transition-slow: 640ms cubic-bezier(.19,1,.22,1);
      --shadow-soft: 0 18px 70px rgba(15,23,42,0.9);
      --max-w: 1120px;
      --font-sans: system-ui, -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, -system-ui,
                   -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, "SF Pro Text", -apple-system,
                   system-ui, sans-serif;
    }

    * {
      margin: 0;
      padding: 0;
      box-sizing: border-box;
    }

    html,
    body {
      height: 100%;
      scroll-behavior: smooth;
      background-color: var(--bg);
      color: var(--text);
      font-family: var(--font-sans);
    }

    body {
      overflow-x: hidden;
    }

    /* Smooth scroll snap between sections */
    main {
      scroll-snap-type: y mandatory;
      overflow-y: auto;
      height: 100vh;
      scroll-behavior: smooth;
    }

    section {
      min-height: 100vh;
      scroll-snap-align: start;
      display: flex;
      align-items: center;
      justify-content: center;
      padding: 80px 24px 40px;
      position: relative;
    }

    .container {
      width: 100%;
      max-width: var(--max-w);
      margin: 0 auto;
      position: relative;
    }

    /* Top Nav */
    .nav-wrap {
      position: fixed;
      z-index: 40;
      top: 18px;
      left: 50%;
      transform: translateX(-50%);
      width: 100%;
      max-width: var(--max-w);
      padding: 0 18px;
      pointer-events: none;
    }

    .nav {
      pointer-events: auto;
      backdrop-filter: blur(26px);
      background: radial-gradient(circle at top left, rgba(79,70,229,0.22), transparent)
                  ,rgba(5,10,25,0.96);
      border-radius: 99px;
      border: 1px solid rgba(148,163,253,0.28);
      padding: 10px 18px;
      box-shadow: 0 18px 60px rgba(15,23,42,0.9);
      display: flex;
      align-items: center;
      gap: 14px;
    }

    .nav-left {
      display: flex;
      align-items: center;
      gap: 8px;
      padding-right: 8px;
      border-right: 1px solid rgba(148,163,253,0.24);
    }

    .logo-dot {
      width: 18px;
      height: 18px;
      border-radius: 999px;
      background:
        radial-gradient(circle at 30% 0%, #ffffff, transparent),
        radial-gradient(circle at 40% 90%, #22c55e, transparent),
        radial-gradient(circle at 100% 0%, #60a5fa, transparent),
        #4f46e5;
      box-shadow: 0 0 18px rgba(79,70,229,0.9);
    }

    .brand {
      font-weight: 600;
      letter-spacing: 0.06em;
      font-size: 12px;
      color: #c7d2fe;
      text-transform: uppercase;
    }

    .nav-links {
      display: flex;
      gap: 8px;
      align-items: center;
      flex: 1;
    }

    .nav-links a {
      font-size: 11px;
      padding: 6px 12px;
      border-radius: 999px;
      color: var(--muted);
      text-decoration: none;
      transition: all var(--transition-fast);
      display: inline-flex;
      align-items: center;
      gap: 4px;
      border: 1px solid transparent;
      position: relative;
      overflow: hidden;
    }

    .nav-links a span.dot {
      width: 6px;
      height: 6px;
      border-radius: 999px;
      background-color: rgba(148,163,253,0.5);
      opacity: 0;
      transform: scale(0.3);
      transition: all var(--transition-fast);
    }

    .nav-links a:hover span.dot,
    .nav-links a.active span.dot {
      opacity: 1;
      transform: scale(1);
    }

    .nav-links a:hover,
    .nav-links a.active {
      color: #e5e7eb;
      border-color: rgba(148,163,253,0.45);
      background: radial-gradient(circle at top, rgba(79,70,229,0.16), transparent);
      box-shadow: 0 10px 26px rgba(15,23,42,0.7);
    }

    .nav-cta {
      margin-left: auto;
      display: flex;
      align-items: center;
      gap: 6px;
    }

    .nav-cta button {
      cursor: pointer;
      padding: 7px 14px;
      border-radius: 999px;
      border: none;
      font-size: 11px;
      display: inline-flex;
      align-items: center;
      gap: 6px;
      color: #030712;
      background: linear-gradient(135deg,#22c55e,#4ade80);
      box-shadow: 0 10px 30px rgba(22,163,74,0.45);
      transition: all var(--transition-fast);
      white-space: nowrap;
    }

    .nav-cta button span.icon {
      display: inline-flex;
      width: 14px;
      height: 14px;
      border-radius: 999px;
      background-color: rgba(3,7,18,0.96);
      align-items: center;
      justify-content: center;
      color: #22c55e;
      font-size: 10px;
    }

    .nav-cta button:hover {
      transform: translateY(-1px);
      box-shadow: 0 18px 42px rgba(22,163,74,0.6);
    }

    /* Hero */
    .hero {
      color: var(--text);
    }

    .hero-inner {
      display: grid;
      grid-template-columns: minmax(0, 1.6fr) minmax(260px, 1.1fr);
      gap: 40px;
      align-items: center;
    }

    .label-pill {
      display: inline-flex;
      align-items: center;
      gap: 8px;
      padding: 5px 11px;
      border-radius: 999px;
      border: 1px solid rgba(148,163,253,0.3);
      font-size: 10px;
      text-transform: uppercase;
      letter-spacing: 0.12em;
      color: #c7d2fe;
      background: radial-gradient(circle at left, rgba(79,70,229,0.26), transparent)
                  ,rgba(5,10,25,0.96);
      box-shadow: 0 10px 32px rgba(15,23,42,0.8);
      margin-bottom: 16px;
    }

    .label-pill span.badge-dot {
      width: 8px;
      height: 8px;
      border-radius: 999px;
      background-color: #22c55e;
      box-shadow: 0 0 18px rgba(34,197,94,0.9);
    }

    h1 {
      font-size: clamp(2.6rem, 4.2vw, 3.6rem);
      line-height: 1.04;
      letter-spacing: -0.035em;
      font-weight: 600;
      margin-bottom: 18px;
    }

    h1 span.accent {
      background: linear-gradient(120deg,#818cf8,#22c55e);
      -webkit-background-clip: text;
      color: transparent;
    }

    .hero-sub {
      font-size: 0.98rem;
      color: var(--muted);
      max-width: 440px;
      line-height: 1.6;
      margin-bottom: 22px;
    }

    .hero-actions {
      display: flex;
      flex-wrap: wrap;
      gap: 10px;
      align-items: center;
      margin-bottom: 16px;
    }

    .btn-primary {
      cursor: pointer;
      padding: 11px 22px;
      border-radius: 999px;
      border: none;
      font-size: 0.9rem;
      display: inline-flex;
      align-items: center;
      gap: 8px;
      color: #030712;
      background: radial-gradient(circle at 0 0, #bbf7d0, transparent),
                  linear-gradient(135deg, #22c55e, #22c55e, #4ade80);
      box-shadow: 0 16px 46px rgba(22,163,74,0.5);
      transition: all var(--transition-med);
    }

    .btn-primary span.arrow {
      display: inline-flex;
      width: 18px;
      height: 18px;
      border-radius: 999px;
      background-color: rgba(3,7,18,0.98);
      color: #22c55e;
      align-items: center;
      justify-content: center;
      font-size: 12px;
      transform-origin: center;
      transition: all var(--transition-fast);
    }

    .btn-primary:hover {
      transform: translateY(-2px);
      box-shadow: 0 26px 60px rgba(22,163,74,0.6);
    }

    .btn-primary:hover span.arrow {
      transform: translateX(2px) rotate(-10deg);
    }

    .btn-ghost {
      cursor: pointer;
      padding: 11px 16px;
      border-radius: 999px;
      border: 1px solid rgba(148,163,253,0.4);
      font-size: 0.86rem;
      display: inline-flex;
      align-items: center;
      gap: 7px;
      color: #c7d2fe;
      background: radial-gradient(circle at top, rgba(15,23,42,0.9), transparent)
                  ,rgba(5,10,25,0.98);
      box-shadow: 0 14px 40px rgba(15,23,42,0.95);
      transition: all var(--transition-med);
    }

    .btn-ghost span.icon {
      font-size: 14px;
      color: #22c55e;
    }

    .btn-ghost:hover {
      transform: translateY(-1px);
      box-shadow: 0 20px 52px rgba(15,23,42,1);
      background: radial-gradient(circle at top, rgba(79,70,229,0.16), transparent)
                  ,rgba(5,10,25,0.98);
    }

    .hero-metrics {
      display: flex;
      gap: 16px;
      margin-top: 8px;
      font-size: 0.76rem;
      color: var(--muted);
      align-items: center;
      flex-wrap: wrap;
    }

    .hero-metrics strong {
      color: #e5e7eb;
      font-size: 0.9rem;
      margin-right: 3px;
    }

    .hero-metrics span.tag {
      padding: 5px 10px;
      border-radius: 999px;
      background-color: rgba(15,23,42,1);
      border: 1px solid rgba(148,163,253,0.26);
      display: inline-flex;
      align-items: center;
      gap: 4px;
      font-size: 0.7rem;
      color: #9ca3af;
    }

    .hero-metrics span.tag i {
      font-size: 9px;
      color: #22c55e;
    }

    .hero-right {
      position: relative;
    }

    .card-3d {
      position: relative;
      background: radial-gradient(circle at top left, rgba(79,70,229,0.3), transparent)
                  ,radial-gradient(circle at bottom right, rgba(34,197,94,0.18), transparent)
                  ,var(--bg-soft);
      border-radius: var(--radius-xl);
      padding: 18px 16px 14px;
      border: 1px solid rgba(148,163,253,0.26);
      box-shadow: var(--shadow-soft);
      backdrop-filter: blur(26px);
      transform-style: preserve-3d;
      perspective: 1200px;
      overflow: hidden;
    }

    .card-top {
      display: flex;
      justify-content: space-between;
      align-items: center;
      margin-bottom: 12px;
    }

    .card-top-left span.title {
      font-size: 0.7rem;
      color: #9ca3af;
      text-transform: uppercase;
      letter-spacing: 0.16em;
    }

    .card-top-left h3 {
      font-size: 1.06rem;
      color: #e5e7eb;
      margin-top: 2px;
      font-weight: 500;
    }

    .status-pill {
      padding: 4px 9px;
      border-radius: 999px;
      font-size: 0.62rem;
      border: 1px solid rgba(34,197,94,0.4);
      color: #bbf7d0;
      display: inline-flex;
      align-items: center;
      gap: 4px;
      background-color: rgba(5,15,20,0.96);
    }

    .status-pill span.dot {
      width: 7px;
      height: 7px;
      border-radius: 999px;
      background-color: #22c55e;
      box-shadow: 0 0 14px rgba(22,163,74,1);
    }

    .chart {
      margin-top: 8px;
      position: relative;
      height: 80px;
      display: flex;
      align-items: flex-end;
      gap: 4px;
    }

    .bar {
      flex: 1;
      border-radius: 999px;
      background: linear-gradient(to top, rgba(79,70,229,0.38), rgba(129,140,248,0.9));
      box-shadow: 0 8px 20px rgba(15,23,42,1);
      transform-origin: bottom;
      transform: scaleY(0.2);
      opacity: 0.16;
      transition: all var(--transition-slow);
    }

    .bar:nth-child(3n) {
      background: linear-gradient(to top, rgba(34,197,94,0.22), rgba(45,212,191,0.9));
    }

    .card-stats {
      display: flex;
      justify-content: space-between;
      align-items: flex-end;
      margin-top: 10px;
      font-size: 0.7rem;
      color: #9ca3af;
      gap: 10px;
    }

    .card-stats strong {
      font-size: 0.98rem;
      color: #e5e7eb;
    }

    .badge-floating {
      position: absolute;
      right: 18px;
      bottom: 16px;
      padding: 7px 10px;
      border-radius: 18px;
      background-color: rgba(3,7,18,0.98);
      border: 1px solid rgba(148,163,253,0.4);
      font-size: 0.6rem;
      color: #9ca3af;
      display: inline-flex;
      align-items: center;
      gap: 6px;
      box-shadow: 0 8px 26px rgba(15,23,42,1);
      backdrop-filter: blur(18px);
      transform: translate3d(0, 12px, 40px);
      opacity: 0;
      transition: all var(--transition-slow);
    }

    .badge-dot-sm {
      width: 7px;
      height: 7px;
      border-radius: 999px;
      background-color: #22c55e;
      box-shadow: 0 0 16px rgba(22,163,74,1);
    }

    .glow-orbit {
      position: absolute;
      inset: -40%;
      opacity: 0.18;
      background:
        radial-gradient(circle at top, rgba(79,70,229,0.2), transparent),
        radial-gradient(circle at 70% 40%, rgba(129,140,248,0.16), transparent),
        radial-gradient(circle at 80% 90%, rgba(34,197,94,0.16), transparent);
      mix-blend-mode: screen;
      pointer-events: none;
      transform-origin: center;
      transform: scale(1.04);
      transition: all var(--transition-slow);
    }

    .floating-pill {
      position: absolute;
      left: -4px;
      bottom: 26px;
      padding: 6px 9px;
      border-radius: 14px;
      font-size: 0.58rem;
      background-color: rgba(5,10,25,0.98);
      border: 1px solid rgba(148,163,253,0.32);
      color: #9ca3af;
      display: inline-flex;
      align-items: center;
      gap: 5px;
      box-shadow: 0 10px 32px rgba(15,23,42,1);
      backdrop-filter: blur(18px);
      transform: translate3d(-12px, 18px, 40px);
      opacity: 0;
      transition: all var(--transition-slow);
    }

    .floating-pill span.icon {
      width: 13px;
      height: 13px;
      border-radius: 999px;
      background-color: #111827;
      display: flex;
      align-items: center;
      justify-content: center;
      font-size: 8px;
      color: #22c55e;
    }

    /* Sections backgrounds */
    #hero {
      background:
        radial-gradient(circle at top, rgba(79,70,229,0.16), transparent),
        radial-gradient(circle at bottom, rgba(15,23,42,1), transparent),
        var(--bg);
    }

    #features {
      background:
        radial-gradient(circle at top right, rgba(79,70,229,0.14), transparent),
        radial-gradient(circle at 0 110%, rgba(15,23,42,1), transparent),
        var(--bg-soft);
    }

    #showcase {
      background:
        radial-gradient(circle at top left, rgba(34,197,94,0.14), transparent),
        radial-gradient(circle at bottom, rgba(15,23,42,1), transparent),
        var(--bg-soft);
    }

    #pricing {
      background:
        radial-gradient(circle at top, rgba(79,70,229,0.18), transparent),
        var(--bg-softer);
    }

    #cta {
      background:
        radial-gradient(circle at top, rgba(34,197,94,0.18), transparent),
        radial-gradient(circle at bottom, rgba(15,23,42,1), transparent),
        var(--bg);
    }

    /* Features */
    .section-heading {
      max-width: var(--max-w);
      margin: 0 auto 26px;
      text-align: center;
    }

    .section-heading h2 {
      font-size: 1.7rem;
      font-weight: 500;
      letter-spacing: -0.015em;
      margin-bottom: 6px;
    }

    .section-heading p {
      font-size: 0.9rem;
      color: var(--muted);
    }

    .features-grid {
      display: grid;
      grid-template-columns: repeat(3, minmax(0, 1fr));
      gap: 16px;
    }

    .feature-card {
      padding: 16px 14px;
      border-radius: 18px;
      background: radial-gradient(circle at top, rgba(79,70,229,0.12), transparent),
                  rgba(5,10,25,0.98);
      border: 1px solid rgba(75,85,99,0.7);
      box-shadow: 0 16px 52px rgba(15,23,42,1);
      font-size: 0.8rem;
      color: var(--muted);
      display: flex;
      flex-direction: column;
      gap: 6px;
      transform: translateY(14px);
      opacity: 0;
      transition: all var(--transition-slow);
    }

    .feature-icon {
      width: 20px;
      height: 20px;
      border-radius: 8px;
      display: flex;
      align-items: center;
      justify-content: center;
      font-size: 12px;
      color: var(--accent);
      background: rgba(15,23,42,1);
      border: 1px solid rgba(129,140,248,0.4);
      box-shadow: 0 10px 26px rgba(15,23,42,1);
    }

    .feature-card h3 {
      font-size: 0.9rem;
      color: #e5e7eb;
      font-weight: 500;
    }

    .feature-tag {
      font-size: 0.64rem;
      color: #22c55e;
      text-transform: uppercase;
      letter-spacing: 0.16em;
    }

    /* Showcase (timeline/steps) */
    .steps {
      display: grid;
      grid-template-columns: 1.4fr 1.4fr;
      gap: 26px;
      align-items: center;
    }

    .steps-list {
      display: flex;
      flex-direction: column;
      gap: 9px;
      font-size: 0.8rem;
      color: var(--muted);
      position: relative;
    }

    .step-badge {
      font-size: 0.7rem;
      color: #a5b4fc;
      text-transform: uppercase;
      letter-spacing: 0.16em;
      margin-bottom: 4px;
    }

    .step {
      padding: 10px 11px;
      border-radius: 14px;
      border: 1px solid rgba(75,85,99,0.8);
      background: rgba(3,7,18,0.98);
      display: flex;
      flex-direction: column;
      gap: 3px;
      transform: translateX(-10px);
      opacity: 0;
      transition: all var(--transition-med);
    }

    .step span.label {
      font-size: 0.65rem;
      color: #6b7280;
      text-transform: uppercase;
      letter-spacing: 0.16em;
    }

    .step strong {
      font-size: 0.88rem;
      color: #e5e7eb;
      font-weight: 500;
    }

    .step span.meta {
      font-size: 0.7rem;
      color: #9ca3af;
    }

    .step.active {
      border-color: rgba(79,70,229,0.9);
      box-shadow: 0 16px 46px rgba(15,23,42,1);
      background: radial-gradient(circle at top, rgba(79,70,229,0.16), transparent),
                  rgba(3,7,18,1);
    }

    .steps-visual {
      position: relative;
      padding: 14px;
      border-radius: 20px;
      background: radial-gradient(circle at top left, rgba(79,70,229,0.26), transparent),
                  radial-gradient(circle at bottom right, rgba(34,197,94,0.2), transparent),
                  rgba(3,7,18,0.98);
      border: 1px solid rgba(79,70,229,0.5);
      box-shadow: 0 18px 60px rgba(15,23,42,1);
      overflow: hidden;
      transform: translateY(18px);
      opacity: 0;
      transition: all var(--transition-slow);
    }

    .steps-visual h3 {
      font-size: 0.9rem;
      margin-bottom: 2px;
      color: #e5e7eb;
      font-weight: 500;
    }

    .steps-visual p {
      font-size: 0.7rem;
      color: #9ca3af;

    function scrollToSection(id) {
      const el = document.getElementById(id);
      if (!el) return;
      el.scrollIntoView({ behavior: "smooth", block: "start" });
    }

    function fakeSubmit() {
      const input = document.getElementById("email");
      const value = (input.value || "").trim();
      const btn = event && event.target ? event.target : null;
      if (btn) {
        const original = btn.innerHTML;
        btn.disabled = true;
        btn.style.opacity = "0.8";
        btn.innerHTML = "Sending...";
        setTimeout(() => {
          btn.innerHTML = "Check your inbox ✦";
          btn.style.opacity = "1";
          if (!value) {
            input.value = "demo@flowframe.landing";
          }
        }, 700);
      }
    }

    const sections = document.querySelectorAll("main section");
    const navLinks = document.querySelectorAll(".nav-links a");

    const sectionObserver = new IntersectionObserver(
      (entries) => {
        entries.forEach((entry) => {
          const id = entry.target.id;
          if (entry.isIntersecting) {
            entry.target.classList.add("active");
            navLinks.forEach((link) => {
              link.classList.toggle(
                "active",
                link.getAttribute("href") === "#" + id
              );
            });
          }
        });
      },
      {
        root: document.querySelector("main"),
        threshold: 0.55,
      }
    );

    sections.forEach((section) => sectionObserver.observe(section));

    const revealObserver = new IntersectionObserver(
      (entries) => {
        entries.forEach((entry) => {
          if (entry.isIntersecting) {
            entry.target.classList.add("in-view");
            revealObserver.unobserve(entry.target);
          }
        });
      },
      {
        root: document.querySelector("main"),
        threshold: 0.18,
      }
    );

    document
      .querySelectorAll(".reveal, .slide-in-left, .slide-in-up")
      .forEach((el) => revealObserver.observe(el));

    const steps = document.querySelectorAll("#showcase .step");
    const stepsVisual = document.querySelector("#showcase .steps-visual");

    const stepsObserver = new IntersectionObserver(
      (entries) => {
        entries.forEach((entry) => {
          if (entry.isIntersecting) {
            const idx = Array.from(steps).indexOf(entry.target);
            steps.forEach((s, i) => {
              if (i <= idx) {
                s.classList.add("active");
              }
            });
            stepsVisual.classList.add("in-view");
          }
        });
      },
      {
        root: document.querySelector("main"),
        threshold: 0.3,
      }
    );
    steps.forEach((step) => stepsObserver.observe(step));
  </script>

      --accent-color: #38bdf8;
      --text-color: #e5e7eb;
      --muted-color: #9ca3af;
      --nav-bg: rgba(15, 23, 42, 0.7);
      --nav-blur: 18px;
      --border-subtle: rgba(148, 163, 184, 0.3);
      --radius-xl: 24px;
      --shadow-soft: 0 18px 45px rgba(15, 23, 42, 0.45);
      --transition-fast: 200ms cubic-bezier(0.23, 1, 0.32, 1);
      --transition-normal: 420ms cubic-bezier(0.23, 1, 0.32, 1);
      --transition-slow: 650ms cubic-bezier(0.19, 1, 0.22, 1);
    }

    * {
      box-sizing: border-box;
      margin: 0;
      padding: 0;
    }

    html, body {
      scroll-behavior: smooth;
      height: 100%;
      font-family: system-ui, -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, "SF Pro Text",
        "Segoe UI", sans-serif;
      color: var(--text-color);
      background: radial-gradient(circle at top left, #0f172a 0, #020617 45%, #020617 100%);
      transition: background 800ms ease, background-color 800ms ease;
    }

    body {
      overflow-x: hidden;
    }

    /* Scrollbar (subtle) */
    ::-webkit-scrollbar {
      width: 8px;
    }
    ::-webkit-scrollbar-track {
      background: transparent;
    }
    ::-webkit-scrollbar-thumb {
      background: rgba(148, 163, 184, 0.35);
      border-radius: 999px;
    }

    a {
      color: inherit;
      text-decoration: none;
    }

    /* Layout */
    main {
      position: relative;
    }

    section {
      min-height: 100vh;
      padding: 96px 5vw 80px;
      display: flex;
      align-items: center;
      position: relative;
      overflow: hidden;
    }

    .container {
      width: 100%;
      max-width: 1120px;
      margin: 0 auto;
      position: relative;
      z-index: 1;
    }

    /* Top Navigation */
    .nav {
      position: fixed;
      inset-inline: 0;
      top: 0;
      z-index: 50;
      display: flex;
      justify-content: center;
      padding: 20px 0;
      pointer-events: none;
    }

    .nav-inner {
      pointer-events: auto;
      width: min(960px, 100% - 32px);
      padding: 10px 18px;
      border-radius: 999px;
      background: var(--nav-bg);
      backdrop-filter: blur(var(--nav-blur));
      border: 1px solid rgba(148, 163, 184, 0.3);
      box-shadow: 0 16px 40px rgba(15, 23, 42, 0.55);
      display: flex;
      align-items: center;
      justify-content: space-between;
      gap: 16px;
    }

    .brand {
      display: flex;
      align-items: center;
      gap: 10px;
      font-size: 14px;
      font-weight: 500;
      letter-spacing: 0.04em;
      text-transform: uppercase;
      color: var(--muted-color);
    }

    .brand-mark {
      width: 26px;
      height: 26px;
      border-radius: 999px;
      background: radial-gradient(circle at 30% 0%, #e0f2fe, #38bdf8 40%, #0ea5e9 70%, #0369a1 100%);
      box-shadow: 0 0 0 1px rgba(56, 189, 248, 0.45),
                  0 14px 32px rgba(15, 23, 42, 0.85);
      position: relative;
      overflow: hidden;
    }

    .brand-mark::after {
      content: "";
      position: absolute;
      inset: 35% 20% auto auto;
      height: 4px;
      border-radius: 999px;
      background: rgba(248, 250, 252, 0.7);
      filter: blur(1px);
    }

    .nav-links {
      display: flex;
      align-items: center;
      gap: 6px;
    }

    .nav-link {
      position: relative;
      padding: 6px 14px;
      border-radius: 999px;
      font-size: 13px;
      font-weight: 500;
      color: var(--muted-color);
      letter-spacing: 0.02em;
      text-transform: uppercase;
      transition: color var(--transition-fast),
                  background var(--transition-fast),
                  transform var(--transition-fast);
    }

    .nav-link::before {
      content: "";
      position: absolute;
      inset: 0;
      border-radius: inherit;
      background: linear-gradient(120deg, rgba(56, 189, 248, 0.4), rgba(56, 189, 248, 0.05));
      opacity: 0;
      transform: scale(0.92);
      transition: opacity var(--transition-fast), transform var(--transition-fast);
    }

    .nav-link span {
      position: relative;
      z-index: 1;
    }

    .nav-link:hover {
      color: #e5f6ff;
      transform: translateY(-1px);
    }

    .nav-link:hover::before {
      opacity: 1;
      transform: scale(1);
    }

    .nav-link.active {
      color: #e5f6ff;
    }

    .nav-link.active::before {
      opacity: 1;
      transform: scale(1);
      background: linear-gradient(120deg, var(--accent-color), rgba(56, 189, 248, 0.25));
    }

    .nav-cta {
      padding: 7px 16px;
      border-radius: 999px;
      border: 1px solid rgba(148, 163, 184, 0.5);
      background: radial-gradient(circle at top left, rgba(56, 189, 248, 0.18), rgba(15, 23, 42, 0.86));
      color: #e5f6ff;
      font-size: 12px;
      font-weight: 500;
      text-transform: uppercase;
      letter-spacing: 0.08em;
      display: inline-flex;
      align-items: center;
      gap: 8px;
      box-shadow: 0 10px 28px rgba(15, 23, 42, 0.75);
      transition: transform var(--transition-fast),
                  box-shadow var(--transition-fast),
                  border-color var(--transition-fast),
                  background var(--transition-fast);
    }

    .nav-cta-arrow {
      width: 16px;
      height: 16px;
      display: grid;
      place-items: center;
      border-radius: 999px;
      background: rgba(15, 23, 42, 0.7);
      border: 1px solid rgba(148, 163, 184, 0.6);
      font-size: 10px;
    }

    .nav-cta:hover {
      transform: translateY(-1px);
      border-color: rgba(56, 189, 248, 0.9);
      background: radial-gradient(circle at top left, rgba(56, 189, 248, 0.25), rgba(15, 23, 42, 0.9));
      box-shadow: 0 18px 40px rgba(15, 23, 42, 0.9);
    }

    .nav-cta:active {
      transform: translateY(0);
      box-shadow: 0 8px 24px rgba(15, 23, 42, 0.9);
    }

    /* Hero Section */
    .hero {
      padding-top: 128px;
      display: flex;
      align-items: center;
    }

    .hero-grid {
      display: grid;
      grid-template-columns: minmax(0, 1.35fr) minmax(0, 1fr);
      gap: 56px;
      align-items: center;
    }

    .eyebrow {
      display: inline-flex;
      align-items: center;
      gap: 8px;
      padding: 4px 10px;
      border-radius: 999px;
      border: 1px solid rgba(148, 163, 184, 0.4);
      background: radial-gradient(circle at top left, rgba(56, 189, 248, 0.09), rgba(15, 23, 42, 0.9));
      color: var(--muted-color);
      font-size: 12px;
      text-transform: uppercase;
      letter-spacing: 0.08em;
      margin-bottom: 18px;
    }

    .eyebrow-dot {
      width: 6px;
      height: 6px;
      border-radius: 999px;
      background: var(--accent-color);
      box-shadow: 0 0 0 4px rgba(56, 189, 248, 0.25);
    }

    h1 {
      font-size: clamp(2.6rem, 4vw, 3.6rem);
      line-height: 1.05;
      letter-spacing: -0.04em;
      margin-bottom: 16px;
    }

    h1 span.accent {
      background: linear-gradient(120deg, #38bdf8, #22c55e, #eab308);
      -webkit-background-clip: text;
      color: transparent;
    }

    .hero-subtitle {
      font-size: 16px;
      line-height: 1.6;
      color: var(--muted-color);
      max-width: 460px;
      margin-bottom: 28px;
    }

    .hero-actions {
      display: flex;
      flex-wrap: wrap;
      gap: 12px;
      align-items: center;
      margin-bottom: 28px;
    }

    .btn {
      padding: 10px 20px;
      border-radius: 999px;
      font-size: 14px;
      font-weight: 500;
      border: 1px solid transparent;
      cursor: pointer;
      display: inline-flex;
      align-items: center;
      gap: 10px;
      transition: transform var(--transition-fast),
                  box-shadow var(--transition-fast),
                  border-color var(--transition-fast),
                  background var(--transition-fast),
                  color var(--transition-fast);
      background: none;
      color: inherit;
    }

    .btn-primary {
      background: radial-gradient(circle at top left, rgba(248, 250, 252, 0.2), rgba(56, 189, 248, 1));
      border-color: rgba(56, 189, 248, 0.4);
      color: #0f172a;
      box-shadow: 0 20px 42px rgba(15, 23, 42, 0.8),
                  0 0 0 1px rgba(15, 23, 42, 0.3) inset;
    }

    .btn-primary:hover {
      transform: translateY(-1px) translateZ(0);
      box-shadow: 0 28px 60px rgba(15, 23, 42, 0.85);
      background: radial-gradient(circle at top left, rgba(248, 250, 252, 0.3), rgba(56, 189, 248, 1));
    }

    .btn-outline {
      border-color: rgba(148, 163, 184, 0.6);
      color: var(--muted-color);
      background: rgba(15, 23, 42, 0.9);
      box-shadow: 0 14px 32px rgba(15, 23, 42, 0.7);
    }

    .btn-outline:hover {
      border-color: rgba(56, 189, 248, 0.9);
      color: #e5f6ff;
      transform: translateY(-1px);
      background: radial-gradient(circle at top left, rgba(56, 189, 248, 0.3), rgba(15, 23, 42, 0.95));
    }

    .btn-icon-arrow {
      font-size: 15px;
      transform-origin: center;
      transition: transform var(--transition-fast);
    }

    .btn-primary:hover .btn-icon-arrow,
    .btn-outline:hover .btn-icon-arrow {
      transform: translateX(3px);
    }

    .hero-meta {
      display: flex;
      flex-wrap: wrap;
      gap: 16px;
      font-size: 12px;
      color: var(--muted-color);
    }

    .meta-item {
      display: inline-flex;
      align-items: center;
      gap: 6px;
    }

    .meta-pill {
      padding: 4px 9px;
      border-radius: 999px;
      background: rgba(15, 23, 42, 0.8);
      border: 1px solid rgba(148, 163, 184, 0.4);
    }

    .hero-visual {
      position: relative;
      isolation: isolate;
    }

    .hero-card {
      position: relative;
      border-radius: var(--radius-xl);
      padding: 22px 22px 18px;
      background: radial-gradient(circle at top left, rgba(56, 189, 248, 0.14), rgba(15, 23, 42, 1));
      border: 1px solid rgba(148, 163, 184, 0.4);
      box-shadow: var(--shadow-soft);
      overflow: hidden;
    }

    .hero-card::before {
      content: "";
      position: absolute;
      inset: -40%;
      background:
        radial-gradient(circle at 0 0, rgba(96, 165, 250, 0.35), transparent 55%),
        radial-gradient(circle at 100% 50%, rgba(45, 212, 191, 0.25), transparent 55%);
      opacity: 0.9;
      mix-blend-mode: screen;
      pointer-events: none;
    }

    .hero-card-inner {
      position: relative;
      z-index: 1;
    }

    .card-header {
      display: flex;
      justify-content: space-between;
      align-items: center;
      margin-bottom: 16px;
      font-size: 12px;
      color: var(--muted-color);
    }

    .status-pill {
      padding: 4px 10px;
      border-radius: 999px;
      border: 1px solid rgba(22, 163, 74, 0.5);
      color: #bbf7d0;
      background: rgba(22, 101, 52, 0.4);
      display: inline-flex;
      align-items: center;
      gap: 6px;
    }

    .status-dot {
      width: 7px;
      height: 7px;
      border-radius: 999px;
      background: #22c55e;
      box-shadow: 0 0 0 3px rgba(34, 197, 94, 0.35);
    }

    .timeline {
      border-radius: 16px;
      background: rgba(15, 23, 42, 0.93);
      border: 1px solid rgba(148, 163, 184, 0.4);
      padding: 10px 12px;
      margin-bottom: 14px;
    }

    .timeline-row {
      display: flex;
      align-items: center;
      justify-content: space-between;
      gap: 10px;
      padding: 6px 0;
    }

    .timeline-label {
      display: flex;
      align-items: center;
      gap: 8px;
      font-size: 11px;
      color: var(--muted-color);
    }

    .timeline-bar {
      flex: 1 1 auto;
      height: 5px;
      border-radius: 999px;
      background: rgba(15, 23, 42, 1);
      overflow: hidden;
      position: relative;
    }

    .timeline-bar-fill {
      position: absolute;
      inset-block: 0;
      left: 0;
      border-radius: inherit;
      background: linear-gradient(90deg, #38bdf8, #22c55e, #eab308);
      transform-origin: left center;
      transform: scaleX(0.65);
    }

    .timeline-value {
      font-size: 11px;
      color: #e5f6ff;
      font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums;
    }

    .chart {
      margin-top: 4px;
      border-radius: 12px;
      background: radial-gradient(circle at top, rgba(15, 23, 42, 0.7), rgba(15, 23, 42, 1));
      border: 1px solid rgba(148, 163, 184, 0.4);
      padding: 10px;
      display: flex;
      flex-direction: column;
      gap: 8px;
    }

    .chart-header {
      display: flex;
      justify-content: space-between;
      align-items: center;
      font-size: 11px;
      color: var(--muted-color);
    }

    .chart-body {
      display: flex;
      align-items: flex-end;
      gap: 6px;
      height: 90px;
      position: relative;
    }

    .chart-body::before {
      content: "";
      position: absolute;
      inset-inline: 0;
      bottom: 0;
      border-bottom: 1px dashed rgba(148, 163, 184, 0.45);
      opacity: 0.6;
    }

    .chart-bar {
      flex: 1 1 0;
      border-radius: 999px;
      background: linear-gradient(180deg, rgba(56, 189, 248, 0.9), rgba(56, 189, 248, 0.2));
      position: relative;
      overflow: hidden;
      box-shadow: 0 10px 18px rgba(15, 23, 42, 0.85);
    }

    .chart-bar:nth-child(2) {
      height: 80%;
      background: linear-gradient(180deg, rgba(52, 211, 153, 0.9), rgba(52, 211, 153, 0.18));
    }

    .chart-bar:nth-child(3) {
      height: 55%;
      background: linear-gradient(180deg, rgba(250, 204, 21, 0.9), rgba(250, 204, 21, 0.18));
    }

    .chart-bar:nth-child(4) {
      height: 95%;
    }

    .chart-bar:nth-child(5) {
      height: 65%;
      background: linear-gradient(180deg, rgba(248, 250, 252, 0.9), rgba(148, 163, 184, 0.2));
    }

    .chart-bar:nth-child(6) {
      height: 45%;
      background: linear-gradient(180deg, rgba(251, 113, 133, 0.9), rgba(248, 113, 113, 0.18));
    }

    .chart-bar:nth-child(7) {
      height: 72%;
    }

    .chart-glow {
      position: absolute;
      inset: 0;
      opacity: 0.5;
      background: radial-gradient(circle at 50% 0, rgba(248, 250, 252, 0.5), transparent 60%);
      mix-blend-mode: screen;
    }

    .hero-float {
      position: absolute;
      inset-inline-start: -16px;
      bottom: -18px;
      width: 130px;
      padding: 10px 12px;
      border-radius: 18px;
      border: 1px solid rgba(148, 163, 184, 0.5);
      background: radial-gradient(circle at top left, rgba(56, 189, 248, 0.2), rgba(15, 23, 42, 0.98));
      box-shadow: 0 18px 34px rgba(15, 23, 42, 0.9);
      font-size: 11px;
      display: flex;
      flex-direction: column;
      gap: 4px;
    }

    .hero-float-label {
      color: var(--muted-color);
    }

    .hero-float-value {
      font-size: 13px;
      font-weight: 600;
      letter-spacing: 0.03em;
      display: inline-flex;
      align-items: center;
      gap: 6px;
    }

    .hero-float-value span {
      font-size: 11px;
      color: #bbf7d0;
      background: rgba(21, 128, 61, 0.25);
      border-radius: 999px;
      padding: 1px 6px;
      border: 1px solid rgba(34, 197, 94, 0.5);
    }

    .hero-orbit {
      position: absolute;
      inset: -40%;
      opacity: 0.7;
      mix-blend-mode: screen;
      pointer-events: none;
    }

    .hero-orbit::before,
    .hero-orbit::after {
      content: "";
      position: absolute;
      border-radius: 999px;
      border: 1px dashed rgba(148, 163, 184, 0.35);
      inset: 50%;
      transform: translate(-50%, -50%);
    }

    .hero-orbit::before {
      width: 220%;
      height: 120%;
    }

    .hero-orbit::after {
      width: 165%;
      height: 82%;
      transform: translate(-50%, -50%) rotate(24deg);
    }

    /* Features Section */
    .section-header {
      max-width: 640px;
      margin-bottom: 40px;
    }

    .section-kicker {
      font-size: 13px;
      text-transform: uppercase;
      letter-spacing: 0.16em;
      color: var(--muted-color);
      margin-bottom: 10px;
    }

    .section-title {
      font-size: 26px;
      letter-spacing: -0.04em;
      margin-bottom: 10px;
    }

    .section-desc {
      font-size: 15px;
      color: var(--muted-color);
    }

    .feature-grid {
      display: grid;
      grid-template-columns: repeat(3, minmax(0, 1fr));
      gap: 20px;
    }

    .feature-card {
      border-radius: 18px;
      padding: 18px 16px 16px;
      border: 1px solid rgba(148, 163, 184, 0.35);
      background: radial-gradient(circle at top, rgba(15, 23, 42, 0.9), rgba(15, 23, 42, 0.98));
      box-shadow: 0 14px 28px rgba(15, 23, 42, 0.8);
      display: flex;
      flex-direction: column;
      gap: 10px;
    }

    .feature-icon {
      width: 30px;
      height: 30px;
      border-radius: 999px;
      display: grid;
      place-items: center;
      font-size: 14px;
      background: radial-gradient(circle at top left, rgba(56, 189, 248, 0.3), rgba(8, 47, 73, 1));
      border: 1px solid rgba(56, 189, 248, 0.55);
      color: #e5f6ff;
      box-shadow: 0 10px 24px rgba(15, 23, 42, 0.9);
    }

    .feature-title {
      font-size: 15px;
      font-weight: 500;
    }

    .feature-text {
      font-size: 13px;
      line-height: 1.6;
      color: var(--muted-color);
    }

    .feature-meta-small {
      margin-top: 6px;
      font-size: 11px;
      color: rgba(148, 163, 184, 0.8);
      display: flex;
      align-items: center;
      gap: 10px;
      justify-content: space-between;
    }

    .pill-soft {
      padding: 3px 8px;
      border-radius: 999px;
      border: 1px solid rgba(148, 163, 184, 0.6);
      background: rgba(15, 23, 42, 0.9);
      font-size: 10px;
      text-transform: uppercase;
      letter-spacing: 0.12em;
    }

    /* Gallery / Showcase Section */
    .showcase-grid {
      display: grid;
      grid-template-columns: minmax(0, 1.5fr) minmax(0, 1fr);
      gap: 22px;
      align-items: stretch;
    }

    .showcase-main {
      border-radius: 20px;
      border: 1px solid rgba(148, 163, 184, 0.4);
      background: radial-gradient(circle at top left, rgba(56, 189, 248, 0.18), rgba(15, 23, 42, 1));
      padding: 18px 18px 14px;
      box-shadow: var(--shadow-soft);
      display: flex;
      flex-direction: column;
      gap: 10px;
    }

    .showcase-toolbar {
      display: flex;
      align-items: center;
      justify-content: space-between;
      gap: 10px;
      font-size: 11px;
      color: var(--muted-color);
    }

    .toolbar-dots {
      display: flex;
      gap: 5px;
      align-items: center;
    }

    .toolbar-dot {
      width: 8px;
      height: 8px;
      border-radius: 999px;
      background: #f97316;
    }

    .toolbar-dot:nth-child(2) { background: #22c55e; }
    .toolbar-dot:nth-child(3) { background: #38bdf8; }

    .showcase-canvas {
      flex: 1 1 auto;
      margin-top: 4px;
      border-radius: 14px;
      background: radial-gradient(circle at top, rgba(15, 23, 42, 0.8), rgba(15, 23, 42, 1));
      border: 1px solid rgba(148, 163, 184, 0.35);
      padding: 12px;
      position: relative;
      overflow: hidden;
    }

    .showcase-node {
      position: absolute;
      border-radius: 16px;
      padding: 10px 11px;
      background: rgba(15, 23, 42, 0.96);
      border: 1px solid rgba(148, 163, 184, 0.45);
      font-size: 11px;
      color: var(--muted-color);
      box-shadow: 0 10px 24px rgba(15, 23, 42, 0.9);
    }

    .node-title {
      font-size: 11px;
      margin-bottom: 4px;
      color: #e5f6ff;
    }

    .node-tag {
      display: inline-flex;
      border-radius: 999px;
      padding: 2px 6px;
      border: 1px solid rgba(56, 189, 248, 0.45);
      background: rgba(8, 47, 73, 0.7);
      color: #e5f6ff;
      font-size: 10px;
    }

    .showcase-node.node-a { top: 12%; left: 8%; }
    .showcase-node.node-b { top: 52%; left: 40%; }
    .showcase-node.node-c { top: 18%; right: 8%; }

    .connector {
      position: absolute;
      border-radius: 999px;
      background: linear-gradient(90deg, rgba(56, 189, 248, 0.8), rgba(56, 189, 248, 0));
      opacity: 0.7;
      filter: blur(0.4px);
    }

    .connector.conn-1 {
      width: 120px;
      height: 2px;
      top: 26%;
      left: 30%;
      transform: rotate(9deg);
    }

    .connector.conn-2 {
      width: 90px;
      height: 2px;
      top: 40%;
      left: 55%;
      transform: rotate(-26deg);
      background: linear-gradient(90deg, rgba(45, 212, 191, 0.8), rgba(45, 212, 191, 0));
    }

    .showcase-chip-row {
      display: flex;
      flex-wrap: wrap;
      gap: 8px;
      margin-top: auto;
      font-size: 10px;
      color: var(--muted-color);
    }

    .chip {
      padding: 4px 8px;
      border-radius: 999px;
      border: 1px solid rgba(148, 163, 184, 0.5);
      background: rgba(15, 23, 42, 0.94);
    }

    .showcase-side {
      display: flex;
      flex-direction: column;
      gap: 12px;
    }

    .side-card {
      flex: 1;
      border-radius: 18px;
      padding: 14px 14px;
      border: 1px solid rgba(148, 163, 184, 0.4);
      background: radial-gradient(circle at top left, rgba(56, 189, 248, 0.12), rgba(15, 23, 42, 0.98));
      box-shadow: 0 16px 30px rgba(15, 23, 42, 0.85);
      font-size: 13px;
      color: var(--muted-color);
      display: flex;

    // IntersectionObserver to reveal sections & update theme/nav
    const sections = document.querySelectorAll('section');
    const navLinks = document.querySelectorAll('.nav-link');
    const root = document.documentElement;
    const body = document.body;

    const observer = new IntersectionObserver(
      entries => {
        entries.forEach(entry => {
          const id = entry.target.id;
          if (entry.isIntersecting) {
            entry.target.classList.add('section-visible');

            // Highlight active nav link
            navLinks.forEach(link => {
              const href = link.getAttribute('href').slice(1);
              link.classList.toggle('active', href === id);
            });

            // Theme transitions (background & accent)
            const bg = entry.target.dataset.bg || '#020617';
            const accent = entry.target.dataset.accent || '#38bdf8';
            body.style.background = `radial-gradient(circle at top left, ${shadeColor(
              bg,
              12
            )} 0, ${bg} 40%, #020617 100%)`;
            root.style.setProperty('--accent-color', accent);
          }
        });
      },
      {
        threshold: 0.45
      }
    );

    sections.forEach(section => observer.observe(section));

    // Smooth scroll for nav links (for older browsers)
    navLinks.forEach(link => {
      link.addEventListener('click', e => {
        e.preventDefault();
        const target = document.querySelector(link.getAttribute('href'));
        if (!target) return;
        const top = target.getBoundingClientRect().top + window.scrollY - 80;
        window.scrollTo({ top, behavior: 'smooth' });
      });
    });

    // Tiny parallax for hero card
    const heroCard = document.querySelector('.hero-card.parallax');
    if (heroCard) {
      let currentX = 0;
      let currentY = 0;
      let targetX = 0;
      let targetY = 0;

      function animateParallax() {
        currentX += (targetX - currentX) * 0.12;
        currentY += (targetY - currentY) * 0.12;
        heroCard.style.transform = `translate3d(${currentX}px, ${currentY}px, 0)`;
        requestAnimationFrame(animateParallax);
      }
      animateParallax();

      window.addEventListener('mousemove', e => {
        const rect = heroCard.getBoundingClientRect();
        const x = (e.clientX - (rect.left + rect.width / 2)) / rect.width;
        const y = (e.clientY - (rect.top + rect.height / 2)) / rect.height;
        const intensity = 8;
        targetX = x * intensity;
        targetY = y * intensity;
      });
    }

    // Helper: shade color for subtle background variations
    function shadeColor(hex, percent) {
      const num = parseInt(hex.replace('#', ''), 16);
      const amt = Math.round(2.55 * percent);
      let r = (num >> 16) + amt;
      let g = ((num >> 8) & 0x00ff) + amt;
      let b = (num & 0x0000ff) + amt;
      r = r < 0 ? 0 : r > 255 ? 255 : r;
      g = g < 0 ? 0 : g > 255 ? 255 : g;
      b = b < 0 ? 0 : b > 255 ? 255 : b;
      return '#' + (0x1000000 + (r << 16) + (g << 8) + b).toString(16).slice(1);
    }
  </script>

question: framer-style-animation
prompt: Generate a landing page with smooth Framer-like transitions between sections. In a single-page self-contained HTML.
content:
<!DOCTYPE html>
<html lang="en">
<head>
    <meta charset="UTF-8">
    <meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1.0">
    <title>Flux - Design Without Limits</title>
    <style>
        * {
            margin: 0;
            padding: 0;
            box-sizing: border-box;
        }

        :root {
            --primary: #6366f1;
            --primary-dark: #4f46e5;
            --secondary: #ec4899;
            --dark: #0f172a;
            --light: #f8fafc;
            --gray: #64748b;
        }

        html {
            scroll-behavior: smooth;
        }

        body {
            font-family: 'Segoe UI', system-ui, -apple-system, sans-serif;
            background: var(--dark);
            color: var(--light);
            overflow-x: hidden;
        }

        /* Navigation */
        nav {
            position: fixed;
            top: 0;
            left: 0;
            right: 0;
            z-index: 1000;
            padding: 1.5rem 5%;
            display: flex;
            justify-content: space-between;
            align-items: center;
            transition: all 0.4s cubic-bezier(0.16, 1, 0.3, 1);
        }

        nav.scrolled {
            background: rgba(15, 23, 42, 0.9);
            backdrop-filter: blur(20px);
            padding: 1rem 5%;
        }

        .logo {
            font-size: 1.75rem;
            font-weight: 800;
            background: linear-gradient(135deg, var(--primary), var(--secondary));
            -webkit-background-clip: text;
            -webkit-text-fill-color: transparent;
            background-clip: text;
        }

        .nav-links {
            display: flex;
            gap: 2.5rem;
            list-style: none;
        }

        .nav-links a {
            color: var(--light);
            text-decoration: none;
            font-weight: 500;
            position: relative;
            transition: color 0.3s ease;
        }

        .nav-links a::after {
            content: '';
            position: absolute;
            bottom: -4px;
            left: 0;
            width: 0;
            height: 2px;
            background: linear-gradient(90deg, var(--primary), var(--secondary));
            transition: width 0.3s cubic-bezier(0.16, 1, 0.3, 1);
        }

        .nav-links a:hover::after {
            width: 100%;
        }

        .nav-cta {
            padding: 0.75rem 1.5rem;
            background: linear-gradient(135deg, var(--primary), var(--secondary));
            border: none;
            border-radius: 50px;
            color: white;
            font-weight: 600;
            cursor: pointer;
            transition: transform 0.3s ease, box-shadow 0.3s ease;
        }

        .nav-cta:hover {
            transform: translateY(-2px);
            box-shadow: 0 10px 40px rgba(99, 102, 241, 0.4);
        }

        /* Sections */
        section {
            min-height: 100vh;
            padding: 8rem 5%;
            position: relative;
            overflow: hidden;
        }

        /* Hero Section */
        .hero {
            display: flex;
            flex-direction: column;
            justify-content: center;
            align-items: center;
            text-align: center;
            background: radial-gradient(ellipse at center, rgba(99, 102, 241, 0.15) 0%, transparent 70%);
        }

        .hero-badge {
            display: inline-flex;
            align-items: center;
            gap: 0.5rem;
            padding: 0.5rem 1rem;
            background: rgba(99, 102, 241, 0.1);
            border: 1px solid rgba(99, 102, 241, 0.3);
            border-radius: 50px;
            font-size: 0.875rem;
            margin-bottom: 2rem;
            opacity: 0;
            transform: translateY(30px);
            animation: fadeInUp 0.8s cubic-bezier(0.16, 1, 0.3, 1) 0.2s forwards;
        }

        .hero-badge span {
            background: linear-gradient(135deg, var(--primary), var(--secondary));
            -webkit-background-clip: text;
            -webkit-text-fill-color: transparent;
            background-clip: text;
        }

        .hero h1 {
            font-size: clamp(3rem, 8vw, 6rem);
            font-weight: 800;
            line-height: 1.1;
            margin-bottom: 1.5rem;
            opacity: 0;
            transform: translateY(30px);
            animation: fadeInUp 0.8s cubic-bezier(0.16, 1, 0.3, 1) 0.4s forwards;
        }

        .hero h1 .gradient {
            background: linear-gradient(135deg, var(--primary), var(--secondary), #f472b6);
            -webkit-background-clip: text;
            -webkit-text-fill-color: transparent;
            background-clip: text;
        }

        .hero p {
            font-size: 1.25rem;
            color: var(--gray);
            max-width: 600px;
            margin-bottom: 3rem;
            opacity: 0;
            transform: translateY(30px);
            animation: fadeInUp 0.8s cubic-bezier(0.16, 1, 0.3, 1) 0.6s forwards;
        }

        .hero-buttons {
            display: flex;
            gap: 1rem;
            opacity: 0;
            transform: translateY(30px);
            animation: fadeInUp 0.8s cubic-bezier(0.16, 1, 0.3, 1) 0.8s forwards;
        }

        .btn-primary {
            padding: 1rem 2rem;
            background: linear-gradient(135deg, var(--primary), var(--secondary));
            border: none;
            border-radius: 50px;
            color: white;
            font-size: 1rem;
            font-weight: 600;
            cursor: pointer;
            transition: all 0.3s cubic-bezier(0.16, 1, 0.3, 1);
        }

        .btn-primary:hover {
            transform: translateY(-3px) scale(1.02);
            box-shadow: 0 20px 40px rgba(99, 102, 241, 0.4);
        }

        .btn-secondary {
            padding: 1rem 2rem;
            background: transparent;
            border: 2px solid rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.2);
            border-radius: 50px;
            color: white;
            font-size: 1rem;
            font-weight: 600;
            cursor: pointer;
            transition: all 0.3s cubic-bezier(0.16, 1, 0.3, 1);
        }

        .btn-secondary:hover {
            border-color: var(--primary);
            background: rgba(99, 102, 241, 0.1);
            transform: translateY(-3px);
        }

        /* Floating Elements */
        .floating-shapes {
            position: absolute;
            width: 100%;
            height: 100%;
            top: 0;
            left: 0;
            pointer-events: none;
            overflow: hidden;
        }

        .shape {
            position: absolute;
            border-radius: 50%;
            filter: blur(60px);
            opacity: 0.5;
            animation: float 20s ease-in-out infinite;
        }

        .shape-1 {
            width: 400px;
            height: 400px;
            background: var(--primary);
            top: 10%;
            left: -10%;
            animation-delay: 0s;
        }

        .shape-2 {
            width: 300px;
            height: 300px;
            background: var(--secondary);
            top: 60%;
            right: -5%;
            animation-delay: -5s;
        }

        .shape-3 {
            width: 200px;
            height: 200px;
            background: #8b5cf6;
            bottom: 10%;
            left: 30%;
            animation-delay: -10s;
        }

        @keyframes float {
            0%, 100% { transform: translate(0, 0) rotate(0deg); }
            25% { transform: translate(50px, -50px) rotate(90deg); }
            50% { transform: translate(0, -100px) rotate(180deg); }
            75% { transform: translate(-50px, -50px) rotate(270deg); }
        }

        @keyframes fadeInUp {
            to {
                opacity: 1;
                transform: translateY(0);
            }
        }

        /* Features Section */
        .features {
            background: linear-gradient(180deg, var(--dark) 0%, #1e1b4b 100%);
        }

        .section-header {
            text-align: center;
            margin-bottom: 5rem;
        }

        .section-header h2 {
            font-size: clamp(2rem, 5vw, 3.5rem);
            font-weight: 800;
            margin-bottom: 1rem;
        }

        .section-header p {
            color: var(--gray);
            font-size: 1.125rem;
            max-width: 500px;
            margin: 0 auto;
        }

        .features-grid {
            display: grid;
            grid-template-columns: repeat(auto-fit, minmax(300px, 1fr));
            gap: 2rem;
            max-width: 1200px;
            margin: 0 auto;
        }

        .feature-card {
            padding: 2.5rem;
            background: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.03);
            border: 1px solid rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.05);
            border-radius: 24px;
            transition: all 0.5s cubic-bezier(0.16, 1, 0.3, 1);
            opacity: 0;
            transform: translateY(50px);
        }

        .feature-card.visible {
            opacity: 1;
            transform: translateY(0);
        }

        .feature-card:hover {
            transform: translateY(-10px);
            background: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.05);
            border-color: rgba(99, 102, 241, 0.3);
            box-shadow: 0 30px 60px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.3);
        }

        .feature-icon {
            width: 60px;
            height: 60px;
            background: linear-gradient(135deg, var(--primary), var(--secondary));
            border-radius: 16px;
            display: flex;
            align-items: center;
            justify-content: center;
            font-size: 1.5rem;
            margin-bottom: 1.5rem;
            transition: transform 0.3s ease;
        }

        .feature-card:hover .feature-icon {
            transform: scale(1.1) rotate(5deg);
        }

        .feature-card h3 {
            font-size: 1.5rem;
            margin-bottom: 1rem;
        }

        .feature-card p {
            color: var(--gray);
            line-height: 1.7;
        }

        /* Showcase Section */
        .showcase {
            background: #1e1b4b;
            position: relative;
        }

        .showcase-container {
            display: grid;
            grid-template-columns: 1fr 1fr;
            gap: 4rem;
            align-items: center;
            max-width: 1200px;
            margin: 0 auto;
        }

        .showcase-content h2 {
            font-size: clamp(2rem, 4vw, 3rem);
            margin-bottom: 1.5rem;
        }

        .showcase-content p {
            color: var(--gray);
            font-size: 1.125rem;
            line-height: 1.8;
            margin-bottom: 2rem;
        }

        .showcase-list {
            list-style: none;
        }

        .showcase-list li {
            display: flex;
            align-items: center;
            gap: 1rem;
            margin-bottom: 1rem;
            font-size: 1.1rem;
        }

        .showcase-list li::before {
            content: '✓';
            width: 24px;
            height: 24px;
            background: linear-gradient(135deg, var(--primary), var(--secondary));
            border-radius: 50%;
            display: flex;
            align-items: center;
            justify-content: center;
            font-size: 0.75rem;
            flex-shrink: 0;
        }

        .showcase-visual {
            position: relative;
            perspective: 1000px;
        }

        .showcase-card {
            width: 100%;
            aspect-ratio: 4/3;
            background: linear-gradient(135deg, rgba(99, 102, 241, 0.2), rgba(236, 72, 153, 0.2));
            border-radius: 24px;
            border: 1px solid rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.1);
            display: flex;
            align-items: center;
            justify-content: center;
            font-size: 4rem;
            transition: transform 0.6s cubic-bezier(0.16, 1, 0.3, 1);
            transform-style: preserve-3d;
        }

        .showcase-card:hover {
            transform: rotateY(10deg) rotateX(5deg);
        }

        .showcase-card::before {
            content: '';
            position: absolute;
            inset: -2px;
            background: linear-gradient(135deg, var(--primary), var(--secondary));
            border-radius: 26px;
            z-index: -1;
            opacity: 0;
            transition: opacity 0.3s ease;
        }

        .showcase-card:hover::before {
            opacity: 1;
        }

        /* Testimonials */
        .testimonials {
            background: linear-gradient(180deg, #1e1b4b 0%, var(--dark) 100%);
        }

        .testimonials-track {
            display: flex;
            gap: 2rem;
            animation: scroll 30s linear infinite;
        }

        .testimonial-card {
            min-width: 400px;
            padding: 2rem;
            background: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.03);
            border: 1px solid rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.05);
            border-radius: 20px;
            transition: all 0.3s ease;
        }

        .testimonial-card:hover {
            background: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.05);
            transform: translateY(-5px);
        }

        .testimonial-header {
            display: flex;
            align-items: center;
            gap: 1rem;
            margin-bottom: 1.5rem;
        }

        .testimonial-avatar {
            width: 50px;
            height: 50px;
            border-radius: 50%;
            background: linear-gradient(135deg, var(--primary), var(--secondary));
            display: flex;
            align-items: center;
            justify-content: center;
            font-weight: 700;
        }

        .testimonial-info h4 {
            font-size: 1rem;
            margin-bottom: 0.25rem;
        }

        .testimonial-info span {
            color: var(--gray);
            font-size: 0.875rem;
        }

        .testimonial-card p {
            color: var(--gray);
            line-height: 1.7;
        }

        .stars {
            color: #fbbf24;
            margin-bottom: 1rem;
        }

        @keyframes scroll {
            0% { transform: translateX(0); }
            100% { transform: translateX(-50%); }
        }

        /* Pricing */
        .pricing {
            background: var(--dark);
        }

        .pricing-grid {
            display: grid;
            grid-template-columns: repeat(auto-fit, minmax(300px, 1fr));
            gap: 2rem;
            max-width: 1000px;
            margin: 0 auto;
        }

        .pricing-card {
            padding: 3rem 2rem;
            background: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.03);
            border: 1px solid rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.05);
            border-radius: 24px;
            text-align: center;
            transition: all 0.5s cubic-bezier(0.16, 1, 0.3, 1);
            opacity: 0;
            transform: translateY(50px) scale(0.95);
        }

        .pricing-card.visible {
            opacity: 1;
            transform: translateY(0) scale(1);
        }

        .pricing-card.featured {
            background: linear-gradient(135deg, rgba(99, 102, 241, 0.2), rgba(236, 72, 153, 0.2));
            border-color: rgba(99, 102, 241, 0.3);
            transform: scale(1.05);
        }

        .pricing-card.featured.visible {
            transform: scale(1.05);
        }

        .pricing-card:hover {
            transform: translateY(-10px);
        }

        .pricing-card.featured:hover {
            transform: translateY(-10px) scale(1.05);
        }

        .pricing-badge {
            display: inline-block;
            padding: 0.5rem 1rem;
            background: linear-gradient(135deg, var(--primary), var(--secondary));
            border-radius: 50px;
            font-size: 0.75rem;
            font-weight: 600;
            text-transform: uppercase;
            letter-spacing: 1px;
            margin-bottom: 1.5rem;
        }

        .pricing-card h3 {
            font-size: 1.5rem;
            margin-bottom: 1rem;
        }

        .pricing-price {
            font-size: 4rem;
            font-weight: 800;
            margin-bottom: 0.5rem;
        }

        .pricing-price span {
            font-size: 1rem;
            font-weight: 400;
            color: var(--gray);
        }

        .pricing-description {
            color: var(--gray);
            margin-bottom: 2rem;
        }

        .pricing-features {
            list-style: none;
            text-align: left;
            margin-bottom: 2rem;
        }

        .pricing-features li {
            padding: 0.75rem 0;
            border-bottom: 1px solid rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.05);
            display: flex;
            align-items: center;
            gap: 0.75rem;
        }

        .pricing-features li::before {
            content: '✓';
            color: var(--primary);
            font-weight: 700;
        }

        /* CTA Section */
        .cta {
            background: linear-gradient(135deg, var(--primary), var(--secondary));
            text-align: center;
            min-height: auto;
            padding: 6rem 5%;
        }

        .cta h2 {
            font-size: clamp(2rem, 5vw, 3.5rem);
            margin-bottom: 1.5rem;
        }

        .cta p {
            font-size: 1.25rem;
            opacity: 0.9;
            margin-bottom: 2.5rem;
            max-width: 600px;
            margin-left: auto;
            margin-right: auto;
        }

        .cta .btn-primary {
            background: white;
            color: var(--primary);
        }

        .cta .btn-primary:hover {
            box-shadow: 0 20px 40px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.3);
        }

        /* Footer */
        footer {
            background: var(--dark);
            padding: 4rem 5% 2rem;
        }

        .footer-content {
            display: grid;
            grid-template-columns: 2fr repeat(3, 1fr);
            gap: 4rem;
            max-width: 1200px;
            margin: 0 auto;
            padding-bottom: 3rem;
            border-bottom: 1px solid rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.05);
        }

        .footer-brand p {
            color: var(--gray);
            margin-top: 1rem;
            line-height: 1.7;
        }

        .footer-links h4 {
            font-size: 1rem;
            margin-bottom: 1.5rem;
        }

        .footer-links ul {
            list-style: none;
        }

        .footer-links li {
            margin-bottom: 0.75rem;
        }

        .footer-links a {
            color: var(--gray);
            text-decoration: none;
            transition: color 0.3s ease;
        }

        .footer-links a:hover {
            color: var(--light);
        }

        .footer-bottom {
            text-align: center;
            padding-top: 2rem;
            color: var(--gray);
        }

        /* Scroll Animations */
        .animate-on-scroll {
            opacity: 0;
            transform: translateY(50px);
            transition: all 0.8s cubic-bezier(0.16, 1, 0.3, 1);
        }

        .animate-on-scroll.visible {
            opacity: 1;
            transform: translateY(0);
        }

        /* Responsive */
        @media (max-width: 768px) {
            .nav-links {
                display: none;
            }

            .showcase-container {
                grid-template-columns: 1fr;
            }

            .footer-content {
                grid-template-columns: 1fr 1fr;
            }

            .testimonial-card {
                min-width: 300px;
            }
        }

        /* Cursor follower */
        .cursor {
            width: 20px;
            height: 20px;
            border: 2px solid var(--primary);
            border-radius: 50%;
            position: fixed;
            pointer-events: none;
            z-index: 9999;
            transition: transform 0.1s ease, width 0.3s ease, height 0.3s ease;
            transform: translate(-50%, -50%);
        }

        .cursor.hover {
            width: 50px;
            height: 50px;
            background: rgba(99, 102, 241, 0.1);
        }

        /* Smooth section transitions */
        .section-transition {
            position: relative;
        }

        .section-transition::before {
            content: '';
            position: absolute;
            top: 0;
            left: 0;
            right: 0;
            height: 200px;
            background: linear-gradient(to bottom, transparent, currentColor);
            opacity: 0.05;
            pointer-events: none;
        }
    </style>
</head>
<body>
    <div class="cursor"></div>

    <nav>
        <div class="logo">Flux</div>
        <ul class="nav-links">
            <li><a href="#features">Features</a></li>
            <li><a href="#showcase">Showcase</a></li>
            <li><a href="#testimonials">Testimonials</a></li>
            <li><a href="#pricing">Pricing</a></li>
        </ul>
        <button class="nav-cta">Get Started</button>
    </nav>

    <section class="hero">
        <div class="floating-shapes">
            <div class="shape shape-1"></div>
            <div class="shape shape-2"></div>
            <div class="shape shape-3"></div>
        </div>
        <div class="hero-badge">
            <span>✨ New</span> Introducing Flux 2.0
        </div>
        <h1>Design Without<br><span class="gradient">Limits</span></h1>
        <p>Create stunning, interactive websites with smooth animations and beautiful transitions. No code required.</p>
        <div class="hero-buttons">
            <button class="btn-primary">Start Free Trial</button>
            <button class="btn-secondary">Watch Demo</button>
        </div>
    </section>

    <section class="features" id="features">
        <div class="section-header animate-on-scroll">
            <h2>Powerful Features</h2>
            <p>Everything you need to create stunning digital experiences</p>
        </div>
        <div class="features-grid">
            <div class="feature-card">
                <div class="feature-icon">⚡</div>
                <h3>Lightning Fast</h3>
                <p>Optimized performance with instant loading times. Your websites will be blazing fast on any device.</p>
            </div>
            <div class="feature-card">
                <div class="feature-icon">🎨</div>
                <h3>Beautiful Design</h3>
                <p>Stunning pre-built components and templates that make your projects look professional from day one.</p>
            </div>
            <div class="feature-card">
                <div class="feature-icon">🔄</div>
                <h3>Smooth Animations</h3>
                <p>Framer-quality transitions and animations that bring your designs to life with buttery smooth motion.</p>
            </div>
            <div class="feature-card">
                <div class="feature-icon">📱</div>
                <h3>Fully Responsive</h3>
                <p>Designs that look perfect on every screen size, from mobile phones to large desktop displays.</p>
            </div>
            <div class="feature-card">
                <div class="feature-icon">🔌</div>
                <h3>Easy Integration</h3>
                <p>Connect with your favorite tools and services. Seamless integrations with popular platforms.</p>
            </div>
            <div class="feature-card">
                <div class="feature-icon">🛡️</div>
                <h3>Secure & Reliable</h3>
                <p>Enterprise-grade security with 99.9% uptime guarantee. Your data is always safe with us.</p>
            </div>
        </div>

    <script>
        // Custom cursor
        const cursor = document.querySelector('.cursor');
        let mouseX = 0, mouseY = 0;
        let cursorX = 0, cursorY = 0;

        document.addEventListener('mousemove', (e) => {
            mouseX = e.clientX;
            mouseY = e.clientY;
        });

        function animateCursor() {
            cursorX += (mouseX - cursorX) * 0.1;
            cursorY += (mouseY - cursorY) * 0.1;
            cursor.style.left = cursorX + 'px';
            cursor.style.top = cursorY + 'px';
            requestAnimationFrame(animateCursor);
        }
        animateCursor();

        // Cursor hover effect
        const hoverElements = document.querySelectorAll('a, button, .feature-card, .pricing-card, .testimonial-card');
        hoverElements.forEach(el => {
            el.addEventListener('mouseenter', () => cursor.classList.add('hover'));
            el.addEventListener('mouseleave', () => cursor.classList.remove('hover'));
        });

        // Navigation scroll effect
        const nav = document.querySelector('nav');
        window.addEventListener('scroll', () => {
            if (window.scrollY > 50) {
                nav.classList.add('scrolled');
            } else {
                nav.classList.remove('scrolled');
            }
        });

        // Intersection Observer for scroll animations
        const observerOptions = {
            threshold: 0.1,
            rootMargin: '0px 0px -50px 0px'
        };

        const observer = new IntersectionObserver((entries) => {
            entries.forEach(entry => {
                if (entry.isIntersecting) {
                    entry.target.classList.add('visible');
                }
            });
        }, observerOptions);

        // Observe all animated elements
        document.querySelectorAll('.animate-on-scroll, .feature-card, .pricing-card').forEach(el => {
            observer.observe(el);
        });

        // Stagger animation for feature cards
        const featureCards = document.querySelectorAll('.feature-card');
        const featureObserver = new IntersectionObserver((entries) => {
            entries.forEach((entry, index) => {
                if (entry.isIntersecting) {
                    setTimeout(() => {
                        entry.target.classList.add('visible');
                    }, index * 100);
                }
            });
        }, observerOptions);

        featureCards.forEach(card => featureObserver.observe(card));

        // Stagger animation for pricing cards
        const pricingCards = document.querySelectorAll('.pricing-card');
        const pricingObserver = new IntersectionObserver((entries) => {
            entries.forEach((entry, index) => {
                if (entry.isIntersecting) {
                    setTimeout(() => {
                        entry.target.classList.add('visible');
                    }, index * 150);
                }
            });
        }, observerOptions);

        pricingCards.forEach(card => pricingObserver.observe(card));

        // Smooth scroll for navigation links
        document.querySelectorAll('a[href^="#"]').forEach(anchor => {
            anchor.addEventListener('click', function(e) {
                e.preventDefault();
                const target = document.querySelector(this.getAttribute('href'));
                if (target) {
                    target.scrollIntoView({
                        behavior: 'smooth',
                        block: 'start'
                    });
                }
            });
        });

        // Parallax effect for floating shapes
        document.addEventListener('mousemove', (e) => {
            const shapes = document.querySelectorAll('.shape');
            const x = e.clientX / window.innerWidth;
            const y = e.clientY / window.innerHeight;

            shapes.forEach((shape, index) => {
                const speed = (index + 1) * 20;
                const xOffset = (x - 0.5) * speed;
                const yOffset = (y - 0.5) * speed;
                shape.style.transform = `translate(${xOffset}px, ${yOffset}px)`;
            });
        });

        // 3D tilt effect for showcase card
        const showcaseCard = document.querySelector('.showcase-card');
        if (showcaseCard) {
            showcaseCard.addEventListener('mousemove', (e) => {
                const rect = showcaseCard.getBoundingClientRect();
                const x = e.clientX - rect.left;
                const y = e.clientY - rect.top;
                const centerX = rect.width / 2;
                const centerY = rect.height / 2;
                const rotateX = (y - centerY) / 10;
                const rotateY = (centerX - x) / 10;

                showcaseCard.style.transform = `rotateX(${rotateX}deg) rotateY(${rotateY}deg)`;
            });

            showcaseCard.addEventListener('mouseleave', () => {
                showcaseCard.style.transform = 'rotateX(0) rotateY(0)';
            });
        }

        // Button ripple effect
        document.querySelectorAll('.btn-primary, .btn-secondary').forEach(button => {
            button.addEventListener('click', function(e) {
                const rect = this.getBoundingClientRect();
                const x = e.clientX - rect.left;
                const y = e.clientY - rect.top;

                const ripple = document.createElement('span');
                ripple.style.cssText = `
                    position: absolute;
                    background: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.3);
                    border-radius: 50%;
                    pointer-events: none;
                    width: 100px;
                    height: 100px;
                    left: ${x - 50}px;
                    top: ${y - 50}px;
                    transform: scale(0);
                    animation: ripple 0.6s ease-out;
                `;

                this.style.position = 'relative';
                this.style.overflow = 'hidden';
                this.appendChild(ripple);

                setTimeout(() => ripple.remove(), 600);
            });
        });

        // Add ripple animation
        const style = document.createElement('style');
        style.textContent = `
            @keyframes ripple {
                to {
                    transform: scale(4);
                    opacity: 0;
                }
            }
        `;
        document.head.appendChild(style);

        // Pause testimonials animation on hover
        const testimonialsTrack = document.querySelector('.testimonials-track');
        if (testimonialsTrack) {
            testimonialsTrack.addEventListener('mouseenter', () => {
                testimonialsTrack.style.animationPlayState = 'paused';
            });
            testimonialsTrack.addEventListener('mouseleave', () => {
                testimonialsTrack.style.animationPlayState = 'running';
            });
        }
    </script>
