  .test-avatar.t3 { background: linear-gradient(135deg, #00d4ff, #00a2cc); }
  .test-name { font-weight: 600; font-size: 14px; }
  .test-role { font-size: 13px; color: rgba(10,10,11,0.5); }

  /* ============================================================
     PRICING
     ============================================================ */
  .pricing-grid {
    display: grid; grid-template-columns: repeat(3, 1fr);
    gap: 20px; margin-top: 64px;
  }
  @media (max-width: 900px) { .pricing-grid { grid-template-columns: 1fr; } }

  .price-card {
    background: linear-gradient(180deg, rgba(255,255,255,0.04) 0%, rgba(255,255,255,0.01) 100%);

    border: 1px solid rgba(255,91,58,0.4);

  .footer-bottom {
    display: flex; justify-content: space-between;

  /* ============================================================

  .progress {

    height: 2px; width: 0%;
    background: linear-gradient(90deg, #ff5b3a, #ff9966);
    z-index: 200;
    transition: width 0.1s;
  }
</style>

  // ========== Custom cursor ==========
  const cursor = document.getElementById('cursor');
  const cursorDot = document.getElementById('cursorDot');
  let mouseX = 0, mouseY = 0, curX = 0, curY = 0;

  document.addEventListener('mousemove', (e) => {
    mouseX = e.clientX; mouseY = e.clientY;
    cursorDot.style.left = mouseX + 'px';
    cursorDot.style.top = mouseY + 'px';
  });

  function animateCursor() {
    curX += (mouseX - curX) * 0.15;
    curY += (mouseY - curY) * 0.15;
    cursor.style.left = curX + 'px';
    cursor.style.top = curY + 'px';
    requestAnimationFrame(animateCursor);
  }
  animateCursor();

  // Hover state for cursor
  document.querySelectorAll('a, button, .bento-item, .price-card, .test-card').forEach(el => {
    el.addEventListener('mouseenter', () => cursor.classList.add('hover'));
    el.addEventListener('mouseleave', () => cursor.classList.remove('hover'));
  });

  // ========== Nav scroll state ==========
  const nav = document.getElementById('nav');
  const progress = document.getElementById('progress');
  window.addEventListener('scroll', () => {
    if (window.scrollY > 50) nav.classList.add('scrolled');
    else nav.classList.remove('scrolled');

    const h = document.documentElement.scrollHeight - window.innerHeight;
    const p = (window.scrollY / h) * 100;
    progress.style.width = p + '%';
  });

  // ========== Reveal on scroll (Intersection Observer) ==========
  const observer = new IntersectionObserver((entries) => {
    entries.forEach(entry => {
      if (entry.isIntersecting) {
        entry.target.classList.add('visible');
        observer.unobserve(entry.target);
      }
    });
  }, { threshold: 0.1, rootMargin: '0px 0px -50px 0px' });

  document.querySelectorAll('.reveal, .reveal-stagger, .mask-text').forEach(el => observer.observe(el));

  // ========== Counter animation ==========
  const counterObserver = new IntersectionObserver((entries) => {
    entries.forEach(entry => {
      if (entry.isIntersecting) {
        const el = entry.target;
        const target = parseFloat(el.dataset.count);
        const suffix = el.dataset.suffix || '';
        const decimal = parseInt(el.dataset.decimal || '0');
        const duration = 2000;
        const start = performance.now();
        function tick(now) {
          const t = Math.min((now - start) / duration, 1);
          const eased = 1 - Math.pow(1 - t, 4);
          const val = target * eased;
          el.textContent = val.toFixed(decimal) + suffix;
          if (t < 1) requestAnimationFrame(tick);
        }
        requestAnimationFrame(tick);
        counterObserver.unobserve(el);
      }
    });
  }, { threshold: 0.5 });

  document.querySelectorAll('[data-count]').forEach(el => counterObserver.observe(el));

  // ========== Parallax for hero orbs ==========
  const orbs = document.querySelectorAll('[data-parallax]');
  document.addEventListener('mousemove', (e) => {
    const x = (e.clientX / window.innerWidth - 0.5) * 2;
    const y = (e.clientY / window.innerHeight - 0.5) * 2;
    orbs.forEach(orb => {
      const speed = parseFloat(orb.dataset.parallax) * 30;
      orb.style.transform = `translate(${x * speed}px, ${y * speed}px)`;
    });
  });

  // ========== Smooth section transitions: scroll-linked reveals ==========
  let lastScroll = 0;
  const sections = document.querySelectorAll('section');
  window.addEventListener('scroll', () => {
    const scrolled = window.scrollY;
    sections.forEach((sec, i) => {
      const rect = sec.getBoundingClientRect();
      const center = rect.top + rect.height / 2 - window.innerHeight / 2;
      // Subtle parallax for section labels
      const label = sec.querySelector('.section-label');
      if (label && Math.abs(center) < window.innerHeight) {
        label.style.transform = `translateX(${center * 0.05}px)`;
      }
    });
    lastScroll = scrolled;
  });

  // ========== Smooth scroll for anchor links ==========
  document.querySelectorAll('a[href^="#"]').forEach(a => {
    a.addEventListener('click', (e) => {
      const target = document.querySelector(a.getAttribute('href'));
      if (target) {
        e.preventDefault();
        target.scrollIntoView({ behavior: 'smooth', block: 'start' });
      }
    });
  });
</script>

</html>

    :root {

      /* Framer-style expressive easing */
      --ease: cubic-bezier(0.22, 1, 0.36, 1);
      --ease-emphatic: cubic-bezier(0.16, 1, 0.3, 1);
      --blur: blur(18px);

    * { box-sizing: border-box; }

      scroll-behavior: smooth;

    body {

        radial-gradient(circle at top left, rgba(167, 139, 250, 0.22), transparent 34rem),

        radial-gradient(circle at 50% 100%, rgba(244, 114, 182, 0.12), transparent 36rem),
        var(--bg);
      overflow-x: hidden;
      -webkit-font-smoothing: antialiased;
      text-rendering: optimizeLegibility;
    }

    /* Subtle grid + grain backdrop */
    body::before {
      content: "";
      position: fixed; inset: 0; z-index: -3; pointer-events: none;
      background-image:
        linear-gradient(rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.04) 1px, transparent 1px),
        linear-gradient(90deg, rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.04) 1px, transparent 1px);
      background-size: 56px 56px;
      mask-image: linear-gradient(to bottom, rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.85), transparent 85%);
    }

    a { color: inherit; text-decoration: none; }
    img, svg { display: block; max-width: 100%; }
    button, input { font: inherit; }
    ::selection { color: #06060a; background: #c4b5fd; }

    .container {
      width: min(calc(100% - 40px), var(--container));
      margin-inline: auto;
    }

    .skip-link {
      position: fixed; left: 16px; top: 16px; z-index: 999;
      transform: translateY(-140%);
      padding: 12px 16px; border-radius: 999px;
      background: var(--text); color: var(--bg);
      transition: transform 240ms var(--ease);
    }
    .skip-link:focus { transform: translateY(0); }

    /* Scroll progress bar */
    .progress {
      position: fixed; top: 0; left: 0; z-index: 101;
      width: 100%; height: 2px; background: transparent;
    }
    .progress__bar {
      height: 100%; width: 0%;
      background: linear-gradient(90deg, var(--brand), var(--brand-2), var(--brand-3));

      position: sticky; top: 0; z-index: 100;
      height: var(--nav-height);
      display: flex; align-items: center;
      border-bottom: 1px solid transparent;

      background: rgba(9, 9, 15, 0.72);

    }
    .mobile-toggle span, .mobile-toggle span::before, .mobile-toggle span::after {
      display: block; width: 18px; height: 2px; border-radius: 999px; background: currentColor;
      transition: transform 240ms var(--ease), opacity 240ms var(--ease);
    }
    .mobile-toggle span { position: relative; }
    .mobile-toggle span::before, .mobile-toggle span::after { content: ""; position: absolute; left: 0; }
    .mobile-toggle span::before { top: -6px; }
    .mobile-toggle span::after { top: 6px; }
    .mobile-toggle[aria-expanded="true"] span { transform: rotate(45deg); }
    .mobile-toggle[aria-expanded="true"] span::before { transform: translateY(6px) rotate(90deg); }
    .mobile-toggle[aria-expanded="true"] span::after { transform: translateY(-6px); opacity: 0; }

    /* Buttons */
    .btn {
      --btn-bg: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.08);
      --btn-color: var(--text);
      --btn-border: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.14);
      position: relative; isolation: isolate;
      display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; gap: 10px;
      min-height: 46px; padding: 0 18px;
      border: 1px solid var(--btn-border); border-radius: 999px;
      color: var(--btn-color); background: var(--btn-bg);
      box-shadow: inset 0 1px 0 rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.08); cursor: pointer; overflow: hidden;
      transition: transform 240ms var(--ease), border-color 240ms var(--ease), background 240ms var(--ease), box-shadow 240ms var(--ease);
    }
    .btn::before {
      content: ""; position: absolute; inset: -2px; z-index: -1; opacity: 0;
      background:
        radial-gradient(circle at var(--mx, 50%) var(--my, 50%), rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.3), transparent 26%),
        linear-gradient(135deg, rgba(167, 139, 250, 0.45), rgba(34, 211, 238, 0.32));
      transition: opacity 240ms var(--ease);
    }
    .btn:hover { transform: translateY(-2px); box-shadow: 0 16px 38px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.22); }
    .btn:hover::before { opacity: 1; }
    .btn:focus-visible, a:focus-visible, button:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid rgba(34, 211, 238, 0.75); outline-offset: 3px; }
    .btn--primary {
      --btn-bg: linear-gradient(135deg, #ede9fe, #a5f3fc);
      --btn-color: #09090f; --btn-border: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.42);
      font-weight: 720; box-shadow: 0 14px 46px rgba(34, 211, 238, 0.22), inset 0 1px 0 rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.65);
    }
    .btn--ghost { --btn-bg: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.055); }
    .icon-arrow { width: 17px; height: 17px; transition: transform 240ms var(--ease); }
    .btn:hover .icon-arrow { transform: translateX(3px); }

    /* Sections */
    main { position: relative; }
    .section {
      position: relative; padding: 118px 0; overflow: clip;
      scroll-margin-top: calc(var(--nav-height) + 24px);
    }
    .section--hero {
      min-height: calc(100svh - var(--nav-height));
      display: grid; align-items: center;
      padding-top: 76px; padding-bottom: 96px;
    }
    .section__bg { position: absolute; inset: 0; z-index: -1; pointer-events: none; }

    .orb {
      position: absolute; border-radius: 999px; opacity: 0.8; filter: blur(12px);
      transform: translate3d(0, var(--parallax-y, 0), 0); will-change: transform;
    }
    .orb--one { width: 340px; height: 340px; top: 10%; right: 4%; background: radial-gradient(circle, rgba(167, 139, 250, 0.35), transparent 68%); }
    .orb--two { width: 280px; height: 280px; left: -80px; bottom: 8%; background: radial-gradient(circle, rgba(34, 211, 238, 0.24), transparent 68%); }
    .orb--three { width: 220px; height: 220px; right: 16%; bottom: 0; background: radial-gradient(circle, rgba(244, 114, 182, 0.22), transparent 68%); }

    .hero {
      display: grid; grid-template-columns: minmax(0, 1.05fr) minmax(320px, 0.95fr);
      align-items: center; gap: 56px;
    }
    .eyebrow {
      display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 10px; width: fit-content; margin-bottom: 22px;
      padding: 8px 12px; border: 1px solid var(--line); border-radius: 999px;
      color: var(--muted); background: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.055); backdrop-filter: var(--blur);
      box-shadow: inset 0 1px 0 rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.08); font-size: 0.92rem;
    }
    .eyebrow__dot { width: 8px; height: 8px; border-radius: 999px; background: var(--success); box-shadow: 0 0 18px rgba(52, 211, 153, 0.9); }

    h1, h2, h3, p { margin-top: 0; }
    h1 { max-width: 900px; margin-bottom: 24px; font-size: clamp(3.2rem, 7.6vw, 7.4rem); line-height: 0.9; letter-spacing: -0.085em; }
    .gradient-text {
      color: transparent;
      background: linear-gradient(90deg, #ffffff 0%, #ddd6fe 24%, #a5f3fc 56%, #fbcfe8 88%);
      background-clip: text; -webkit-background-clip: text;
    }
    .hero__copy { max-width: 650px; margin-bottom: 34px; color: var(--muted); font-size: clamp(1.08rem, 1.8vw, 1.28rem); line-height: 1.75; }
    .hero__actions { display: flex; flex-wrap: wrap; gap: 14px; margin-bottom: 34px; }
    .hero__meta { display: flex; flex-wrap: wrap; gap: 16px; color: var(--muted-2); font-size: 0.94rem; }
    .hero__meta strong { color: var(--text); font-weight: 760; }

    /* Pointer-tilt 3D visual */
    .visual { position: relative; min-height: 560px; perspective: 1200px; }
    .dashboard {
      position: absolute; inset: 28px 0 auto auto; width: min(100%, 530px); min-height: 440px;
      border: 1px solid rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.16); border-radius: var(--radius-xl);
      background: linear-gradient(180deg, rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.14), rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.055)), rgba(14, 14, 24, 0.66);
      box-shadow: var(--shadow), inset 0 1px 0 rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.14); backdrop-filter: blur(24px);
      transform: translate3d(0, var(--parallax-y, 0), 0) rotateX(var(--ry, 6deg)) rotateY(var(--rx, -10deg)) rotateZ(1deg);
      transform-style: preserve-3d; will-change: transform; overflow: hidden;
      transition: transform 200ms var(--ease);
    }
    .dashboard::before {
      content: ""; position: absolute; inset: 0; pointer-events: none;
      background: radial-gradient(circle at 20% 10%, rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.18), transparent 30%), linear-gradient(135deg, rgba(167, 139, 250, 0.18), transparent 36%);
    }
    .dashboard__top { position: relative; display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: space-between; padding: 20px; border-bottom: 1px solid var(--line); }
    .traffic { display: flex; gap: 8px; }
    .traffic span { width: 11px; height: 11px; border-radius: 999px; background: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.28); }
    .traffic span:nth-child(1) { background: #fb7185; }
    .traffic span:nth-child(2) { background: #fbbf24; }
    .traffic span:nth-child(3) { background: #34d399; }
    .dashboard__pill { padding: 7px 10px; border: 1px solid var(--line); border-radius: 999px; color: var(--muted); background: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.055); font-size: 0.8rem; }
    .dashboard__body { position: relative; display: grid; gap: 16px; padding: 20px; }
    .metric-grid { display: grid; grid-template-columns: 1fr 1fr; gap: 14px; }
    .metric { min-height: 116px; padding: 18px; border: 1px solid var(--line); border-radius: 22px; background: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.06); }
    .metric small { color: var(--muted-2); }
    .metric b { display: block; margin-top: 12px; font-size: 2rem; letter-spacing: -0.05em; }
    .chart { height: 168px; padding: 18px; border: 1px solid var(--line); border-radius: 24px; background: linear-gradient(180deg, rgba(34, 211, 238, 0.08), transparent), rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.055); }
    .bars { display: flex; align-items: end; height: 100%; gap: 10px; }
    .bars span {
      flex: 1; min-width: 12px; border-radius: 999px 999px 8px 8px;
      background: linear-gradient(180deg, #a5f3fc, #a78bfa 70%, rgba(167, 139, 250, 0.35));
      transform-origin: bottom; animation: barRise 1200ms var(--ease-emphatic) both;
      animation-delay: calc(var(--i) * 80ms + 500ms);
    }
    @keyframes barRise { from { transform: scaleY(0.12); opacity: 0.35; } to { transform: scaleY(1); opacity: 1; } }

    .floating-card {
      position: absolute; z-index: 2; width: 220px; padding: 16px;
      border: 1px solid rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.16); border-radius: 22px;
      background: rgba(15, 15, 26, 0.72); box-shadow: 0 20px 70px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.36); backdrop-filter: blur(20px);
      transform: translate3d(0, var(--parallax-y, 0), 0); will-change: transform;
    }
    .floating-card--one { left: 0; top: 84px; }
    .floating-card--two { right: 10px; bottom: 42px; width: 250px; }
    .floating-card small { color: var(--muted-2); }
    .floating-card strong { display: block; margin-top: 7px; font-size: 1.22rem; letter-spacing: -0.04em; }
    .pulse-row { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 8px; margin-top: 12px; }
    .pulse-row span { width: 100%; height: 8px; border-radius: 999px; background: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.09); overflow: hidden; }
    .pulse-row span::before { content: ""; display: block; width: 74%; height: 100%; border-radius: inherit; background: linear-gradient(90deg, var(--brand), var(--brand-2)); }

    /* Section heads */
    .section-head { display: grid; grid-template-columns: minmax(0, 0.9fr) minmax(260px, 0.55fr); align-items: end; gap: 36px; margin-bottom: 48px; }
    .section-kicker { margin-bottom: 14px; color: var(--brand-2); font-size: 0.86rem; font-weight: 760; letter-spacing: 0.14em; text-transform: uppercase; }
    h2 { margin-bottom: 0; font-size: clamp(2.35rem, 5vw, 4.8rem); line-height: 0.98; letter-spacing: -0.075em; }
    .section-head p { margin-bottom: 0; color: var(--muted); line-height: 1.75; font-size: 1.04rem; }

    /* Feature cards with cursor spotlight */
    .feature-grid { display: grid; grid-template-columns: repeat(3, 1fr); gap: 18px; }
    .card {
      position: relative; min-height: 280px; padding: 26px;
      border: 1px solid var(--line); border-radius: var(--radius-lg);
      background: linear-gradient(180deg, rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.095), rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.045)), rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.035);
      box-shadow: inset 0 1px 0 rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.08); overflow: hidden;
      transition: transform 360ms var(--ease), border-color 360ms var(--ease), box-shadow 360ms var(--ease);
    }
    .card::before {
      content: ""; position: absolute; inset: -1px; opacity: 0; pointer-events: none;
      background: radial-gradient(circle at var(--mx, 50%) var(--my, 50%), rgba(167, 139, 250, 0.28), transparent 34%), linear-gradient(135deg, rgba(34, 211, 238, 0.12), transparent 45%);
      transition: opacity 360ms var(--ease);
    }
    .card:hover { transform: translateY(-8px); border-color: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.24); box-shadow: 0 28px 80px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.24); }
    .card:hover::before { opacity: 1; }
    .card > * { position: relative; }
    .card__icon {
      width: 48px; height: 48px; display: grid; place-items: center; margin-bottom: 60px;
      border: 1px solid rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.16); border-radius: 16px;
      background: linear-gradient(135deg, rgba(167, 139, 250, 0.32), rgba(34, 211, 238, 0.16)), rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.06);
      color: #dbeafe; box-shadow: inset 0 1px 0 rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.12);
    }
    .card h3 { margin-bottom: 12px; font-size: 1.35rem; letter-spacing: -0.04em; }
    .card p { margin-bottom: 0; color: var(--muted); line-height: 1.72; }

    /* Marquee */
    .marquee { margin-top: 72px; border-block: 1px solid var(--line); overflow: hidden; mask-image: linear-gradient(90deg, transparent, black 12%, black 88%, transparent); }
    .marquee__track { display: flex; width: max-content; animation: marquee 24s linear infinite; }
    .marquee__item { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 10px; padding: 20px 28px; color: var(--muted); font-weight: 680; letter-spacing: -0.03em; }
    .marquee__item::before { content: ""; width: 8px; height: 8px; border-radius: 999px; background: linear-gradient(135deg, var(--brand), var(--brand-2)); }
    @keyframes marquee { to { transform: translateX(-50%); } }

    /* Process with sticky panel */
    .process { display: grid; grid-template-columns: 0.8fr 1.2fr; gap: 28px; align-items: start; }
    .sticky-panel {
      position: sticky; top: calc(var(--nav-height) + 28px); padding: 30px;
      border: 1px solid var(--line); border-radius: var(--radius-xl);
      background: linear-gradient(180deg, rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.1), rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.045)), rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.04);
      box-shadow: var(--shadow);
    }
    .sticky-panel h2 { margin-bottom: 14px; }
    .sticky-panel p { color: var(--muted); line-height: 1.75; margin-bottom: 20px; }
    .steps { display: grid; gap: 16px; }
    .step { display: grid; grid-template-columns: 70px 1fr; gap: 18px; padding: 24px; min-height: 150px; border: 1px solid var(--line); border-radius: var(--radius-lg); background: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.05); }
    .step__num { display: grid; place-items: center; width: 54px; height: 54px; border-radius: 18px; background: linear-gradient(135deg, rgba(167, 139, 250, 0.34), rgba(34, 211, 238, 0.18)); color: #eef2ff; font-weight: 780; }
    .step h3 { margin-bottom: 10px; letter-spacing: -0.04em; }
    .step p { margin-bottom: 0; color: var(--muted); line-height: 1.72; }

    /* Pricing */
    .pricing-grid { display: grid; grid-template-columns: repeat(3, 1fr); gap: 18px; align-items: stretch; }
    .price-card { position: relative; display: flex; flex-direction: column; padding: 28px; border: 1px solid var(--line); border-radius: var(--radius-xl); background: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.052); overflow: hidden; }
    .price-card--featured { background: radial-gradient(circle at 50% 0%, rgba(34, 211, 238, 0.18), transparent 34%), linear-gradient(180deg, rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.12), rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.055)); border-color: rgba(165, 243, 252, 0.28); box-shadow: 0 30px 90px rgba(34, 211, 238, 0.1); }
    .badge { width: fit-content; margin-bottom: 22px; padding: 7px 11px; border-radius: 999px; background: rgba(34, 211, 238, 0.12); color: #a5f3fc; font-size: 0.84rem; font-weight: 720; }
    .price { margin: 18px 0 22px; font-size: 3.4rem; font-weight: 790; letter-spacing: -0.07em; }
    .price span { color: var(--muted-2); font-size: 1rem; letter-spacing: -0.02em; font-weight: 520; }
    .features-list { display: grid; gap: 12px; margin: 0 0 26px; padding: 0; list-style: none; color: var(--muted); }
    .features-list li { display: flex; gap: 10px; line-height: 1.5; }
    .features-list li::before { content: "✓"; color: var(--success); font-weight: 800; }
    .price-card .btn { margin-top: auto; }

    /* FAQ */
    .faq { display: grid; grid-template-columns: 0.85fr 1.15fr; gap: 38px; align-items: start; }
    .accordion { display: grid; gap: 12px; }
    details { border: 1px solid var(--line); border-radius: 20px; background: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.052); overflow: hidden; }
    summary { display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: space-between; gap: 16px; padding: 20px 22px; cursor: pointer; font-weight: 700; letter-spacing: -0.03em; }
    summary::-webkit-details-marker { display: none; }
    summary::after { content: "+"; width: 30px; height: 30px; display: grid; place-items: center; border: 1px solid var(--line); border-radius: 50%; color: var(--muted); transition: transform 260ms var(--ease); }
    details[open] summary::after { transform: rotate(45deg); }
    details p { margin: 0; padding: 0 22px 22px; color: var(--muted); line-height: 1.72; }

    /* CTA */
    .cta { text-align: center; padding: 78px 28px; border: 1px solid var(--line); border-radius: 38px; background: radial-gradient(circle at top, rgba(167, 139, 250, 0.28), transparent 36%), radial-gradient(circle at bottom right, rgba(34, 211, 238, 0.16), transparent 32%), linear-gradient(180deg, rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.105), rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.045)); box-shadow: var(--shadow); }
    .cta h2 { max-width: 840px; margin-inline: auto; margin-bottom: 20px; }
    .cta p { max-width: 640px; margin-inline: auto; margin-bottom: 30px; color: var(--muted); line-height: 1.72; }

    /* Footer */
    .site-footer { padding: 36px 0 48px; color: var(--muted-2); }
    .footer-inner { display: flex; justify-content: space-between; gap: 24px; border-top: 1px solid var(--line); padding-top: 24px; }
    .footer-links { display: flex; gap: 18px; }

    /* Soft section divider */
    .section-transition { position: absolute; left: 50%; top: 0; width: min(100% - 40px, var(--container)); height: 1px; transform: translateX(-50%); background: linear-gradient(90deg, transparent, rgba(255,255,255,0.18), transparent); }
    .section-transition::after { content: ""; position: absolute; left: 50%; top: -64px; width: 260px; height: 130px; transform: translateX(-50%); border-radius: 50%; background: radial-gradient(circle, rgba(167, 139, 250, 0.18), transparent 68%); filter: blur(18px); }

    /* ── Scroll-triggered reveals ── */
    [data-reveal] {
      opacity: 0;
      transform: translate3d(0, 34px, 0) scale(0.985);
      filter: blur(10px);
      transition: opacity 900ms var(--ease-emphatic), transform 900ms var(--ease-emphatic), filter 900ms var(--ease-emphatic);
      transition-delay: var(--delay, 0ms);
      will-change: opacity, transform, filter;
    }
    [data-reveal].is-visible { opacity: 1; transform: translate3d(0, 0, 0) scale(1); filter: blur(0); }
    [data-reveal="left"] { transform: translate3d(-34px, 0, 0) scale(0.985); }
    [data-reveal="right"] { transform: translate3d(34px, 0, 0) scale(0.985); }
    [data-reveal="zoom"] { transform: scale(0.94); }
    [data-reveal="clip"] {
      clip-path: inset(18% 0 18% 0 round 28px); transform: translate3d(0, 24px, 0);
      transition: opacity 950ms var(--ease-emphatic), transform 950ms var(--ease-emphatic), filter 950ms var(--ease-emphatic), clip-path 950ms var(--ease-emphatic);
    }
    [data-reveal="clip"].is-visible { clip-path: inset(0 0 0 0 round 28px); }

    /* Responsive */
    @media (max-width: 980px) {
      :root { --nav-height: 70px; }
      .nav__links {
        position: fixed; left: 20px; right: 20px; top: calc(var(--nav-height) + 10px);
        display: grid; gap: 8px; padding: 12px; border-radius: 24px;
        background: rgba(9, 9, 15, 0.9); box-shadow: var(--shadow);
        transform: translateY(-10px) scale(0.98); opacity: 0; pointer-events: none;
        transition: opacity 240ms var(--ease), transform 240ms var(--ease);
      }
      .nav__links.is-open { opacity: 1; transform: translateY(0) scale(1); pointer-events: auto; }
      .nav__links a { justify-content: center; }
      .nav__cta { display: none; }
      .mobile-toggle { display: inline-flex; }
      .hero, .section-head, .process, .faq { grid-template-columns: 1fr; }
      .visual { min-height: 520px; }
      .dashboard { left: 5%; right: auto; width: 90%; }
      .feature-grid, .pricing-grid { grid-template-columns: 1fr; }
      .sticky-panel { position: relative; top: auto; }
    }
    @media (max-width: 640px) {
      .section { padding: 86px 0; }
      .section--hero { padding-top: 50px; }
      h1 { font-size: clamp(3rem, 16vw, 4.6rem); }
      .hero__actions, .footer-inner, .footer-links { flex-direction: column; }
      .btn { width: 100%; }
      .visual { min-height: 470px; }
      .dashboard { min-height: 410px; transform: translate3d(0, var(--parallax-y, 0), 0); }
      .metric-grid { grid-template-columns: 1fr; }
      .chart { height: 130px; }
      .card__icon { margin-bottom: 42px; }
      .step { grid-template-columns: 1fr; }
    }

    /* Respect reduced motion */
    @media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce) {
      html { scroll-behavior: auto; }
      *, *::before, *::after {
        animation-duration: 0.001ms !important; animation-iteration-count: 1 !important;
        transition-duration: 0.001ms !important; scroll-behavior: auto !important;
      }
      [data-reveal] { opacity: 1 !important; transform: none !important; filter: none !important; clip-path: none !important; }
      .orb, .dashboard, .floating-card { transform: none !important; }
    }
  </style>
</head>
<body>
  <a class="skip-link" href="#main">Skip to content</a>

  <div class="progress" aria-hidden="true"><div class="progress__bar" id="progressBar"></div></div>

  <header class="site-header" id="siteHeader">
    <div class="container nav">
      <a class="brand" href="#home" aria-label="Velora home">
        <span class="brand__mark" aria-hidden="true"></span>
        <span>Velora</span>
      </a>

        <a href="#pricing">Pricing</a>
        <a href="#faq">FAQ</a>
      </nav>
      <a class="btn btn--ghost nav__cta" href="#pricing">
        Start free
        <svg class="icon-arrow" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" aria-hidden="true"><path d="M5 12h14m-6-6 6 6-6 6" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round"/></svg>
      </a>
      <button class="mobile-toggle" id="mobileToggle" type="button" aria-label="Open menu" aria-controls="navLinks" aria-expanded="false"><span aria-hidden="true"></span></button>
    </div>
  </header>

  <main id="main">
    <!-- HERO -->
    <section class="section section--hero" id="home" data-section>
      <div class="section__bg" aria-hidden="true">
        <span class="orb orb--one" data-parallax="0.16"></span>
        <span class="orb orb--two" data-parallax="-0.11"></span>
        <span class="orb orb--three" data-parallax="0.08"></span>
      </div>
      <div class="container hero">
        <div class="hero__content">
          <div class="eyebrow" data-reveal><span class="eyebrow__dot" aria-hidden="true"></span> New motion system for high-converting pages</div>
          <h1 data-reveal style="--delay: 90ms">Build pages that feel <span class="gradient-text">alive.</span></h1>
          <p class="hero__copy" data-reveal style="--delay: 180ms">Velora blends scroll-triggered reveals, parallax depth, and elegant easing into a single polished landing page — no libraries, no build step.</p>
          <div class="hero__actions" data-reveal style="--delay: 270ms">
            <a class="btn btn--primary" href="#pricing">Launch your page
              <svg class="icon-arrow" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" aria-hidden="true"><path d="M5 12h14m-6-6 6 6-6 6" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round"/></svg>
            </a>
            <a class="btn btn--ghost" href="#features">Explore features</a>
          </div>
          <div class="hero__meta" data-reveal style="--delay: 360ms">
            <span><strong>98%</strong> faster iterations</span>
            <span><strong>42k</strong> animated views</span>
            <span><strong>0</strong> dependencies</span>
          </div>

  <script>
  (() => {
    "use strict";
    const prefersReducedMotion = window.matchMedia("(prefers-reduced-motion: reduce)").matches;
    const header = document.getElementById("siteHeader");
    const progressBar = document.getElementById("progressBar");
    const navLinks = document.getElementById("navLinks");
    const mobileToggle = document.getElementById("mobileToggle");
    const sections = [...document.querySelectorAll("[data-section]")];
    const navAnchors = [...document.querySelectorAll('.nav__links a[href^="#"]')];
    const revealEls = [...document.querySelectorAll("[data-reveal]")];
    const parallaxEls = [...document.querySelectorAll("[data-parallax]")];

    document.getElementById("year").textContent = new Date().getFullYear();
    const clamp = (v, min, max) => Math.min(Math.max(v, min), max);

    /* Sticky header + progress + scroll parallax — batched in rAF */
    function updateHeader() { header.classList.toggle("is-scrolled", window.scrollY > 8); }
    function updateProgress() {
      const top = window.scrollY || document.documentElement.scrollTop;
      const h = document.documentElement.scrollHeight - window.innerHeight;
      progressBar.style.width = `${clamp(h > 0 ? (top / h) * 100 : 0, 0, 100)}%`;
    }
    function updateParallax() {
      if (prefersReducedMotion) return;
      const vh = window.innerHeight;
      parallaxEls.forEach((el) => {
        const speed = parseFloat(el.dataset.parallax || "0");
        const rect = el.getBoundingClientRect();
        if (rect.bottom < -160 || rect.top > vh + 160) return;
        const offset = rect.top + rect.height / 2 - vh / 2;
        el.style.setProperty("--parallax-y", `${(offset * speed * -1).toFixed(2)}px`);
      });
    }
    let ticking = false;
    function onFrame() { updateHeader(); updateProgress(); updateParallax(); ticking = false; }
    function requestTick() { if (!ticking) { requestAnimationFrame(onFrame); ticking = true; } }
    window.addEventListener("scroll", requestTick, { passive: true });
    window.addEventListener("resize", requestTick);
    onFrame();

    /* Scroll-triggered reveals + active nav tracking */
    if ("IntersectionObserver" in window) {
      const revealObserver = new IntersectionObserver((entries, obs) => {
        entries.forEach((e) => {
          if (!e.isIntersecting) return;
          e.target.classList.add("is-visible");
          obs.unobserve(e.target);
        });
      }, { threshold: 0.14, rootMargin: "0px 0px -8% 0px" });
      revealEls.forEach((el) => revealObserver.observe(el));

      const sectionObserver = new IntersectionObserver((entries) => {
        entries.forEach((e) => {
          if (!e.isIntersecting) return;
          const id = e.target.id;
          navAnchors.forEach((a) => a.classList.toggle("is-active", a.getAttribute("href") === `#${id}`));
        });
      }, { threshold: 0.42 });
      sections.forEach((s) => sectionObserver.observe(s));
    } else {
      revealEls.forEach((el) => el.classList.add("is-visible"));
    }

    /* Smooth anchor scroll with sticky-header offset */
    document.addEventListener("click", (ev) => {
      const link = ev.target.closest('a[href^="#"]');
      if (!link) return;
      const id = link.getAttribute("href");
      if (!id || id === "#") return;
      const target = document.querySelector(id);
      if (!target) return;
      ev.preventDefault();
      const top = target.getBoundingClientRect().top + window.scrollY - (header.offsetHeight + 12);
      window.scrollTo({ top, behavior: prefersReducedMotion ? "auto" : "smooth" });
      closeMobileMenu();
    });

    /* Mobile menu */
    function closeMobileMenu() {
      navLinks.classList.remove("is-open");
      mobileToggle.setAttribute("aria-expanded", "false");
      mobileToggle.setAttribute("aria-label", "Open menu");
    }
    mobileToggle.addEventListener("click", () => {
      const open = navLinks.classList.toggle("is-open");
      mobileToggle.setAttribute("aria-expanded", String(open));
      mobileToggle.setAttribute("aria-label", open ? "Close menu" : "Open menu");
    });
    window.addEventListener("keydown", (e) => { if (e.key === "Escape") closeMobileMenu(); });
    window.addEventListener("resize", () => { if (window.innerWidth > 980) closeMobileMenu(); });

    /* Cursor spotlight on buttons + cards */
    [...document.querySelectorAll(".btn, .card")].forEach((t) => {
      t.addEventListener("pointermove", (e) => {
        const r = t.getBoundingClientRect();
        t.style.setProperty("--mx", `${(((e.clientX - r.left) / r.width) * 100).toFixed(2)}%`);
        t.style.setProperty("--my", `${(((e.clientY - r.top) / r.height) * 100).toFixed(2)}%`);
      });
    });

    /* Pointer-driven 3D tilt on the hero dashboard (desktop only) */
    const scene = document.getElementById("tiltScene");
    const card = document.getElementById("tiltCard");
    if (scene && card && !prefersReducedMotion && window.matchMedia("(pointer: fine)").matches) {
      scene.addEventListener("pointermove", (e) => {
        const r = scene.getBoundingClientRect();
        const px = (e.clientX - r.left) / r.width - 0.5;
        const py = (e.clientY - r.top) / r.height - 0.5;
        card.style.setProperty("--rx", `${(-px * 14 - 10).toFixed(2)}deg`);
        card.style.setProperty("--ry", `${(py * 12 + 6).toFixed(2)}deg`);
      });
      scene.addEventListener("pointerleave", () => {
        card.style.setProperty("--rx", "-10deg");
        card.style.setProperty("--ry", "6deg");
      });
    }
  })();
  </script>
</body>
</html>

question: framer-style-animation
prompt: Generate a landing page with smooth Framer-like transitions between sections. In a single-page self-contained HTML.
content:
<!DOCTYPE html>
<html lang="en">
<head>
  <meta charset="UTF-8" />
  <meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1.0" />
  <meta
    name="description"
    content="Flowline helps teams plan, build, and ship work from one beautifully simple workspace."
  />
  <title>Flowline — Turn momentum into progress</title>

  <style>
    :root {
      color-scheme: dark;
      --bg: #07080a;
      --bg-soft: #0d0f12;
      --card: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.055);
      --card-hover: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.08);
      --line: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.1);
      --line-bright: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.18);
      --text: #f4f4f1;
      --muted: #9b9da3;
      --accent: #b8ff5a;
      --accent-2: #7e5cff;
      --accent-3: #57d8ff;
      --radius: 24px;
      --container: 1180px;
      --ease: cubic-bezier(0.16, 1, 0.3, 1);
      --spring: cubic-bezier(0.34, 1.56, 0.64, 1);
    }

    * {
      box-sizing: border-box;
    }

    html {
      scroll-behavior: smooth;
      scroll-padding-top: 100px;
    }

    body {
      margin: 0;
      overflow-x: hidden;
      background:
        radial-gradient(circle at 50% -15%, rgba(126, 92, 255, 0.17), transparent 30%),
        var(--bg);
      color: var(--text);
      font-family:
        Inter, ui-sans-serif, -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, "Segoe UI",
        sans-serif;
      -webkit-font-smoothing: antialiased;
    }

    body::before {
      position: fixed;
      z-index: -3;
      inset: 0;
      content: "";
      pointer-events: none;
      background-image:
        linear-gradient(rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.022) 1px, transparent 1px),
        linear-gradient(90deg, rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.022) 1px, transparent 1px);
      background-size: 64px 64px;
      mask-image: linear-gradient(to bottom, black, transparent 75%);
    }

    ::selection {
      color: #0a0b0d;
      background: var(--accent);
    }

    a {
      color: inherit;
      text-decoration: none;
    }

    button,
    a {
      -webkit-tap-highlight-color: transparent;
    }

    button {
      color: inherit;
      font: inherit;
    }

    .container {
      width: min(calc(100% - 40px), var(--container));
      margin-inline: auto;
    }

    .ambient {
      position: fixed;
      z-index: -2;
      width: 500px;
      height: 500px;
      border-radius: 50%;
      opacity: 0.12;
      pointer-events: none;
      filter: blur(120px);
      transform: translate3d(-50%, -50%, 0);
      transition: left 1.4s var(--ease), top 1.4s var(--ease);
      background: linear-gradient(135deg, var(--accent-2), var(--accent-3));
    }

    /* Navigation */

    .nav-wrap {
      position: fixed;
      z-index: 100;
      top: 18px;
      left: 0;
      width: 100%;
      padding-inline: 20px;
      pointer-events: none;
    }

    .nav {
      display: flex;
      align-items: center;
      justify-content: space-between;
      width: min(100%, 820px);
      min-height: 62px;
      margin: auto;
      padding: 8px 9px 8px 18px;
      border: 1px solid var(--line);
      border-radius: 18px;
      background: rgba(10, 11, 13, 0.68);
      box-shadow: 0 18px 50px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.32);
      backdrop-filter: blur(22px) saturate(140%);
      pointer-events: auto;
      transition:
        width 0.6s var(--ease),
        background 0.4s ease,
        transform 0.4s var(--ease);
    }

    .nav.scrolled {
      width: min(100%, 720px);
      background: rgba(10, 11, 13, 0.86);
    }

    .logo {
      display: inline-flex;
      align-items: center;
      gap: 10px;
      font-weight: 750;
      letter-spacing: -0.04em;
    }

    .logo-mark {
      position: relative;
      width: 28px;
      height: 28px;
      overflow: hidden;
      border-radius: 9px;
      background: var(--accent);
      box-shadow: 0 0 28px rgba(184, 255, 90, 0.24);
    }

    .logo-mark::before,
    .logo-mark::after {
      position: absolute;
      content: "";
      background: #0a0b0d;
    }

    .logo-mark::before {
      inset: 6px 12px 6px 6px;
      border-radius: 8px;
    }

    .logo-mark::after {
      inset: 6px 6px 14px 15px;
      border-radius: 8px;
    }

    .nav-links {
      display: flex;
      align-items: center;
      gap: 7px;
    }

    .nav-links a {
      padding: 10px 13px;
      border-radius: 10px;
      color: var(--muted);
      font-size: 14px;
      transition: color 0.25s ease, background 0.25s ease;
    }

    .nav-links a:hover,
    .nav-links a.active {
      color: var(--text);
      background: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.065);
    }

    .nav-cta {
      display: inline-flex;
      align-items: center;
      gap: 8px;
      padding: 12px 16px;
      border-radius: 12px;
      color: #0b0c0d;
      background: var(--text);
      font-size: 14px;
      font-weight: 700;
      transition: transform 0.35s var(--spring), background 0.25s ease;
    }

    .nav-cta:hover {
      background: var(--accent);
      transform: scale(1.04);
    }

    /* Shared */

    section {
      position: relative;
      padding: 130px 0;
    }

    .eyebrow {
      display: inline-flex;
      align-items: center;
      gap: 9px;
      margin-bottom: 22px;
      color: #c9cacf;
      font-size: 13px;
      font-weight: 680;
      letter-spacing: 0.08em;
      text-transform: uppercase;
    }

    .eyebrow::before {
      width: 7px;
      height: 7px;
      border-radius: 50%;
      content: "";
      background: var(--accent);
      box-shadow: 0 0 16px rgba(184, 255, 90, 0.8);
    }

    .section-heading {
      max-width: 760px;
      margin: 0;
      font-size: clamp(42px, 6vw, 74px);
      font-weight: 570;
      line-height: 0.98;
      letter-spacing: -0.065em;
    }

    .section-heading span {
      color: var(--muted);
    }

    .section-copy {
      max-width: 570px;
      margin: 28px 0 0;
      color: var(--muted);
      font-size: 18px;
      line-height: 1.7;
    }

    .reveal {
      opacity: 0;
      filter: blur(12px);
      transform: translateY(44px) scale(0.98);
      transition:
        opacity 0.9s var(--ease),
        filter 0.9s var(--ease),
        transform 0.9s var(--ease);
      transition-delay: var(--delay, 0ms);
    }

    .reveal.in-view {
      opacity: 1;
      filter: blur(0);
      transform: translateY(0) scale(1);
    }

    /* Hero */

    .hero {
      display: grid;
      place-items: center;
      min-height: 100svh;
      padding-top: 160px;
      text-align: center;
    }

    .hero-content {
      position: relative;
      z-index: 2;
      max-width: 1040px;
      margin: auto;
    }

    .announcement {
      display: inline-flex;
      align-items: center;
      gap: 10px;
      margin-bottom: 30px;
      padding: 7px 12px 7px 8px;
      border: 1px solid var(--line);
      border-radius: 999px;
      color: #c9cacf;
      background: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.035);
      font-size: 13px;
      transition: border-color 0.25s ease, transform 0.35s var(--spring);
    }

    .announcement:hover {
      border-color: var(--line-bright);
      transform: translateY(-2px);
    }

    .announcement b {
      padding: 5px 8px;
      border-radius: 999px;
      color: #10120f;
      background: var(--accent);
      font-size: 10px;
      letter-spacing: 0.08em;
    }

    h1 {
      margin: 0 auto;
      max-width: 970px;
      font-size: clamp(64px, 10vw, 128px);
      font-weight: 540;
      line-height: 0.86;
      letter-spacing: -0.08em;
    }

    h1 .muted {
      color: #777a80;
    }

    h1 .glow {
      color: transparent;
      background: linear-gradient(110deg, #fff 10%, #b8ff5a 48%, #8bdcff 85%);
      background-clip: text;
      -webkit-background-clip: text;
    }

    .hero-copy {
      max-width: 650px;
      margin: 34px auto 0;
      color: var(--muted);
      font-size: clamp(17px, 2vw, 20px);
      line-height: 1.65;
    }

    .hero-actions {
      display: flex;
      justify-content: center;
      gap: 12px;
      margin-top: 36px;
    }

    .button {
      position: relative;
      display: inline-flex;
      align-items: center;
      justify-content: center;
      gap: 10px;
      min-height: 54px;
      padding: 0 22px;
      overflow: hidden;
      border: 1px solid var(--line);
      border-radius: 15px;
      font-size: 15px;
      font-weight: 700;
      transition:
        transform 0.35s var(--spring),
        border-color 0.25s ease,
        background 0.25s ease;
    }

    .button:hover {
      transform: translateY(-3px) scale(1.02);
    }

    .button.primary {
      border-color: var(--accent);
      color: #0a0b0d;
      background: var(--accent);
      box-shadow: 0 12px 40px rgba(184, 255, 90, 0.15);
    }

    .button.primary::after {
      position: absolute;
      top: -30%;
      left: -45%;
      width: 30%;
      height: 160%;
      content: "";
      background: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.52);
      filter: blur(12px);
      transform: skewX(-20deg);
      transition: left 0.75s var(--ease);
    }

    .button.primary:hover::after {
      left: 120%;
    }

    .button.secondary {
      background: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.045);
    }

    .button.secondary:hover {
      border-color: var(--line-bright);
      background: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.075);
    }

    .hero-visual {
      position: relative;
      width: min(100%, 1050px);
      height: 350px;
      margin: 82px auto -90px;
      perspective: 1200px;
    }

    .dashboard {
      position: absolute;
      inset: 0;
      display: grid;
      grid-template-columns: 190px 1fr;
      overflow: hidden;
      border: 1px solid var(--line-bright);
      border-radius: 28px;
      background: rgba(13, 15, 18, 0.76);
      box-shadow:
        0 50px 100px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.48),
        inset 0 1px rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.08);
      backdrop-filter: blur(26px);
      transform: rotateX(8deg);
      transform-origin: center bottom;
      transition: transform 0.8s var(--ease);
    }

    .hero-visual:hover .dashboard {
      transform: rotateX(2deg) translateY(-8px);
    }

    .sidebar {
      padding: 28px 20px;
      border-right: 1px solid var(--line);
      text-align: left;
    }

    .side-title {
      margin-bottom: 26px;
      color: #e6e6e3;
      font-size: 13px;
      font-weight: 700;
    }

    .side-link {
      display: flex;
      align-items: center;
      gap: 10px;
      margin: 5px 0;
      padding: 10px;
      border-radius: 9px;
      color: #777a80;
      font-size: 12px;
    }

    .side-link.active {
      color: #fff;
      background: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.07);
    }

    .side-dot {
      width: 7px;
      height: 7px;
      border: 1px solid currentColor;
      border-radius: 50%;
    }

    .dash-main {
      padding: 28px;
      text-align: left;
    }

    .dash-header {
      display: flex;
      align-items: center;
      justify-content: space-between;
      margin-bottom: 24px;
    }

    .dash-header strong {
      font-size: 17px;
    }

    .avatars {
      display: flex;
    }

    .avatar {
      display: grid;
      place-items: center;
      width: 28px;
      height: 28px;
      margin-left: -7px;
      border: 2px solid #111318;
      border-radius: 50%;
      color: #111;
      background: var(--avatar);
      font-size: 9px;
      font-weight: 800;
    }

    .board {
      display: grid;
      grid-template-columns: repeat(3, 1fr);
      gap: 14px;
    }

    .column {
      min-height: 230px;
      padding: 13px;
      border: 1px solid rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.07);
      border-radius: 14px;
      background: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.025);
    }

    .column-label {
      display: flex;
      align-items: center;
      justify-content: space-between;
      margin-bottom: 12px;
      color: #8e9197;
      font-size: 10px;
      text-transform: uppercase;
    }

    .task {
      margin-bottom: 9px;
      padding: 13px;
      border: 1px solid rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.08);
      border-radius: 11px;
      background: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.055);
      box-shadow: 0 8px 20px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.12);
      transition: transform 0.35s var(--spring), background 0.25s ease;
    }

    .task:hover {
      background: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.09);
      transform: translateY(-3px) rotate(-1deg);
    }

    .task p {
      margin: 0 0 13px;
      color: #d7d8da;
      font-size: 11px;
      line-height: 1.4;
    }

    .tag {
      display: inline-block;
      padding: 4px 7px;
      border-radius: 5px;
      color: var(--tag-color);
      background: color-mix(in srgb, var(--tag-color) 12%, transparent);
      font-size: 8px;
      font-weight: 800;
      letter-spacing: 0.04em;
      text-transform: uppercase;
    }

    .float-card {
      position: absolute;
      z-index: 3;
      display: flex;
      align-items: center;
      gap: 12px;
      padding: 14px 16px;
      border: 1px solid var(--line-bright);
      border-radius: 15px;
      background: rgba(20, 22, 25, 0.88);
      box-shadow: 0 20px 45px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.35);
      backdrop-filter: blur(20px);
      animation: float 5s ease-in-out infinite;
    }

    .float-card.one {
      top: 70px;
      right: -55px;
    }

    .float-card.two {
      bottom: 22px;
      left: -45px;
      animation-delay: -2.5s;
    }

    .float-icon {
      display: grid;
      place-items: center;
      width: 34px;
      height: 34px;
      border-radius: 10px;
      color: #101;
      background: var(--accent);
      font-weight: 900;
    }

    .float-text {
      text-align: left;
    }

    .float-text strong,
    .float-text small {
      display: block;
    }

    .float-text strong {
      font-size: 12px;
    }

    .float-text small {
      margin-top: 3px;
      color: var(--muted);
      font-size: 10px;
    }

    @keyframes float {
      0%, 100% { transform: translateY(0) rotate(0); }
      50% { transform: translateY(-12px) rotate(1deg); }
    }

    /* Trust strip */

    .trust {
      padding: 120px 0 70px;
      overflow: hidden;
    }

    .trust-label {
      margin-bottom: 32px;
      color: #686b70;
      font-size: 12px;
      letter-spacing: 0.12em;
      text-align: center;
      text-transform: uppercase;
    }

    .logo-marquee {
      display: flex;
      width: max-content;
      animation: marquee 28s linear infinite;
    }

    .logo-set {
      display: flex;
      gap: 70px;
      padding-right: 70px;
    }

    .client-logo {
      color: #74777d;
      font-size: 19px;
      font-weight: 750;
      letter-spacing: -0.04em;
      white-space: nowrap;
      transition: color 0.25s ease;
    }

    .client-logo:hover {
      color: #d7d8da;
    }

    @keyframes marquee {
      to { transform: translateX(-50%); }
    }

    /* Features */

    .features {
      padding-top: 120px;
    }

    .feature-intro {
      display: flex;
      align-items: flex-end;
      justify-content: space-between;
      gap: 50px;
      margin-bottom: 70px;
    }

    .bento {
      display: grid;
      grid-template-columns: repeat(12, 1fr);
      gap: 18px;
    }

    .bento-card {
      position: relative;
      min-height: 390px;
      overflow: hidden;
      border: 1px solid var(--line);
      border-radius: var(--radius);
      background: var(--card);
      transition:
        transform 0.6s var(--ease),
        border-color 0.35s ease,
        background 0.35s ease;
    }

    .bento-card::before {
      position: absolute;
      inset: 0;
      content: "";
      opacity: 0;
      pointer-events: none;
      background: radial-gradient(
        450px circle at var(--x, 50%) var(--y, 50%),
        rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.09),
        transparent 42%
      );
      transition: opacity 0.35s ease;
    }

    .bento-card:hover {
      z-index: 2;
      border-color: var(--line-bright);
      background: var(--card-hover);
      transform: translateY(-7px);
    }

    .bento-card:hover::before {
      opacity: 1;
    }

    .bento-card.large {
      grid-column: span 7;
    }

    .bento-card.medium {
      grid-column: span 5;
    }

    .bento-card.third {
      grid-column: span 4;
      min-height: 330px;
    }

    .card-copy {
      position: relative;
      z-index: 2;
      padding: 30px;
    }

    .card-number {
      margin-bottom: 45px;
      color: #6e7076;
      font-family: ui-monospace, SFMono-Regular, Menlo, monospace;
      font-size: 11px;
    }

    .card-copy h3 {
      margin: 0 0 12px;
      font-size: 25px;
      font-weight: 600;
      letter-spacing: -0.04em;
    }

    .card-copy p {
      max-width: 430px;
      margin: 0;
      color: var(--muted);
      font-size: 15px;
      line-height: 1.65;
    }

    .timeline-visual {
      position: absolute;
      right: 28px;
      bottom: 25px;
      left: 28px;
      height: 150px;
      padding: 20px;
      border: 1px solid var(--line);
      border-radius: 17px;
      background: rgba(5, 6, 8, 0.56);
    }

    .timeline-row {
      display: grid;
      grid-template-columns: 90px 1fr;
      align-items: center;
      height: 34px;
      color: #777a80;
      font-size: 9px;
    }

    .timeline-track {
      position: relative;
      height: 7px;
      overflow: hidden;
      border-radius: 99px;
      background: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.055);
    }

    .timeline-fill {
      width: var(--width);
      height: 100%;
      border-radius: inherit;
      background: var(--color);
      transform: scaleX(0);
      transform-origin: left;
      transition: transform 1.3s var(--ease);
    }

    .in-view .timeline-fill {
      transform: scaleX(1);
      transition-delay: calc(200ms + var(--i) * 130ms);
    }

    .pulse-visual {
      position: absolute;
      right: 30px;
      bottom: 10px;
      left: 30px;
      height: 180px;
    }

    .pulse-ring {
      position: absolute;
      top: 50%;
      left: 50%;
      border: 1px solid rgba(184, 255, 90, 0.22);
      border-radius: 50%;
      transform: translate(-50%, -50%);
      animation: pulse 3s ease-out infinite;
    }

    .pulse-ring:nth-child(1) { width: 55px; height: 55px; }
    .pulse-ring:nth-child(2) { width: 100px; height: 100px; animation-delay: -1s; }
    .pulse-ring:nth-child(3) { width: 155px; height: 155px; animation-delay: -2s; }

    .pulse-center {
      position: absolute;
      top: 50%;
      left: 50%;
      display: grid;
      place-items: center;
      width: 46px;
      height: 46px;
      border-radius: 50%;
      color: #111;
      background: var(--accent);
      box-shadow: 0 0 45px rgba(184, 255, 90, 0.35);
      transform: translate(-50%, -50%);
    }

    @keyframes pulse {
      0%, 100% { opacity: 0.25; transform: translate(-50%, -50%) scale(0.9); }
      50% { opacity: 1; transform: translate(-50%, -50%) scale(1.05); }
    }

    .mini-stat {
      position: absolute;
      right: 28px;
      bottom: 28px;
      left: 28px;
    }

    .mini-stat strong {
      display: block;
      font-size: 72px;
      font-weight: 520;
      letter-spacing: -0.07em;
      line-height: 1;
    }

    .mini-stat span {
      display: block;
      margin-top: 12px;
      color: var(--muted);
      font-size: 12px;
    }

    .sparkline {
      width: 100%;
      height: 76px;
      margin-top: 22px;
    }

    .sparkline path {
      fill: none;
      stroke: var(--accent);
      stroke-linecap: round;
      stroke-width: 3;
      stroke-dasharray: 500;
      stroke-dashoffset: 500;
      transition: stroke-dashoffset 1.7s var(--ease);
    }

    .in-view .sparkline path {
      stroke-dashoffset: 0;
    }

    .command-list {
      position: absolute;
      right: 24px;
      bottom: 24px;
      left: 24px;
      display: grid;
      gap: 8px;
    }

    .command-item {
      display: flex;
      align-items: center;
      justify-content: space-between;
      padding: 12px 14px;
      border: 1px solid var(--line);
      border-radius: 11px;
      color: #b8bac0;
      background: rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.22);
      font-size: 11px;
      transform: translateX(-15px);
      opacity: 0;
      transition: transform 0.7s var(--ease), opacity 0.7s var(--ease);

  <script>
    const reduceMotion = window.matchMedia("(prefers-reduced-motion: reduce)").matches;
    const nav = document.querySelector(".nav");
    const ambient = document.querySelector(".ambient");
    const reveals = document.querySelectorAll(".reveal");
    const steps = document.querySelectorAll(".step");
    const navLinks = document.querySelectorAll(".nav-links a");
    const sections = document.querySelectorAll("main section[id]");

    // Framer-like viewport reveals
    const revealObserver = new IntersectionObserver(
      (entries) => {
        entries.forEach((entry) => {
          if (!entry.isIntersecting) return;
          entry.target.classList.add("in-view");

          const counter = entry.target.querySelector("[data-count]");
          if (counter && !counter.dataset.played) {
            counter.dataset.played = "true";
            animateCounter(counter, Number(counter.dataset.count));
          }

          revealObserver.unobserve(entry.target);
        });
      },
      { threshold: 0.16, rootMargin: "0px 0px -6% 0px" }
    );

    reveals.forEach((element) => revealObserver.observe(element));

    // Activate sticky workflow cards near the center of the viewport
    const stepObserver = new IntersectionObserver(
      (entries) => {
        entries.forEach((entry) => {
          entry.target.classList.toggle("is-active", entry.isIntersecting);
        });
      },
      { threshold: 0.62, rootMargin: "-10% 0px -10% 0px" }
    );

    steps.forEach((step) => stepObserver.observe(step));

    // Spotlight follows pointer inside feature cards
    document.querySelectorAll(".spotlight").forEach((card) => {
      card.addEventListener("pointermove", (event) => {
        const rect = card.getBoundingClientRect();
        card.style.setProperty("--x", `${event.clientX - rect.left}px`);
        card.style.setProperty("--y", `${event.clientY - rect.top}px`);
      });
    });

    // Lightweight parallax and compact navigation
    let ticking = false;

    function updateScrollEffects() {
      const scrollY = window.scrollY;
      nav.classList.toggle("scrolled", scrollY > 80);

      if (!reduceMotion) {
        const dashboard = document.querySelector(".dashboard");
        const offset = Math.min(scrollY * 0.075, 42);
        dashboard.style.translate = `0 ${offset}px`;
      }

      let current = "";
      sections.forEach((section) => {
        if (scrollY >= section.offsetTop - 220) current = section.id;
      });

      navLinks.forEach((link) => {
        link.classList.toggle(
          "active",
          link.getAttribute("href") === `#${current}`

      });

      ticking = false;
    }

    window.addEventListener(
      "scroll",
      () => {
        if (!ticking) {
          requestAnimationFrame(updateScrollEffects);
          ticking = true;
        }
      },
      { passive: true }
    );

    // Soft ambient glow follows the pointer
    if (!reduceMotion) {

        ambientY += (event.clientY - ambientY) * 0.22;
        ambient.style.left = `${ambientX}px`;
        ambient.style.top = `${ambientY}px`;
      });

      if (reduceMotion) {
        element.textContent = `${target}%`;
        return;

      const duration = 1300;
      const start = performance.now();

      function frame(now) {
        const progress = Math.min((now - start) / duration, 1);
        const eased = 1 - Math.pow(1 - progress, 4);
        element.textContent = `${Math.round(target * eased)}%`;

        if (progress < 1) requestAnimationFrame(frame);
      }

      requestAnimationFrame(frame);

    const header = document.getElementById("header");
    const progressBar = document.getElementById("progressBar");
    const cursorGlow = document.getElementById("cursorGlow");

    function updateScrollEffects() {
      const scrollTop = window.scrollY;
      const maxScroll = document.documentElement.scrollHeight - window.innerHeight;
      const progress = maxScroll > 0 ? (scrollTop / maxScroll) * 100 : 0;

      progressBar.style.width = progress + "%";
      header.classList.toggle("scrolled", scrollTop > 24);
    }

    window.addEventListener("scroll", updateScrollEffects, { passive: true });
    updateScrollEffects();

    window.addEventListener("pointermove", (event) => {
      cursorGlow.style.left = event.clientX + "px";
      cursorGlow.style.top = event.clientY + "px";
    });

    const observer = new IntersectionObserver(
      (entries) => {
        entries.forEach((entry) => {
          if (entry.isIntersecting) {
            entry.target.classList.add("visible");
            observer.unobserve(entry.target);
          }
        });
      },
      { threshold: 0.14 }
    );

    document.querySelectorAll(".reveal").forEach((element) => observer.observe(element));

    document.querySelectorAll('a[href^="#"]').forEach((link) => {
      link.addEventListener("click", (event) => {
        const target = document.querySelector(link.getAttribute("href"));
        if (!target) return;

        event.preventDefault();
        target.scrollIntoView({
          behavior: "smooth",
          block: "start"
        });
      });
    });
