<script>
(function() {
  // ─── Progress Bar ───
  const progressBar = document.getElementById('progressBar');

  // ─── Navbar scroll effect ───
  const navbar = document.getElementById('navbar');

  // ─── Intersection Observer for reveals ───
  const revealElements = document.querySelectorAll('.reveal');

  const revealObserver = new IntersectionObserver((entries) => {
    entries.forEach(entry => {
      if (entry.isIntersecting) {
        entry.target.classList.add('active');
      }
    });
  }, {
    threshold: 0.1,
    rootMargin: '0px 0px -50px 0px'
  });

  revealElements.forEach(el => revealObserver.observe(el));

  // ─── Stat counter animation ───
  const statNumbers = document.querySelectorAll('.stat-number[data-target]');

  const statObserver = new IntersectionObserver((entries) => {
    entries.forEach(entry => {
      if (entry.isIntersecting) {
        const el = entry.target;
        const target = parseInt(el.dataset.target);
        animateCounter(el, target);
        statObserver.unobserve(el);
      }
    });
  }, { threshold: 0.5 });

  statNumbers.forEach(el => statObserver.observe(el));

  function animateCounter(el, target) {
    const duration = 2000;
    const startTime = performance.now();

    function update(currentTime) {
      const elapsed = currentTime - startTime;
      const progress = Math.min(elapsed / duration, 1);

      // Ease out expo
      const eased = 1 - Math.pow(2, -10 * progress);
      const current = Math.floor(eased * target);

      if (target >= 1000000) {
        el.textContent = (current / 1000000).toFixed(1) + 'M+';
      } else if (target >= 1000) {
        el.textContent = (current / 1000).toFixed(0) + 'K+';
      } else {
        el.textContent = current + '+';
      }

      if (progress < 1) {
        requestAnimationFrame(update);
      } else {
        if (target >= 1000000) {
          el.textContent = (target / 1000000).toFixed(1) + 'M+';
        } else if (target >= 1000) {
          el.textContent = (target / 1000).toFixed(0) + 'K+';
        } else {
          el.textContent = target + '+';
        }
      }
    }

    requestAnimationFrame(update);
  }

  // ─── Process line fill ───
  const processLineFill = document.getElementById('processLineFill');
  const processObserver = new IntersectionObserver((entries) => {
    entries.forEach(entry => {
      if (entry.isIntersecting) {
        processLineFill.classList.add('active');
        processObserver.unobserve(entry.target);
      }
    });
  }, { threshold: 0.3 });

  const processSteps = document.querySelector('.process-steps');
  if (processSteps) processObserver.observe(processSteps);

  // ─── Showcase tabs ───
  const tabBtns = document.querySelectorAll('.tab-btn');
  const showcasePanels = document.querySelectorAll('.showcase-panel');

  tabBtns.forEach(btn => {
    btn.addEventListener('click', () => {
      tabBtns.forEach(b => b.classList.remove('active'));
      showcasePanels.forEach(p => p.classList.remove('active'));
      btn.classList.add('active');
      document.getElementById(btn.dataset.tab).classList.add('active');
    });
  });

  // ─── Hero particles ───
  const heroParticles = document.getElementById('heroParticles');
  for (let i = 0; i < 30; i++) {
    const p = document.createElement('div');
    p.className = 'particle';
    p.style.left = Math.random() * 100 + '%';
    p.style.animationDelay = Math.random() * 8 + 's';
    p.style.animationDuration = (6 + Math.random() * 6) + 's';
    p.style.width = (2 + Math.random() * 3) + 'px';
    p.style.height = p.style.width;
    p.style.background = Math.random() > 0.5 ? '#6366f1' : '#ec4899';
    heroParticles.appendChild(p);
  }

  // ─── Magnetic button effect ───
  const magneticBtns = document.querySelectorAll('.magnetic');

  magneticBtns.forEach(btn => {
    btn.addEventListener('mousemove', (e) => {
      const rect = btn.getBoundingClientRect();
      const x = e.clientX - rect.left - rect.width / 2;
      const y = e.clientY - rect.top - rect.height / 2;
      btn.style.transform = `translate(${x * 0.15}px, ${y * 0.15}px)`;
    });

    btn.addEventListener('mouseleave', () => {
      btn.style.transform = 'translate(0, 0)';
    });
  });

  // ─── Smooth scroll with offset for nav ───
  document.querySelectorAll('a[href^="#"]').forEach(anchor => {
    anchor.addEventListener('click', function(e) {
      e.preventDefault();
      const target = document.querySelector(this.getAttribute('href'));
      if (target) {
        const offset = 0;
        const top = target.getBoundingClientRect().top + window.pageYOffset - offset;
        window.scrollTo({ top, behavior: 'smooth' });
      }
    });
  });

  // ─── Parallax + progress bar on scroll ───
  let ticking = false;

  function onScroll() {
    if (!ticking) {
      requestAnimationFrame(() => {
        const scrollTop = window.pageYOffset;
        const docHeight = document.documentElement.scrollHeight - window.innerHeight;
        const scrollPercent = (scrollTop / docHeight) * 100;

        // Progress bar
        progressBar.style.width = scrollPercent + '%';

        // Navbar
        if (scrollTop > 50) {
          navbar.classList.add('scrolled');
        } else {
          navbar.classList.remove('scrolled');
        }

        // Parallax orbs
        document.querySelectorAll('.bg-orb').forEach((orb, i) => {
          const speed = 0.05 + (i * 0.03);
          orb.style.transform = `translateY(${scrollTop * speed}px)`;
        });

        // Transition glow effects
        document.querySelectorAll('.section-divider').forEach(div => {
          const rect = div.getBoundingClientRect();
          const glow = div.querySelector('.transition-glow');
          if (glow) {
            if (rect.top < window.innerHeight * 0.5 && rect.bottom > window.innerHeight * 0.3) {
              glow.classList.add('active');
            } else {
              glow.classList.remove('active');
            }
          }
        });

        ticking = false;
      });
      ticking = true;
    }
  }

  window.addEventListener('scroll', onScroll, { passive: true });
  onScroll();

  // ─── Add section transition dividers dynamically ───
  const sections = document.querySelectorAll('section');
  sections.forEach((section, i) => {
    if (i > 0 && i < sections.length - 1) {
      // Insert a subtle glow line between sections
      const glowLine = document.createElement('div');
      glowLine.style.cssText = `
        width: 100%;
        height: 1px;
        background: linear-gradient(90deg, transparent, rgba(99,102,241,0.2), rgba(236,72,153,0.15), transparent);
        margin: 0;
        opacity: 0;
        transition: opacity 1s var(--ease-out-expo);
      `;

      const glowObserver = new IntersectionObserver((entries) => {
        entries.forEach(entry => {
          glowLine.style.opacity = entry.isIntersecting ? '1' : '0';
        });
      }, { threshold: 1 });

      glowObserver.observe(glowLine);

      if (section.parentNode) {
        section.parentNode.insertBefore(glowLine, section);
      }
    }
  });

  // ─── Hero typing effect on sub text (subtle) ───
  // Already handled by CSS animation

  // ─── Gallery tilt effect ───
  document.querySelectorAll('.gallery-item').forEach(item => {
    item.addEventListener('mousemove', (e) => {
      const rect = item.getBoundingClientRect();
      const x = e.clientX - rect.left;
      const y = e.clientY - rect.top;
      const centerX = rect.width / 2;
      const centerY = rect.height / 2;
      const rotateX = ((y - centerY) / centerY) * -5;
      const rotateY = ((x - centerX) / centerX) * 5;

      item.style.transform = `perspective(600px) rotateX(${rotateX}deg) rotateY(${rotateY}deg) scale(1.03)`;
    });

    item.addEventListener('mouseleave', () => {
      item.style.transform = 'perspective(600px) rotateX(0) rotateY(0) scale(1)';
    });
  });

  // ─── Feature card glow on hover ───
  document.querySelectorAll('.feature-card').forEach(card => {
    card.addEventListener('mousemove', (e) => {
      const rect = card.getBoundingClientRect();
      const x = e.clientX - rect.left;
      const y = e.clientY - rect.top;
      card.style.background = `radial-gradient(circle at ${x}px ${y}px, rgba(99,102,241,0.06), rgba(255,255,255,0.02) 70%)`;
    });

    card.addEventListener('mouseleave', () => {
      card.style.background = 'rgba(255,255,255,0.02)';
    });
  });

  // ─── Smooth section entrance with scale ───
  const sections2 = document.querySelectorAll('section');
  const sectionObserver = new IntersectionObserver((entries) => {
    entries.forEach(entry => {
      if (entry.isIntersecting) {
        entry.target.style.transition = 'opacity 0.6s var(--ease-out-expo), transform 0.8s var(--ease-out-expo)';
      }
    });
  }, { threshold: 0.15 });

  sections2.forEach(s => sectionObserver.observe(s));

  console.log('🎬 Motion landing page loaded successfully');
})();
</script>

    box-shadow: 0 12px 40px rgba(124,92,252,0.5);
  }

  .btn-secondary {
    background: var(--glass);
    border: 1px solid var(--glass-border);
    color: #fff;
    backdrop-filter: blur(20px);
  }
  .btn-secondary:hover {
    transform: translateY(-3px) scale(1.02);
    background: rgba(255,255,255,0.1);
    border-color: rgba(255,255,255,0.15);
    box-shadow: 0 12px 40px rgba(0,0,0,0.3);
  }

  .btn svg { width: 18px; height: 18px; }

  /* Floating elements */
  .float-card {
    position: absolute;
    padding: 16px 20px;
    background: rgba(255,255,255,0.03);
    border: 1px solid rgba(255,255,255,0.06);
    border-radius: 16px;
    backdrop-filter: blur(30px);
    font-size: 13px;
    color: rgba(255,255,255,0.7);
    z-index: 3;
    animation: floatCard 6s ease-in-out infinite;
  }
  .float-card-1 { top: 20%; left: 5%; animation-delay: 0s; }
  .float-card-2 { top: 25%; right: 5%; animation-delay: 2s; }
  .float-card-3 { bottom: 20%; left: 8%; animation-delay: 4s; }

  @keyframes floatCard {
    0%, 100% { transform: translateY(0) rotate(0deg); }
    50% { transform: translateY(-15px) rotate(1deg); }
  }

  .float-card-icon {
    width: 32px; height: 32px;
    border-radius: 8px;
    display: flex;
    align-items: center;
    justify-content: center;
    margin-bottom: 8px;
    font-size: 16px;
  }

  /* Scroll indicator */
  .scroll-indicator {
    position: absolute;
    bottom: 40px;
    left: 50%;
    transform: translateX(-50%);
    display: flex;
    flex-direction: column;
    align-items: center;
    gap: 8px;
    opacity: 0;
    animation: fadeIn 1s ease 1.5s forwards;
    z-index: 5;
  }
  .scroll-indicator span {
    font-size: 11px;
    text-transform: uppercase;
    letter-spacing: 3px;
    color: rgba(255,255,255,0.3);
  }
  .scroll-line {
    width: 1px;
    height: 40px;
    background: rgba(255,255,255,0.1);
    position: relative;
    overflow: hidden;
  }
  .scroll-line::after {
    content: '';
    position: absolute;
    top: -40px;
    left: 0;
    width: 100%;
    height: 40px;
    background: var(--accent);
    animation: scrollLine 2s ease-in-out infinite;
  }
  @keyframes scrollLine {
    0% { top: -40px; }
    100% { top: 40px; }
  }

  /* Section styles */
  section {
    position: relative;
    padding: 140px 48px;
    overflow: hidden;
  }

  .section-header {
    text-align: center;
    max-width: 700px;
    margin: 0 auto 80px;
  }

  .section-tag {
    display: inline-flex;
    align-items: center;
    gap: 8px;
    padding: 6px 16px;
    background: rgba(124,92,252,0.1);
    border: 1px solid rgba(124,92,252,0.2);
    border-radius: 100px;
    font-size: 13px;
    font-weight: 600;
    color: var(--accent);
    text-transform: uppercase;
    letter-spacing: 1.5px;
    margin-bottom: 24px;
  }

  .section-title {
    font-size: clamp(38px, 5.5vw, 64px);
    font-weight: 800;
    letter-spacing: -2px;
    line-height: 1.08;
    margin-bottom: 20px;
  }

  .section-desc {
    font-size: 18px;
    color: rgba(255,255,255,0.5);
    line-height: 1.7;
    font-weight: 400;
  }

  /* Scroll reveal animations */
  .reveal {
    opacity: 0;
    transform: translateY(60px);
    transition: all 1s cubic-bezier(0.16, 1, 0.3, 1);
    will-change: transform, opacity;
  }
  .reveal.active {
    opacity: 1;
    transform: translateY(0);
  }
  .reveal-scale {
    opacity: 0;
    transform: scale(0.92) translateY(40px);
    transition: all 1s cubic-bezier(0.16, 1, 0.3, 1);
    will-change: transform, opacity;
  }
  .reveal-scale.active {
    opacity: 1;
    transform: scale(1) translateY(0);
  }
  .reveal-left {
    opacity: 0;
    transform: translateX(-60px);
    transition: all 1s cubic-bezier(0.16, 1, 0.3, 1);
    will-change: transform, opacity;
  }
  .reveal-left.active {
    opacity: 1;
    transform: translateX(0);
  }
  .reveal-right {
    opacity: 0;
    transform: translateX(60px);
    transition: all 1s cubic-bezier(0.16, 1, 0.3, 1);
    will-change: transform, opacity;
  }
  .reveal-right.active {
    opacity: 1;
    transform: translateX(0);
  }
  .reveal-blur {
    opacity: 0;
    filter: blur(20px);
    transform: translateY(30px);
    transition: all 1.2s cubic-bezier(0.16, 1, 0.3, 1);
    will-change: transform, opacity, filter;
  }
  .reveal-blur.active {
    opacity: 1;
    filter: blur(0);
    transform: translateY(0);
  }

  /* Stagger children */
  .stagger-children > * {
    opacity: 0;
    transform: translateY(40px);
    transition: all 0.8s cubic-bezier(0.16, 1, 0.3, 1);
    will-change: transform, opacity;
  }
  .stagger-children.active > *:nth-child(1) { transition-delay: 0s; }
  .stagger-children.active > *:nth-child(2) { transition-delay: 0.1s; }
  .stagger-children.active > *:nth-child(3) { transition-delay: 0.2s; }
  .stagger-children.active > *:nth-child(4) { transition-delay: 0.3s; }
  .stagger-children.active > *:nth-child(5) { transition-delay: 0.4s; }
  .stagger-children.active > *:nth-child(6) { transition-delay: 0.5s; }
  .stagger-children.active > * {
    opacity: 1;
    transform: translateY(0);
  }

  /* Features section */
  .features-grid {
    display: grid;
    grid-template-columns: repeat(3, 1fr);
    gap: 24px;
    max-width: 1200px;
    margin: 0 auto;
  }

  .feature-card {
    padding: 40px 32px;
    background: var(--glass);
    border: 1px solid var(--glass-border);

    overflow: hidden;

  .feature-card::before {

  }
  .feature-card:hover {

  .feature-card:hover::before {

  .feature-icon {

  .feature-icon.blue { background: rgba(0,212,255,0.15); }
  .feature-icon.pink { background: rgba(255,107,107,0.15); }
  .feature-icon.green { background: rgba(34,197,94,0.15); }
  .feature-icon.orange { background: rgba(251,191,36,0.15); }
  .feature-icon.cyan { background: rgba(0,222,222,0.15); }

  .feature-card h3 {
    font-size: 20px;
    font-weight: 700;
    margin-bottom: 12px;
    letter-spacing: -0.5px;
    position: relative;
    z-index: 1;
  }
  .feature-card p {
    font-size: 15px;
    color: rgba(255,255,255,0.5);
    line-height: 1.7;
    position: relative;
    z-index: 1;
  }

  /* Showcase section */
  .showcase {
    padding: 140px 0;
    overflow: hidden;
  }
  .showcase .section-header {
    padding: 0 48px;
  }

  .showcase-marquee {
    display: flex;
    gap: 24px;
    width: max-content;
    animation: marquee 40s linear infinite;
    padding: 20px 0;
  }
  .showcase-marquee:hover {
    animation-play-state: paused;
  }
  @keyframes marquee {
    0% { transform: translateX(0); }
    100% { transform: translateX(-50%); }
  }

  .showcase-card {
    width: 420px;
    height: 300px;
    border-radius: 20px;
    overflow: hidden;
    position: relative;
    flex-shrink: 0;
    border: 1px solid rgba(255,255,255,0.06);

  .showcase-card-bg {

  .showcase-card:hover .showcase-card-bg {
    transform: scale(1.1);
  }

  .showcase-card-content {
    position: absolute;
    bottom: 0;
    left: 0;
    right: 0;
    padding: 30px;
    background: linear-gradient(transparent, rgba(0,0,0,0.8));
    transform: translateY(20px);
    opacity: 0;
    transition: all 0.4s cubic-bezier(0.16, 1, 0.3, 1);
  }
  .showcase-card:hover .showcase-card-content {
    transform: translateY(0);
    opacity: 1;
  }
  .showcase-card-content h4 {
    font-size: 18px;
    font-weight: 700;
    margin-bottom: 4px;
  }
  .showcase-card-content p {
    font-size: 13px;
    color: rgba(255,255,255,0.7);
  }

  /* Stats */
  .stats-section {
    padding: 100px 48px;
  }
  .stats-grid {
    display: grid;
    grid-template-columns: repeat(4, 1fr);
    gap: 2px;
    max-width: 1100px;
    margin: 0 auto;
    background: var(--glass-border);
    border-radius: 24px;
    overflow: hidden;
    border: 1px solid var(--glass-border);
  }
  .stat-item {
    padding: 48px 32px;
    text-align: center;
    background: var(--bg);
    transition: all 0.4s cubic-bezier(0.16, 1, 0.3, 1);
  }
  .stat-item:hover {
    background: rgba(124,92,252,0.05);
  }
  .stat-number {
    font-size: 52px;
    font-weight: 800;
    letter-spacing: -2px;
    background: linear-gradient(135deg, var(--accent), var(--accent2));
    -webkit-background-clip: text;
    -webkit-text-fill-color: transparent;
    margin-bottom: 8px;
  }
  .stat-label {
    font-size: 14px;
    color: rgba(255,255,255,0.5);
    font-weight: 500;
  }

  /* Testimonials */
  .testimonials-grid {
    display: grid;
    grid-template-columns: repeat(3, 1fr);
    gap: 24px;
    max-width: 1200px;
    margin: 0 auto;
  }

  .testimonial-card {
    padding: 36px;
    background: var(--glass);
    border: 1px solid var(--glass-border);
    border-radius: 24px;
    transition: all 0.5s cubic-bezier(0.16, 1, 0.3, 1);
  }
  .testimonial-card:hover {
    transform: translateY(-6px);
    border-color: rgba(124,92,252,0.2);
  }

  .testimonial-stars {
    display: flex;
    gap: 4px;
    margin-bottom: 20px;
    color: #fbbf24;
    font-size: 16px;
  }

  .testimonial-text {
    font-size: 16px;
    line-height: 1.8;
    color: rgba(255,255,255,0.7);
    margin-bottom: 24px;
    font-style: italic;
  }

  .testimonial-author {
    display: flex;
    align-items: center;
    gap: 14px;
  }
  .testimonial-avatar {
    width: 44px; height: 44px;
    border-radius: 50%;
    display: flex;
    align-items: center;
    justify-content: center;
    font-size: 18px;
    font-weight: 700;
  }
  .testimonial-name {
    font-size: 15px;
    font-weight: 600;
  }
  .testimonial-role {
    font-size: 13px;
    color: rgba(255,255,255,0.4);
  }

  /* Pricing */
  .pricing-grid {
    display: grid;
    grid-template-columns: repeat(3, 1fr);
    gap: 24px;
    max-width: 1100px;
    margin: 0 auto;
    align-items: start;
  }

  .pricing-card {
    padding: 48px 36px;
    background: var(--glass);
    border: 1px solid var(--glass-border);
    border-radius: 28px;
    position: relative;
    transition: all 0.5s cubic-bezier(0.16, 1, 0.3, 1);
  }
  .pricing-card:hover {
    transform: translateY(-8px);
    box-shadow: 0 30px 80px rgba(0,0,0,0.3);
  }
  .pricing-card.featured {
    background: linear-gradient(135deg, rgba(124,92,252,0.15), rgba(0,212,255,0.08));
    border-color: rgba(124,92,252,0.3);
    transform: scale(1.05);
  }
  .pricing-card.featured:hover {
    transform: scale(1.05) translateY(-8px);
    box-shadow: 0 30px 80px rgba(124,92,252,0.2);
  }

  .pricing-badge {
    position: absolute;
    top: -12px;
    left: 50%;
    transform: translateX(-50%);
    padding: 6px 20px;
    background: linear-gradient(135deg, var(--accent), var(--accent2));
    border-radius: 100px;
    font-size: 12px;
    font-weight: 700;
    text-transform: uppercase;
    letter-spacing: 1px;
  }

  .pricing-plan {
    font-size: 14px;
    font-weight: 600;
    text-transform: uppercase;
    letter-spacing: 1.5px;
    color: rgba(255,255,255,0.5);
    margin-bottom: 12px;
  }
  .pricing-price {
    font-size: 56px;
    font-weight: 800;
    letter-spacing: -3px;
    margin-bottom: 8px;
  }
  .pricing-price span {
    font-size: 18px;
    font-weight: 500;
    letter-spacing: 0;
    color: rgba(255,255,255,0.4);
  }
  .pricing-desc {
    font-size: 15px;
    color: rgba(255,255,255,0.5);
    margin-bottom: 32px;
    line-height: 1.6;
  }
  .pricing-features {
    list-style: none;
    margin-bottom: 36px;
  }
  .pricing-features li {
    padding: 10px 0;
    font-size: 15px;
    color: rgba(255,255,255,0.7);
    display: flex;
    align-items: center;
    gap: 12px;

  .pricing-features li svg {
    width: 18px; height: 18px;

  }

  .pricing-btn {

  .pricing-btn-secondary {
    background: rgba(255,255,255,0.06);
    color: #fff;
    border: 1px solid rgba(255,255,255,0.1);
  }
  .pricing-btn-secondary:hover {
    background: rgba(255,255,255,0.1);
    transform: translateY(-2px);
  }

  /* CTA Section */
  .cta-section {
    padding: 160px 48px;
    text-align: center;
    position: relative;
  }
  .cta-bg {
    position: absolute;
    inset: 0;
    overflow: hidden;
    z-index: 0;
  }
  .cta-bg::before {
    content: '';

    left: 50%;
    transform: translate(-50%, -50%);

  .cta-content {
    position: relative;
    z-index: 1;
    max-width: 700px;
    margin: 0 auto;

  .cta-section h2 {

    line-height: 1.05;
    margin-bottom: 24px;
  }
  .cta-section p {
    font-size: 19px;
    color: rgba(255,255,255,0.5);

    margin-bottom: 48px;
  }

  .cta-buttons {
    display: flex;
    gap: 16px;
    justify-content: center;
    flex-wrap: wrap;
  }

  footer {

  .footer-grid {

    max-width: 280px;
    margin-bottom: 24px;
  }

  .footer-socials {
    display: flex;
    gap: 12px;

  .footer-social-icon {

    border-radius: 10px;
    background: rgba(255,255,255,0.05);

  .footer-col h4 {

  .footer-col li {
    margin-bottom: 12px;

  .footer-col a {

  .footer-col a:hover {

  /* Noise overlay */
  .noise {

    z-index: 9999;
    pointer-events: none;
    opacity: 0.035;
    background-image: url("data:image/svg+xml,%3Csvg viewBox='0 0 256 256' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'%3E%3Cfilter id='noise'%3E%3CfeTurbulence type='fractalNoise' baseFrequency='0.9' numOctaves='4' stitchTiles='stitch'/%3E%3C/filter%3E%3Crect width='100%25' height='100%25' filter='url(%23noise)'/%3E%3C/svg%3E");
    background-repeat: repeat;
    background-size: 128px;
  }

  /* Progress bar */
  .progress-bar {
    position: fixed;
    top: 0;
    left: 0;
    height: 2px;

    transition: width 0.1s;
  }

  /* Responsive */
  @media (max-width: 1024px) {
    .features-grid,
    .testimonials-grid,
    .pricing-grid {
      grid-template-columns: repeat(2, 1fr);

      grid-template-columns: repeat(2, 1fr);

    .footer-grid {
      grid-template-columns: 1fr 1fr;

  @media (max-width: 768px) {

  .magnetic {

  /* Counter animation */
  .counter {
    display: inline-block;
    overflow: hidden;
    position: relative;

  /* Glow line divider */
  .glow-divider {
    width: 200px;
    height: 1px;
    background: linear-gradient(90deg, transparent, rgba(124,92,252,0.5), transparent);
    margin: 0 auto;
  }
</style>

<!-- Noise overlay -->
<div class="noise"></div>

<script>
  // Custom cursor
  const cursorDot = document.getElementById('cursorDot');
  const cursorRing = document.getElementById('cursorRing');
  let mouseX = 0, mouseY = 0;
  let ringX = 0, ringY = 0;

  document.addEventListener('mousemove', (e) => {
    mouseX = e.clientX;
    mouseY = e.clientY;
    cursorDot.style.left = mouseX + 'px';
    cursorDot.style.top = mouseY + 'px';
  });

  function animateCursorRing() {
    ringX += (mouseX - ringX) * 0.15;
    ringY += (mouseY - ringY) * 0.15;
    cursorRing.style.left = ringX + 'px';
    cursorRing.style.top = ringY + 'px';
    requestAnimationFrame(animateCursorRing);
  }
  animateCursorRing();

  // Hover effects for cursor
  const hoverElements = document.querySelectorAll('a, button, .btn, .feature-card, .showcase-card, .pricing-card, .testimonial-card, .footer-social-icon');
  hoverElements.forEach(el => {
    el.addEventListener('mouseenter', () => cursorRing.classList.add('hover'));
    el.addEventListener('mouseleave', () => cursorRing.classList.remove('hover'));
  });

  // Scroll progress bar
  const progressBar = document.getElementById('progressBar');
  window.addEventListener('scroll', () => {
    const scrollTop = window.scrollY;
    const docHeight = document.documentElement.scrollHeight - window.innerHeight;
    const scrollPercent = (scrollTop / docHeight) * 100;
    progressBar.style.width = scrollPercent + '%';
  });

  // Navbar scroll effect
  const navbar = document.getElementById('navbar');
  let lastScroll = 0;
  window.addEventListener('scroll', () => {
    const scrollTop = window.scrollY;
    if (scrollTop > 80) {
      navbar.classList.add('scrolled');
    } else {
      navbar.classList.remove('scrolled');
    }
    lastScroll = scrollTop;
  });

  // Intersection Observer for scroll animations
  const observerOptions = {
    threshold: 0.1,
    rootMargin: '0px 0px -60px 0px'
  };

  const observer = new IntersectionObserver((entries) => {
    entries.forEach(entry => {
      if (entry.isIntersecting) {
        entry.target.classList.add('active');

        // Counter animation
        const counters = entry.target.querySelectorAll('.counter');
        counters.forEach(counter => {
          if (!counter.dataset.animated) {
            counter.dataset.animated = 'true';
            animateCounter(counter);
          }
        });

        // Unobserve after animation to prevent re-triggering
        // observer.unobserve(entry.target);
      }
    });
  }, observerOptions);

  // Observe all animated elements
  const animatedElements = document.querySelectorAll('.reveal, .reveal-scale, .reveal-left, .reveal-right, .reveal-blur, .stagger-children');
  animatedElements.forEach(el => observer.observe(el));

  // Counter animation
  function animateCounter(el) {
    const target = parseInt(el.dataset.target);
    const duration = 2000;
    const startTime = performance.now();

    function update(currentTime) {
      const elapsed = currentTime - startTime;
      const progress = Math.min(elapsed / duration, 1);
      // Ease out cubic
      const eased = 1 - Math.pow(1 - progress, 3);
      el.textContent = Math.round(target * eased);

      if (progress < 1) {
        requestAnimationFrame(update);
      }
    }
    requestAnimationFrame(update);
  }

  // Magnetic effect for buttons
  const magneticElements = document.querySelectorAll('.magnetic');
  magneticElements.forEach(el => {
    el.addEventListener('mousemove', (e) => {
      const rect = el.getBoundingClientRect();
      const x = e.clientX - rect.left - rect.width / 2;
      const y = e.clientY - rect.top - rect.height / 2;
      el.style.transform = `translate(${x * 0.15}px, ${y * 0.15}px)`;
    });
    el.addEventListener('mouseleave', () => {
      el.style.transform = 'translate(0, 0)';
    });
  });

  // Smooth scroll for anchor links
  document.querySelectorAll('a[href^="#"]').forEach(anchor => {
    anchor.addEventListener('click', function (e) {
      e.preventDefault();
      const target = document.querySelector(this.getAttribute('href'));
      if (target) {
        const offset = 80;
        const targetPosition = target.getBoundingClientRect().top + window.scrollY - offset;
        window.scrollTo({
          top: targetPosition,
          behavior: 'smooth'
        });
      }
    });
  });

  // Parallax effect for hero floating cards
  window.addEventListener('scroll', () => {
    const scrollY = window.scrollY;
    const floatCards = document.querySelectorAll('.float-card');
    floatCards.forEach((card, i) => {
      const speed = 0.1 + (i * 0.05);
      card.style.transform = `translateY(${scrollY * -speed}px)`;
    });
  });

  // Feature cards tilt effect
  const featureCards = document.querySelectorAll('.feature-card');
  featureCards.forEach(card => {
    card.addEventListener('mousemove', (e) => {
      const rect = card.getBoundingClientRect();
      const x = e.clientX - rect.left;
      const y = e.clientY - rect.top;
      const centerX = rect.width / 2;
      const centerY = rect.height / 2;
      const rotateX = (y - centerY) / 20;
      const rotateY = (centerX - x) / 20;

      card.style.transform = `perspective(1000px) rotateX(${rotateX}deg) rotateY(${rotateY}deg) translateY(-8px)`;
    });
    card.addEventListener('mouseleave', () => {
      card.style.transform = 'perspective(1000px) rotateX(0deg) rotateY(0deg) translateY(0px)';
    });
  });

  // Pricing cards hover glow
  const pricingCards = document.querySelectorAll('.pricing-card');
  pricingCards.forEach(card => {
    card.addEventListener('mousemove', (e) => {
      const rect = card.getBoundingClientRect();
      const x = e.clientX - rect.left;
      const y = e.clientY - rect.top;
      card.style.setProperty('--glow-x', x + 'px');
      card.style.setProperty('--glow-y', y + 'px');
      card.style.background = `radial-gradient(600px circle at ${x}px ${y}px, rgba(124,92,252,0.06), transparent 60%), var(--glass)`;
    });
    card.addEventListener('mouseleave', () => {
      card.style.background = 'var(--glass)';
    });
  });

  // Page load animation
  window.addEventListener('load', () => {
    document.body.style.opacity = '1';
  });

  // Initial state
  document.body.style.opacity = '0';
  document.body.style.transition = 'opacity 0.5s ease';

  // Trigger initial reveals for elements already in viewport
  setTimeout(() => {
    animatedElements.forEach(el => {
      const rect = el.getBoundingClientRect();
      if (rect.top < window.innerHeight && rect.bottom > 0) {
        el.classList.add('active');
        const counters = el.querySelectorAll('.counter');
        counters.forEach(counter => {
          if (!counter.dataset.animated) {
            counter.dataset.animated = 'true';
            animateCounter(counter);
          }
        });
      }
    });
  }, 100);
</script>

</body>
</html>

<!DOCTYPE html>

  @import url('https://fonts.googleapis.com/css2?family=Inter:wght@300;400;500;600;700;800;900&display=swap');

  *, *::before, *::after {
    margin: 0;
    padding: 0;
    box-sizing: border-box;
  }

  :root {

    right: 0;

    background-clip: text;

  .nav-links {
    display: flex;

  .nav-links a {

    text-decoration: none;
    font-size: 0.9rem;
    font-weight: 500;
    transition: color 0.3s ease;
    position: relative;
  }

  .nav-links a::after {
    content: '';
    position: absolute;
    bottom: -4px;
    left: 0;
    width: 0;
    height: 2px;

    transition: width 0.3s var(--transition-smooth);

  }

  .nav-links a:hover { color: var(--text-primary); }
  .nav-links a:hover::after { width: 100%; }

  .nav-cta {
    padding: 10px 24px;
    background: var(--gradient-1);
    border: none;
    border-radius: 50px;
    color: white;
    font-weight: 600;
    font-size: 0.9rem;
    cursor: pointer;
    transition: transform 0.3s var(--transition-bounce), box-shadow 0.3s ease;
  }

  .nav-cta:hover {
    transform: scale(1.05);

  /* ===== HERO SECTION ===== */
  .hero {
    min-height: 100vh;
    display: flex;
    flex-direction: column;
    justify-content: center;
    align-items: center;
    text-align: center;
    padding: 120px 40px 80px;
    position: relative;
    overflow: hidden;
  }

  .hero-bg-orb {

    border-radius: 50%;
    filter: blur(120px);
    opacity: 0.3;
    animation: orbFloat 20s ease-in-out infinite;
  }

  .hero-bg-orb:nth-child(1) {

    height: 600px;
    background: #6c5ce7;
    top: -200px;

  .hero-bg-orb:nth-child(2) {

    height: 400px;
    background: #fd79a8;
    bottom: -100px;
    left: -100px;

  .hero-bg-orb:nth-child(3) {
    width: 300px;
    height: 300px;
    background: #00cec9;
    top: 50%;
    left: 50%;
    transform: translate(-50%, -50%);
    animation-delay: -14s;
  }

  @keyframes orbFloat {
    0%, 100% { transform: translate(0, 0) scale(1); }
    25% { transform: translate(30px, -40px) scale(1.1); }
    50% { transform: translate(-20px, 20px) scale(0.95); }
    75% { transform: translate(40px, 30px) scale(1.05); }
  }

  .hero-badge {
    display: inline-flex;
    align-items: center;

    padding: 8px 20px;

    border: 1px solid var(--glass-border);
    border-radius: 50px;

  .hero-badge-dot {

  @keyframes pulse {

  .hero h1 {
    font-size: clamp(3rem, 8vw, 7rem);
    font-weight: 900;

    transform: translateY(40px);

  }

  .hero h1 .gradient-text {

  .hero p {

  .btn-primary {

  .hero-scroll-indicator {

  @keyframes scrollDown {

  }

  @keyframes fadeUp {

  /* ===== SECTION COMMON ===== */
  section {

  .section-label {

  .reveal {

  .stagger-1 { transition-delay: 0.1s; }

  .stagger-3 { transition-delay: 0.3s; }
  .stagger-4 { transition-delay: 0.4s; }

  /* ===== FEATURES SECTION ===== */
  .features {

  .features-header {

  .features-grid {

  .feature-card::before {

  .feature-card:hover {

  .feature-icon {

    margin-bottom: 24px;
    position: relative;
  }

  .feature-icon.icon-1 { background: linear-gradient(135deg, rgba(108,92,231,0.2), rgba(108,92,231,0.05)); }
  .feature-icon.icon-2 { background: linear-gradient(135deg, rgba(253,121,168,0.2), rgba(253,121,168,0.05)); }
  .feature-icon.icon-3 { background: linear-gradient(135deg, rgba(0,206,201,0.2), rgba(0,206,201,0.05)); }
  .feature-icon.icon-4 { background: linear-gradient(135deg, rgba(255,234,167,0.2), rgba(255,234,167,0.05)); }
  .feature-icon.icon-5 { background: linear-gradient(135deg, rgba(85,239,196,0.2), rgba(85,239,196,0.05)); }
  .feature-icon.icon-6 { background: linear-gradient(135deg, rgba(162,155,254,0.2), rgba(162,155,254,0.05)); }

  .feature-card h3 {

    letter-spacing: -0.5px;
  }

  .feature-card p {
    color: var(--text-secondary);

  }

  /* ===== SHOWCASE SECTION ===== */
  .showcase {
    overflow: hidden;
  }

  .showcase-container {
    max-width: 1200px;
    margin: 0 auto;
    display: grid;
    grid-template-columns: 1fr 1fr;
    gap: 80px;
    align-items: center;

  .showcase-visual {

  .showcase-screen {
    position: absolute;

  .screen-bar {
    display: flex;
    gap: 8px;

  .screen-dot {
    width: 12px;

    border-radius: 50%;

  .screen-dot:nth-child(1) { background: #ff5f57; }
  .screen-dot:nth-child(2) { background: #ffbd2e; }
  .screen-dot:nth-child(3) { background: #28ca41; }

  .screen-content {
    flex: 1;
    padding: 24px;

  .screen-line {

  }

  .floating-element {
    position: absolute;
    background: var(--glass);
    backdrop-filter: blur(20px);
    border: 1px solid var(--glass-border);
    border-radius: 16px;

    animation: float 6s ease-in-out infinite;
  }

  .floating-element.el-1 {

  // ===== NAVBAR SCROLL EFFECT =====
  const navbar = document.getElementById('navbar');
  let lastScroll = 0;

  window.addEventListener('scroll', () => {
    const currentScroll = window.pageYOffset;
    if (currentScroll > 50) {
      navbar.classList.add('scrolled');
    } else {
      navbar.classList.remove('scrolled');
    }
    lastScroll = currentScroll;
  });

  // ===== INTERSECTION OBSERVER FOR REVEAL ANIMATIONS =====
  const observerOptions = {
    threshold: 0.1,
    rootMargin: '0px 0px -50px 0px'
  };

  const observer = new IntersectionObserver((entries) => {
    entries.forEach(entry => {
      if (entry.isIntersecting) {
        entry.target.classList.add('active');
      }
    });
  }, observerOptions);

  document.querySelectorAll('.reveal, .reveal-left, .reveal-right, .reveal-scale').forEach(el => {
    observer.observe(el);
  });

  // ===== COUNTER ANIMATION =====
  const counterObserver = new IntersectionObserver((entries) => {
    entries.forEach(entry => {
      if (entry.isIntersecting) {
        const el = entry.target;
        const target = parseFloat(el.dataset.target);
        const suffix = el.dataset.suffix || '';
        const duration = 2000;
        const startTime = performance.now();
        const isDecimal = target % 1 !== 0;

        function updateCounter(currentTime) {
          const elapsed = currentTime - startTime;
          const progress = Math.min(elapsed / duration, 1);
          const eased = 1 - Math.pow(1 - progress, 4); // easeOutQuart
          const current = eased * target;

          if (isDecimal) {
            el.textContent = current.toFixed(1) + suffix;
          } else {
            el.textContent = Math.floor(current).toLocaleString() + suffix;
          }

          if (progress < 1) {
            requestAnimationFrame(updateCounter);
          }
        }

        requestAnimationFrame(updateCounter);
        counterObserver.unobserve(el);
      }
    });
  }, { threshold: 0.5 });

  document.querySelectorAll('.stat-number[data-target]').forEach(el => {
    counterObserver.observe(el);
  });

  // ===== CARD MOUSE TRACKING =====
  document.querySelectorAll('.feature-card').forEach(card => {
    card.addEventListener('mousemove', (e) => {
      const rect = card.getBoundingClientRect();
      const x = ((e.clientX - rect.left) / rect.width) * 100;
      const y = ((e.clientY - rect.top) / rect.height) * 100;
      card.style.setProperty('--mouse-x', x + '%');
      card.style.setProperty('--mouse-y', y + '%');
    });
  });

  // ===== PARALLAX ON HERO ORBS =====
  window.addEventListener('scroll', () => {
    const scrolled = window.pageYOffset;
    const orbs = document.querySelectorAll('.hero-bg-orb');
    orbs.forEach((orb, i) => {
      const speed = (i + 1) * 0.15;
      orb.style.transform = `translateY(${scrolled * speed}px)`;
    });
  });

  // ===== SMOOTH ANCHOR SCROLLING =====
  document.querySelectorAll('a[href^="#"]').forEach(anchor => {
    anchor.addEventListener('click', function(e) {
      e.preventDefault();
      const target = document.querySelector(this.getAttribute('href'));
      if (target) {
        target.scrollIntoView({ behavior: 'smooth', block: 'start' });
      }
    });
  });

  // ===== BUTTON RIPPLE EFFECT =====
  document.querySelectorAll('.btn-primary, .btn-secondary, .nav-cta').forEach(btn => {
    btn.addEventListener('click', function(e) {
      const ripple = document.createElement('span');
      const rect = this.getBoundingClientRect();
      const size = Math.max(rect.width, rect.height);
      ripple.style.cssText = `
        position: absolute;
        width: ${size}px;
        height: ${size}px;
        left: ${e.clientX - rect.left - size / 2}px;
        top: ${e.clientY - rect.top - size / 2}px;
        background: rgba(255,255,255,0.3);
        border-radius: 50%;
        transform: scale(0);
        animation: rippleEffect 0.6s ease-out forwards;
        pointer-events: none;
      `;
      this.style.position = 'relative';
      this.style.overflow = 'hidden';
      this.appendChild(ripple);
      setTimeout(() => ripple.remove(), 600);
    });
  });

  // Add ripple keyframe
  const style = document.createElement('style');
  style.textContent = `
    @keyframes rippleEffect {
      to { transform: scale(4); opacity: 0; }
    }
  `;
  document.head.appendChild(style);
</script>
</body>
</html>

  background-image:linear-gradient(var(--line-d) 1px,transparent 1px),linear-gradient(90deg,var(--line-d) 1px,transparent 1px);
  background-size:34px 34px;mask-image:radial-gradient(80% 80% at 50% 50%,#000,transparent)}
.panel-a{position:absolute;left:6%;top:14%;width:44%;height:56%;border:1px solid var(--line-d);border-radius:10px;
  background:linear-gradient(150deg,rgba(255,74,30,.16),rgba(255,74,30,.02));
  opacity:var(--a);transform:translateY(calc((1 - var(--a)) * 46px)) scale(calc(.94 + var(--a)*.06))}
.panel-b{position:absolute;right:7%;top:20%;width:38%;height:48%;border:1px solid rgba(217,242,78,.28);border-radius:10px;
  background:linear-gradient(200deg,rgba(217,242,78,.13),transparent);
  opacity:var(--b);transform:translateX(calc((1 - var(--b)) * 60px)) rotate(calc((1 - var(--b)) * -4deg))}
.panel-b::after{content:"";position:absolute;left:14%;right:14%;top:26%;height:1px;background:rgba(217,242,78,.3)}
.panel-b::before{content:"";position:absolute;left:14%;width:40%;top:44%;height:1px;background:rgba(217,242,78,.2)}
.orb{position:absolute;top:50%;width:44px;height:44px;margin-top:-22px;border-radius:999px;
  left:calc(6% + var(--e) * 76%);
  background:radial-gradient(circle at 32% 30%,#FFD9C7,var(--molten) 55%,#B92A08);
  transform:scale(var(--sq),calc(2 - var(--sq)));
  box-shadow:0 0 40px rgba(255,74,30,.55),0 14px 30px rgba(0,0,0,.5)}
.orb::after{content:"";position:absolute;inset:-14px;border:1px dashed rgba(255,74,30,.35);border-radius:999px;
  transform:rotate(calc(var(--p) * 480deg))}
.bar-track{position:absolute;left:6%;right:6%;bottom:9%;height:2px;background:rgba(244,240,230,.14);border-radius:2px}
.bar-fill{height:100%;width:calc(var(--c) * 100%);background:var(--acid);box-shadow:0 0 12px rgba(217,242,78,.6)}
.chip{position:absolute;left:6%;bottom:16%;font-family:var(--mono);font-size:.58rem;letter-spacing:.14em;
  color:var(--bone);background:rgba(11,11,13,.6);border:1px solid var(--line-d);border-radius:5px;padding:.25em .5em;
  opacity:var(--c)}
.curvechip{position:absolute;right:6%;top:8%;width:64px;height:64px;border:1px solid var(--line-d);border-radius:8px;
  background:rgba(11,11,13,.5);padding:6px}
.curvechip svg{width:100%;height:100%;overflow:visible}
.curvechip path{fill:none;stroke:var(--acid);stroke-width:1.6;stroke-dasharray:120;stroke-dashoffset:calc(120 - var(--p) * 120)}
.curvechip line{stroke:rgba(244,240,230,.16);stroke-width:1}

/* ruler */
.ruler{position:relative;height:56px;border-top:1px solid var(--line-d);cursor:ew-resize;touch-action:none;
  background:linear-gradient(180deg,rgba(255,255,255,.02),transparent)}
.ticks{position:absolute;inset:0;display:flex;align-items:flex-end;padding:0 1px}
.ticks i{flex:1;border-left:1px solid rgba(244,240,230,.16);height:6px}
.ticks i.maj{height:15px;border-left-color:rgba(244,240,230,.34)}
.kf{position:absolute;top:8px;width:8px;height:8px;background:var(--acid);transform:translateX(-4px) rotate(45deg);opacity:.35;transition:opacity .3s,box-shadow .3s}
.kf.on{opacity:1;box-shadow:0 0 12px rgba(217,242,78,.8)}
.playhead{position:absolute;top:0;bottom:0;width:1px;background:var(--molten);left:calc(var(--p) * 100%);pointer-events:none}
.playhead::before{content:"";position:absolute;top:-1px;left:-4px;width:9px;height:9px;background:var(--molten);transform:rotate(45deg)}
.readout{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:1rem;flex-wrap:wrap;padding:.65rem .85rem;border-top:1px solid var(--line-d);
  font-family:var(--mono);font-size:.6rem;letter-spacing:.12em;text-transform:uppercase;color:var(--chalk)}
.readout b{color:var(--bone);font-weight:500}
.readout .sep{flex:1}
.readout .ease{color:var(--acid)}
.stagefoot{display:flex;gap:1rem;align-items:center;margin-top:.9rem;font-family:var(--mono);font-size:.6rem;letter-spacing:.12em;text-transform:uppercase;opacity:.45}
@media (max-width:1000px){
  .hero{grid-template-columns:1fr;padding-top:6rem}
  .hero__stage{order:-1}
}

/* ============================================================
   MARQUEE STRIP
   ============================================================ */
.strip{border-block:1px solid var(--line-d);padding:1.1rem 0;overflow:hidden;background:var(--ink-2)}
.strip__row{display:flex;gap:3.4rem;width:max-content;animation:slide 34s linear infinite}
.strip__row span{font-family:var(--disp);font-weight:600;font-size:1.05rem;letter-spacing:.02em;opacity:.42;white-space:nowrap;transition:opacity .3s}
.strip__row span:hover{opacity:1}
@keyframes slide{to{transform:translateX(-50%)}}
.strip__lbl{font-family:var(--mono);font-size:.6rem;letter-spacing:.2em;text-transform:uppercase;opacity:.4;
  padding:0 var(--gut);margin-bottom:.7rem}

/* ============================================================
   CAPABILITIES (sticky two-column)
   ============================================================ */
.cap-grid{display:grid;grid-template-columns:minmax(0,.85fr) minmax(0,1.15fr);gap:clamp(1.8rem,5vw,5.5rem);align-items:start}
.cap-left{position:sticky;top:19vh}
.cap-left h2{margin:1.1rem 0 1.3rem}
.cap-list{list-style:none;margin:2.4rem 0 0;padding:0;border-top:1px solid var(--line)}
.cap-list li{display:grid;grid-template-columns:auto 1fr auto;gap:1rem;align-items:center;
  padding:.85rem 0;border-bottom:1px solid var(--line);transition:.5s var(--ease-out);opacity:.42}
.cap-list li .n{font-family:var(--mono);font-size:.62rem;letter-spacing:.12em}
.cap-list li .t{font-family:var(--disp);font-weight:600;font-size:1.02rem;letter-spacing:-.015em}
.cap-list li .m{font-family:var(--mono);font-size:.58rem;opacity:0;transform:translateX(-6px);transition:.5s var(--ease-out)}
.cap-list li.on{opacity:1}
.cap-list li.on .m{opacity:.55;transform:none}
.cap-list li.on .n{color:var(--molten)}
.cap-cards{display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:clamp(1.2rem,3vw,2.4rem)}
.cap-card{border:1px solid var(--line);border-radius:16px;background:#fff;overflow:hidden;
  transition:transform .7s var(--ease-out),box-shadow .7s var(--ease-out)}
.cap-card:hover{transform:translateY(-6px);box-shadow:0 30px 60px -30px rgba(11,11,13,.28)}
.cap-card__img{position:relative;overflow:hidden;aspect-ratio:16/9;background:var(--bone-2)}
.cap-card__img img{width:100%;height:100%;object-fit:cover;transform:scale(1.06);
  animation:kb 22s var(--ease-io) infinite alternate}
@keyframes kb{0%{transform:scale(1.06) translate(0,0)}100%{transform:scale(1.16) translate(-2%,-2.5%)}}
.cap-card__img .num{position:absolute;left:1rem;top:1rem;font-family:var(--mono);font-size:.6rem;letter-spacing:.16em;
  background:var(--ink);color:var(--bone);padding:.35em .6em;border-radius:999px}
.cap-card__body{padding:clamp(1.1rem,2.4vw,1.9rem)}
.cap-card__body h3{margin-bottom:.6rem}
.cap-card__body p{margin:0 0 1.1rem;color:rgba(11,11,13,.66);max-width:52ch;font-weight:300}
.cap-spec{display:flex;flex-wrap:wrap;gap:.4rem}
.cap-spec i{font-style:normal;font-family:var(--mono);font-size:.58rem;letter-spacing:.12em;text-transform:uppercase;
  border:1px solid var(--line);border-radius:999px;padding:.35em .7em;opacity:.65}
@media (max-width:900px){.cap-grid{grid-template-columns:1fr}.cap-left{position:static}.cap-list{display:none}}

/* ============================================================
   HORIZONTAL PRESETS
   ============================================================ */
.hs-wrap{height:340vh;position:relative;background:var(--ink)}
.hs-pin{position:sticky;top:0;height:100vh;display:flex;flex-direction:column;justify-content:center;overflow:hidden}
.hs-head{padding:0 var(--gut);max-width:var(--maxw);margin:0 auto 2rem;display:flex;align-items:flex-end;gap:2rem;flex-wrap:wrap}
.hs-head h2{margin:0}
.hs-head p{margin:0 0 .3rem;max-width:36ch;color:rgba(244,240,230,.6);font-weight:300}
.hs-track{display:flex;gap:clamp(1rem,2vw,1.9rem);padding-inline:var(--gut);width:max-content;will-change:transform}
.pset{position:relative;width:clamp(230px,26vw,330px);flex:none;border:1px solid var(--line-d);border-radius:14px;
  overflow:hidden;background:var(--ink-2);transition:border-color .5s,transform .6s var(--ease-out)}
.pset:hover{border-color:rgba(255,74,30,.5)}
.pset img{aspect-ratio:4/3;object-fit:cover;width:100%;filter:saturate(.7) contrast(1.05);transition:filter .6s,transform .8s var(--ease-out)}
.pset:hover img{filter:saturate(1.1) contrast(1.1);transform:scale(1.05)}
.pset__b{padding:1rem 1.05rem 1.15rem}
.pset__b h3{font-size:1.08rem;margin-bottom:.4rem}
.pset__spec{font-family:var(--mono);font-size:.58rem;letter-spacing:.1em;color:var(--acid);opacity:.8;margin-bottom:.8rem}
.pset__frames{display:flex;gap:2px;align-items:flex-end;height:22px}
.pset__frames i{flex:1;background:rgba(244,240,230,.16);border-radius:1px;transition:background .4s,height .5s var(--ease-out)}
.pset:hover .pset__frames i{background:var(--molten)}
.pset__tag{position:absolute;top:.8rem;right:.8rem;font-family:var(--mono);font-size:.55rem;letter-spacing:.14em;
  background:rgba(11,11,13,.7);border:1px solid var(--line-d);padding:.3em .55em;border-radius:5px;text-transform:uppercase}
.hs-bar{max-width:var(--maxw);margin:2rem auto 0;padding-inline:var(--gut);display:flex;align-items:center;gap:1rem;
  font-family:var(--mono);font-size:.6rem;letter-spacing:.16em;text-transform:uppercase;opacity:.5}
.hs-bar .track{flex:1;height:1px;background:var(--line-d);position:relative}
.hs-bar .track i{position:absolute;inset:0;background:var(--molten);transform:scaleX(var(--hp,0));transform-origin:left}

/* ============================================================
   PIPELINE STACK
   ============================================================ */
.stack{position:relative}
.scard{position:sticky;top:calc(15vh + var(--i) * 20px);margin-bottom:44vh;
  border:1px solid var(--line);border-radius:18px;background:#fff;overflow:hidden;
  box-shadow:0 30px 70px -40px rgba(11,11,13,.4);will-change:transform}
.scard__in{display:grid;grid-template-columns:auto minmax(0,1.3fr) minmax(0,1fr);gap:clamp(1.2rem,3vw,3rem);
  align-items:center;padding:clamp(1.4rem,3vw,2.6rem)}
.scard__n{font-family:var(--disp);font-weight:800;font-size:clamp(2.6rem,6vw,5.4rem);line-height:.8;color:var(--bone-2);
  letter-spacing:-.05em}
.scard h3{margin-bottom:.7rem;font-size:clamp(1.3rem,2.3vw,2rem)}
.scard p{margin:0;color:rgba(11,11,13,.66);font-weight:300;max-width:46ch}
.scard__foot{display:flex;flex-wrap:wrap;gap:.4rem;margin-top:1.1rem}
.scard__foot i{font-style:normal;font-family:var(--mono);font-size:.56rem;letter-spacing:.12em;text-transform:uppercase;
  background:var(--ink);color:var(--bone);border-radius:999px;padding:.4em .75em;opacity:.82}
.scard__img{border-radius:12px;overflow:hidden;aspect-ratio:5/4}
.scard__img img{width:100%;height:100%;object-fit:cover}
.scard:nth-child(2){background:var(--bone-2)}
.scard:nth-child(4){background:var(--ink);color:var(--bone);border-color:var(--line-d)}
.scard:nth-child(4) p{color:rgba(244,240,230,.66)}
.scard:nth-child(4) .scard__n{color:var(--ink-3)}
.scard:nth-child(4) .scard__foot i{background:var(--molten);color:var(--ink)}
@media (max-width:900px){.scard__in{grid-template-columns:1fr}.scard__img{display:none}}

/* ============================================================
   HANDOFF / BEFORE-AFTER
   ============================================================ */
.ho{background:var(--teal);color:var(--bone)}
.ho-grid{display:grid;grid-template-columns:minmax(0,1fr) minmax(0,1.25fr);gap:clamp(2rem,5vw,5rem);align-items:center}
.ba{position:relative;border-radius:16px;overflow:hidden;border:1px solid rgba(244,240,230,.22);
  aspect-ratio:16/10;cursor:ew-resize;touch-action:none;user-select:none;background:#000}
.ba img{position:absolute;inset:0;width:100%;height:100%;object-fit:cover}
.ba .after{clip-path:inset(0 0 0 var(--pos,52%))}
.ba .before{filter:grayscale(1) contrast(1.1) brightness(.72)}
.ba__handle{position:absolute;top:0;bottom:0;left:var(--pos,52%);width:2px;background:var(--acid);pointer-events:none}
.ba__handle::after{content:"⇆";position:absolute;top:50%;left:50%;transform:translate(-50%,-50%);
  width:44px;height:44px;border-radius:999px;background:var(--acid);color:var(--ink);
  display:grid;place-items:center;font-size:1rem;font-weight:700;box-shadow:0 8px 24px rgba(0,0,0,.4)}
.ba__lbl{position:absolute;bottom:1rem;font-family:var(--mono);font-size:.58rem;letter-spacing:.14em;text-transform:uppercase;
  background:rgba(11,11,13,.62);border:1px solid rgba(244,240,230,.2);padding:.4em .6em;border-radius:6px}
.ba__lbl.l{left:1rem}.ba__lbl.r{right:1rem;color:var(--acid)}
.ho ul{list-style:none;padding:0;margin:2rem 0 0;display:grid;gap:.9rem}
.ho ul li{display:grid;grid-template-columns:auto 1fr;gap:.9rem;align-items:start;font-weight:300;
  color:rgba(244,240,230,.8);font-size:.96rem}
.ho ul li b{font-family:var(--disp);font-weight:700;color:var(--bone);display:block;font-size:1.02rem;letter-spacing:-.01em}
.ho ul li::before{content:"";width:8px;height:8px;margin-top:.5rem;background:var(--acid);transform:rotate(45deg);flex:none}
@media (max-width:900px){.ho-grid{grid-template-columns:1fr}}

/* ============================================================
   POSTCARDS
   ============================================================ */
.cards-field{position:relative;min-height:640px;margin-top:2rem}
.pc{position:absolute;width:clamp(180px,20vw,262px);border-radius:12px;overflow:hidden;background:#fff;
  border:1px solid var(--line);box-shadow:0 20px 45px -25px rgba(11,11,13,.45);
  transform:translate(var(--x,0),var(--y,0)) rotate(var(--r,0deg));
  transition:transform .7s var(--ease-out),box-shadow .7s var(--ease-out),z-index 0s;cursor:pointer}
.pc:hover{transform:translate(var(--x,0),calc(var(--y,0) - 14px)) rotate(0deg) scale(1.05);
  box-shadow:0 40px 70px -28px rgba(11,11,13,.5);z-index:5}
.pc img{aspect-ratio:1/1;object-fit:cover;width:100%;animation:kb 26s var(--ease-io) infinite alternate}
.pc__b{padding:.7rem .8rem .8rem;color:var(--ink)}
.pc__b .h{font-family:var(--mono);font-size:.58rem;letter-spacing:.1em;color:var(--molten)}
.pc__b .c{font-size:.84rem;font-weight:500;margin-top:.25rem;line-height:1.3}
.pc__b .f{font-family:var(--mono);font-size:.55rem;letter-spacing:.12em;text-transform:uppercase;opacity:.45;margin-top:.5rem}
@media (max-width:820px){
  .cards-field{min-height:0;display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(auto-fill,minmax(150px,1fr));gap:1rem}
  .pc{position:static;width:auto;transform:none!important}
}

/* ============================================================
   STATS
   ============================================================ */
.stats{background:var(--ink);border-block:1px solid var(--line-d)}
.stats-grid{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(4,1fr);gap:1px;background:var(--line-d)}
.stat{background:var(--ink);padding:clamp(1.6rem,3.4vw,3rem) clamp(1rem,2vw,1.8rem)}
.stat .v{font-family:var(--disp);font-weight:800;font-size:clamp(2.1rem,4.6vw,4.2rem);letter-spacing:-.04em;line-height:.9}
.stat .v em{font-style:normal;color:var(--molten);font-size:.5em;letter-spacing:0}
.stat .k{font-family:var(--mono);font-size:.6rem;letter-spacing:.16em;text-transform:uppercase;opacity:.5;margin-top:.9rem}
.stat .sub{font-size:.86rem;opacity:.55;margin-top:.5rem;font-weight:300;max-width:22ch}
@media (max-width:820px){.stats-grid{grid-template-columns:repeat(2,1fr)}}

/* ============================================================
   TESTIMONIALS
   ============================================================ */
.tst-grid{display:grid;grid-template-columns:minmax(0,1.35fr) minmax(0,1fr);gap:clamp(1.4rem,3vw,2.6rem)}
.quote{border:1px solid var(--line);border-radius:16px;padding:clamp(1.4rem,3vw,2.6rem);background:#fff;
  display:flex;flex-direction:column;justify-content:space-between;gap:2rem;transition:transform .6s var(--ease-out)}
.quote:hover{transform:translateY(-5px)}
.quote--big p{font-family:var(--disp);font-weight:600;letter-spacing:-.025em;line-height:1.16;
  font-size:clamp(1.35rem,2.9vw,2.4rem);margin:0}
.quote p{margin:0}
.quote--sm{background:var(--bone-2)}
.quote--sm p{font-size:1.02rem;line-height:1.45;font-weight:300}
.who{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:.8rem}
.who img{width:40px;height:40px;border-radius:999px;object-fit:cover;filter:grayscale(1)}
.who .n{font-family:var(--disp);font-weight:700;font-size:.95rem;letter-spacing:-.01em}
.who .r{font-family:var(--mono);font-size:.58rem;letter-spacing:.12em;text-transform:uppercase;opacity:.5}
.tst-col{display:grid;gap:clamp(1.4rem,3vw,2.6rem)}
@media (max-width:900px){.tst-grid{grid-template-columns:1fr}}

/* ============================================================
   PRICING
   ============================================================ */
.pr-top{display:flex;align-items:flex-end;justify-content:space-between;gap:2rem;flex-wrap:wrap;margin-bottom:3rem}
.toggle{display:inline-flex;position:relative;border:1px solid var(--line-d);border-radius:999px;padding:4px;
  font-family:var(--mono);font-size:.62rem;letter-spacing:.14em;text-transform:uppercase}
.toggle button{position:relative;z-index:1;background:none;border:0;padding:.55em 1.1em;border-radius:999px;cursor:pointer;opacity:.55;transition:color .4s,opacity .4s}
.toggle button.on{opacity:1;color:var(--ink)}
.toggle .pill{position:absolute;top:4px;bottom:4px;left:4px;width:calc(50% - 4px);background:var(--acid);border-radius:999px;
  transition:transform .5s var(--ease-out)}
.toggle.ann .pill{transform:translateX(100%)}
.tiers{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(3,1fr);gap:clamp(1rem,2vw,1.6rem);align-items:stretch}
.tier{border:1px solid var(--line-d);border-radius:18px;padding:clamp(1.4rem,2.6vw,2.2rem);display:flex;flex-direction:column;
  background:var(--ink-2);transition:transform .6s var(--ease-out),border-color .5s,background .5s}
.tier:hover{transform:translateY(-6px);border-color:rgba(244,240,230,.35)}
.tier--hero{background:linear-gradient(170deg,#1F1F27,#101014);border-color:rgba(255,74,30,.45);position:relative;
  box-shadow:0 40px 80px -40px rgba(255,74,30,.28)}
.tier--hero .ribbon{position:absolute;top:1.2rem;right:1.2rem;font-family:var(--mono);font-size:.55rem;letter-spacing:.16em;
  text-transform:uppercase;background:var(--molten);color:var(--ink);padding:.4em .7em;border-radius:999px}
.tier .name{font-family:var(--disp);font-weight:700;font-size:1.2rem;letter-spacing:-.01em}
.tier .desc{font-size:.86rem;opacity:.55;margin:.4rem 0 1.6rem;font-weight:300}
.price{display:flex;align-items:baseline;gap:.4rem;font-family:var(--disp);font-weight:800;letter-spacing:-.04em;font-size:clamp(2rem,4.4vw,3.2rem);line-height:.9}
.price small{font-family:var(--mono);font-size:.6rem;letter-spacing:.12em;font-weight:400;opacity:.55;text-transform:uppercase}
.price .amt{display:inline-block}
.price .amt.flip{animation:flipIn .42s var(--ease-out)}
@keyframes flipIn{0%{opacity:0;transform:translateY(-14px) scale(.96)}100%{opacity:1;transform:none}}
.tier ul{list-style:none;padding:0;margin:1.7rem 0 2rem;display:grid;gap:.72rem;flex:1}
.tier li{display:grid;grid-template-columns:auto 1fr;gap:.7rem;font-size:.88rem;font-weight:300;color:rgba(244,240,230,.78)}
.tier li::before{content:"";width:6px;height:6px;margin-top:.55em;background:var(--acid);transform:rotate(45deg)}
.tier .btn{justify-content:center}
.ent{margin-top:1.6rem;border:1px dashed var(--line-d);border-radius:18px;padding:clamp(1.2rem,2.4vw,1.8rem);
  display:flex;align-items:center;gap:1.5rem;flex-wrap:wrap;justify-content:space-between}
.ent p{margin:0;max-width:52ch;font-weight:300;opacity:.75}
@media (max-width:900px){.tiers{grid-template-columns:1fr}}

/* ============================================================
   FAQ
   ============================================================ */
.faq{border-top:1px solid var(--line)}
.q{border-bottom:1px solid var(--line)}
.q button{width:100%;background:none;border:0;text-align:left;cursor:pointer;padding:1.35rem 0;
  display:grid;grid-template-columns:auto 1fr auto;gap:1.2rem;align-items:center;
  font-family:var(--disp);font-weight:600;font-size:clamp(1.02rem,1.7vw,1.35rem);letter-spacing:-.02em;transition:opacity .4s}
.q button .qn{font-family:var(--mono);font-size:.6rem;letter-spacing:.14em;opacity:.45}
.q button:hover{opacity:.6}
.q .plus{position:relative;width:14px;height:14px;flex:none}
.q .plus::before,.q .plus::after{content:"";position:absolute;background:currentColor;transition:transform .45s var(--ease-out)}
.q .plus::before{left:0;right:0;top:6.5px;height:1px}
.q .plus::after{top:0;bottom:0;left:6.5px;width:1px}
.q.open .plus::after{transform:rotate(90deg)}
.q .ans{display:grid;grid-template-rows:0fr;transition:grid-template-rows .55s var(--ease-out)}
.q.open .ans{grid-template-rows:1fr}
.q .ans>div{overflow:hidden}
.q .ans p{margin:0 0 1.5rem;max-width:62ch;color:rgba(11,11,13,.66);font-weight:300;padding-left:clamp(0rem,4vw,3.4rem)}

/* ============================================================
   CTA + FOOTER
   ============================================================ */
.cta{background:var(--ink);padding-bottom:0;overflow:hidden}
.mq{display:flex;gap:2.4rem;width:max-content;animation:slide 26s linear infinite;margin-block:2rem}
.mq h2{font-size:clamp(3rem,11vw,10rem);white-space:nowrap;letter-spacing:-.05em;line-height:.82;
  color:transparent;-webkit-text-stroke:1px rgba(244,240,230,.4)}
.mq h2:nth-child(2){color:var(--molten);-webkit-text-stroke:0}
.form{display:flex;gap:.6rem;flex-wrap:wrap;align-items:center;max-width:560px;margin-top:1.5rem}
.form input{flex:1;min-width:220px;background:transparent;border:1px solid var(--line-d);border-radius:999px;
  padding:.9rem 1.2rem;outline:none;transition:border-color .4s,box-shadow .4s}
.form input:focus{border-color:var(--molten);box-shadow:0 0 0 4px rgba(255,74,30,.12)}
.form .ok{font-family:var(--mono);font-size:.66rem;letter-spacing:.12em;color:var(--acid);opacity:0;transform:translateY(6px);transition:.5s var(--ease-out)}
.form .ok.on{opacity:1;transform:none}
.cta-grid{display:grid;grid-template-columns:minmax(0,1.1fr) minmax(0,.9fr);gap:clamp(2rem,5vw,5rem);align-items:center}
.changelog{border:1px solid var(--line-d);border-radius:16px;padding:1.4rem;background:var(--ink-2)}
.changelog h4{font-family:var(--mono);font-size:.6rem;letter-spacing:.18em;text-transform:uppercase;margin:0 0 1rem;opacity:.5}
.changelog ol{list-style:none;margin:0;padding:0;display:grid;gap:.85rem}
.changelog li{display:grid;grid-template-columns:auto 1fr;gap:.8rem;font-size:.86rem;font-weight:300;opacity:.8}
.changelog li b{font-family:var(--mono);font-size:.6rem;letter-spacing:.1em;color:var(--acid);font-weight:400;padding-top:.2em}
footer{border-top:1px solid var(--line-d);background:var(--ink-2);padding-block:clamp(3rem,6vw,5rem) 2rem}
.f-grid{display:grid;grid-template-columns:1.6fr repeat(4,1fr);gap:2rem}
.f-col h5{font-family:var(--mono);font-size:.6rem;letter-spacing:.18em;text-transform:uppercase;opacity:.45;margin:0 0 1.1rem;font-weight:400}
.f-col a{display:block;padding:.3rem 0;font-size:.9rem;opacity:.75;transition:opacity .3s,transform .3s var(--ease-out)}
.f-col a:hover{opacity:1;transform:translateX(4px)}
.f-bot{display:flex;justify-content:space-between;gap:1rem;flex-wrap:wrap;margin-top:3.5rem;padding-top:1.2rem;
  border-top:1px solid var(--line-d);font-family:var(--mono);font-size:.58rem;letter-spacing:.14em;text-transform:uppercase;opacity:.45}
@media (max-width:900px){.f-grid{grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr}.cta-grid{grid-template-columns:1fr}}

/* ============================================================
   REDUCED / PIN-OFF
   ============================================================ */
html.reduced .scrub-wrap,html.reduced .hs-wrap{height:auto}
html.reduced .scrub-pin,html.reduced .hs-pin{position:static;height:auto}
html.reduced .scard{position:static;margin-bottom:1.6rem}
html.reduced .hs-track{transform:none!important;flex-wrap:wrap;width:auto}
html.reduced .pc{position:static;transform:none!important;width:auto}
html.reduced .cards-field{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(auto-fill,minmax(180px,1fr));gap:1.2rem;min-height:0}
html.reduced .grain{animation:none}
@media (max-width:820px){
  .scrub-wrap{height:auto}
  .scrub-pin{position:static;height:auto;padding-block:6rem 3rem}
  .hs-wrap{height:auto}
  .hs-pin{position:static;height:auto;padding-block:4rem}
  .hs-track{transform:none!important;flex-wrap:wrap;width:auto;justify-content:center}
  .stack .scard{position:static;margin-bottom:1.4rem}
}
@media (prefers-reduced-motion:reduce){
  html{scroll-behavior:auto}
  *,*::before,*::after{animation-duration:.001ms!important;animation-iteration-count:1!important;
    transition-duration:.001ms!important}
  [data-rv],.mask .lni{opacity:1!important;transform:none!important;filter:none!important;clip-path:none!important}
}
</style>
</head>
<body>

<div class="grain" aria-hidden="true"></div>
<div class="vig" aria-hidden="true"></div>
<div class="navwipe" id="navwipe" aria-hidden="true"></div>
<div class="cursor" id="cursor" aria-hidden="true"><span id="cursorLbl"></span></div>
<div class="dot-cursor" id="dotc" aria-hidden="true"></div>

<!-- ===================== NAV ===================== -->
<header class="nav" id="nav">
  <a href="#canvas" class="brand" data-magnet><i class="kfmark"></i>INERTIA</a>
  <nav class="nav__links" aria-label="Primary">
    <a href="#canvas">Canvas</a>
    <a href="#capabilities">Capabilities</a>
    <a href="#presets">Presets</a>
