<!-- ══════════════ OPENER : LIVE KEYGRAPH ══════════════ -->
<section class="opener" id="stage">
  <div class="op-grid">
    <div class="op-left" data-rv>
      <div class="kicker"><em>◆</em> Cadence 4.2 <s></s> Frame-level motion engine</div>
      <h1 class="split">Motion, solved at the <span class="l2">frame</span> <span class="l3">level.</span></h1>
      <p class="deck">A deterministic timeline for the browser. Key any property, dial the curve,
        and ship <b>60fps choreography</b> that survives re-renders, refactors and code review.</p>
      <div class="op-actions">
        <button class="btn mag" data-scroll="#curves"><span>Browse 48 curves</span></button>
        <button class="btn ghost mag" data-scroll="#engine"><span>See the engine →</span></button>
      </div>
      <div class="op-facts">
        <div><b>6.2kb</b>Runtime, gzipped</div>
        <div><b>0</b>Layout thrash</div>
        <div><b>SSR</b>Hydration-safe</div>
      </div>
    </div>

    <!-- editor -->
    <div class="editor" id="editor" data-rv style="--d:140ms">
      <div class="ed-head">
        <div class="file"><span class="pulse"></span> hero-intro.cad <em>· autosaved 2m ago</em></div>
        <div class="tabs"><b class="on">Graph</b><b>Choreo</b><b>Physics</b></div>
        <div class="meta"><i id="fps">60</i> fps · <i id="ms">1.2</i> ms/frame</div>
      </div>

      <div class="ed-body">
        <div class="graph-wrap">
          <svg id="graph" viewBox="0 0 480 236" role="img" aria-label="Easing curve graph. Drag to scrub the timeline.">
            <defs><linearGradient id="grad" x1="0" y1="0" x2="0" y2="1">
              <stop offset="0" stop-color="#FF4A1C" stop-opacity=".34"/><stop offset="1" stop-color="#FF4A1C" stop-opacity="0"/>
            </linearGradient></defs>
            <g id="grid"></g>
            <line class="diag" x1="26" y1="200" x2="454" y2="26"/>
            <path id="area" d=""/><path id="ghost" d=""/><path id="curve" d=""/>
            <g class="ph" id="ph"><line x1="26" y1="14" x2="26" y2="212"/></g>
            <g id="handle"><circle cx="26" cy="200" r="6.5"/></g>
            <text x="26" y="226" fill="#8E8A83" font-family="Space Mono, monospace" font-size="9" letter-spacing="1.4">t 0.00</text>
            <text x="454" y="226" text-anchor="end" fill="#8E8A83" font-family="Space Mono, monospace" font-size="9" letter-spacing="1.4">t 1.00</text>
            <text x="12" y="30" fill="#8E8A83" font-family="Space Mono, monospace" font-size="9">1</text>
            <text x="12" y="204" fill="#8E8A83" font-family="Space Mono, monospace" font-size="9">0</text>
          </svg>
          <div class="axis"><span>Progress → value</span><span id="curveName">easeOutQuint</span></div>
        </div>

        <aside class="preview">
          <div class="rail" id="rail"><div class="cube" id="cube">C</div></div>
          <div class="readouts">
            <div class="ro"><span>x</span><b id="v-x">0px</b></div>
            <div class="ro"><span>scale</span><b id="v-s">0.86×</b></div>
            <div class="ro"><span>alpha</span><b id="v-o">0%</b></div>
            <div class="ro"><span>rot</span><b id="v-r">0°</b></div>
            <div class="ro"><span>curve</span><b id="v-y">0.000</b></div>
          </div>
        </aside>
      </div>

      <div class="lanes" id="lanes">
        <div class="lane"><em>Position</em><div class="bar"><i data-l="0"></i><u data-k="0"></u></div><b data-v="0">0%</b></div>
        <div class="lane"><em>Scale</em><div class="bar"><i data-l="1"></i><u data-k="1"></u></div><b data-v="1">0%</b></div>
        <div class="lane"><em>Opacity</em><div class="bar"><i data-l="2"></i><u data-k="2"></u></div><b data-v="2">0%</b></div>
        <div class="lane"><em>Rotate</em><div class="bar"><i data-l="3"></i><u data-k="3"></u></div><b data-v="3">0%</b></div>

          <button class="ico" id="rew" aria-label="Rewind"><svg width="12" height="12" viewBox="0 0 12 12"><path d="M4 1l7 5-7 5zM1 1h2v10H1z"/></svg></button>

<!-- ══════════════ CAPABILITIES ══════════════ -->
<section id="moves">
  <div class="row-split">
    <div data-rv>
      <div class="kicker"><em>01</em> Capabilities <s></s> 06 modules</div>
      <h2 class="split">Everything that moves,<br><u>moves on the same</u> <i>clock.</i></h2>
    </div>
    <p class="lede" data-rv style="--d:120ms">Six modules, one shared timeline. Curves, springs, scroll links and layout
      transitions all resolve against the same frame loop — so nothing fights for the compositor.</p>
  </div>

  <div class="caps">
    <article class="cap" style="grid-column:span 4" data-rv>
      <div class="cap-n">M-01 / KEYGRAPH</div>
      <h3>Multi-property keyframing with sub-frame precision</h3>
      <p>Every lane resolves independently, samples at device resolution, never drops a tick.</p>
      <div class="cap-viz"><div class="a-spans" data-bars="9"></div></div>
    </article>
    <article class="cap" style="grid-column:span 4" data-rv="--d:80ms">
      <div class="cap-n">M-02 / PHYSICS</div>
      <h3>Real springs, not fake beziers</h3>
      <p>Stiffness, damping, mass. Interrupt mid-flight and velocity carries through.</p>
      <div class="cap-viz"><div class="a-orbit"><i></i></div></div>
    </article>
    <article class="cap" style="grid-column:span 4" data-rv="--d:160ms">
      <div class="cap-n">M-03 / SCROLL LINK</div>
      <h3>Inertial scroll binding</h3>
      <p>Map any value to scroll position with a smoothed virtual playhead.</p>
      <div class="cap-viz"><div class="a-lines" data-lines="4"></div></div>
    </article>
    <article class="cap" style="grid-column:span 5" data-rv>
      <div class="cap-n">M-04 / LAYOUT FX</div>
      <h3>Shared-element transitions without the clone tax</h3>
      <p>Morph between DOM states using the View Transitions protocol, with a fallback scheduler for everything else.</p>
      <div class="cap-viz"><div class="a-bars" data-bars="7"></div></div>
    </article>
    <article class="cap" style="grid-column:span 3" data-rv="--d:100ms">
      <div class="cap-n">M-05 / TEXT</div>
      <h3>Glyph-level choreography</h3>
      <p>Split, mask, stagger. Line-height safe.</p>
      <div class="cap-viz"><div class="a-orbit"><i style="background:var(--flare)"></i></div></div>
    </article>
    <article class="cap" style="grid-column:span 4" data-rv="--d:200ms">
      <div class="cap-n">M-06 / INSPECTOR</div>
      <h3>Frame-by-frame diffing</h3>
      <p>Record a session, step through frames, compare against your golden master.</p>
      <div class="cap-viz"><div class="a-lines" data-lines="5"></div></div>
    </article>
  </div>
</section>

<div class="curtain" data-rv="clip"></div>

<!-- ══════════════ PINNED CROSSFADE ══════════════ -->
<section class="pin" id="engine" aria-label="The engine">
  <div class="pin-in" id="pinIn">
    <article class="panel" data-panel="0">
      <div>
        <div class="idx">SURFACE 01 — KEYGRAPH</div>
        <h3>Draw the curve.<br>The browser obeys.</h3>
        <p>Drag handles, type a cubic-bezier, or hand it a spring. Cadence compiles your intent into a
          single sampled lookup table — 1024 entries, 40 microseconds to build, zero allocation per frame.</p>
      </div>
      <div class="art"><div class="grid-bg"></div>
        <svg viewBox="0 0 200 200" aria-hidden="true">
          <path d="M20 170C60 170 60 40 180 32" fill="none" stroke="#FF4A1C" stroke-width="2.5"
                stroke-dasharray="330" stroke-dashoffset="330"><animate attributeName="stroke-dashoffset" values="330;0;0" dur="3.4s" repeatCount="indefinite"/></path>
          <circle r="6" fill="#EFEAE0"><animateMotion dur="3.4s" repeatCount="indefinite" path="M20 170C60 170 60 40 180 32"/></circle>
          <line x1="20" y1="170" x2="180" y2="32" stroke="rgba(239,234,224,.16)" stroke-dasharray="3 5"/>
        </svg>
      </div>
    </article>
    <article class="panel" data-panel="1">
      <div>
        <div class="idx">SURFACE 02 — CHOREO</div>
        <h3>Sequence hundreds<br>of actors, one cue sheet.</h3>
        <p>Nested timelines, offsets, markers and label tracks. Reorder a cue and every dependent
          lane re-keys itself. Nothing recomputes unless a value actually changed.</p>
      </div>
      <div class="art"><div class="grid-bg"></div>
        <div class="choreo">
          <i style="--hh:82%;--dl:0s"></i><i style="--hh:44%;--dl:.12s"></i><i style="--hh:96%;--dl:.24s"></i>
          <i style="--hh:58%;--dl:.36s"></i><i style="--hh:74%;--dl:.48s"></i><i style="--hh:36%;--dl:.6s"></i>
          <i style="--hh:88%;--dl:.72s"></i><i style="--hh:52%;--dl:.84s"></i>
        </div>
      </div>
    </article>
    <article class="panel" data-panel="2">
      <div>
        <div class="idx">SURFACE 03 — SHIP</div>
        <h3>Compile to nothing<br>but transform & opacity.</h3>
        <p>The bundler emits a tree-shaken module per scene. Your motion budget, printed in CI,
          before a human ever has to review a keyframe.</p>
      </div>
      <div class="art"><div class="grid-bg"></div>
        <div class="term">
          <span class="ln" style="--dl:0s"><b>$ cadence build --scene hero</b></span>
          <span class="ln" style="--dl:.4s">sampling <em>4</em> lanes… ok</span>
          <span class="ln" style="--dl:.8s">compiling cues… ok</span>
          <span class="ln" style="--dl:1.2s">budget <em>6.2kb</em> / 8.0kb</span>
          <span class="ln" style="--dl:1.6s"><b>✓ shipped in 41ms</b></span>
        </div>
        <div class="badge">60 FPS LOCKED</div>
      </div>
    </article>
    <div class="pin-nav" id="pinNav"><i><b></b></i><i><b></b></i><i><b></b></i></div>
    <div class="pin-tag" id="pinTag">Scroll → 01 / 03</div>
  </div>
</section>

<!-- ══════════════ STACKED WORKFLOW ══════════════ -->
<section id="flow" class="stack">
  <div class="row-split" data-rv>
    <div>
      <div class="kicker"><em>02</em> Workflow <s></s> Idle → shipped</div>
      <h2 class="split">Four moves, and you<br><u>never open a</u> <i>plugin.</i></h2>
    </div>
    <p class="lede">The whole pipeline lives in your repo. Motion is code, reviewed like code, tested like code —
      with a graph that stays readable at 2am.</p>
  </div>

  <div style="margin-top:52px">
    <div class="slot"><div class="scard" style="--i:0" data-stack>
      <div><div class="big">01</div><h3>Declare the scene</h3>
        <p>One object, plain TypeScript. Lanes, cues, markers — no wrapper components, no context providers.</p></div>
      <ul class="checks">
        <li><b>TYPED</b>Property keys inferred from the target element's actual style surface.</li>
        <li><b>PORTABLE</b>The same scene object runs in Node for snapshot tests.</li>
        <li><b>DIFFABLE</b>Scenes serialise to stable JSON — git diffs read like changelogs.</li>
      </ul>
    </div></div>
    <div class="slot"><div class="scard" style="--i:1" data-stack>
      <div><div class="big">02</div><h3>Key the curves</h3>
        <p>Scrub, drag or type. Every handle snaps to a 1/240s grid so collaborators land on your frames.</p></div>
      <ul class="checks">
        <li><b>LOOKUP</b>1024-entry table baked at build; runtime does array reads.</li>
        <li><b>INTERRUPT</b>Velocity-preserving retargeting on pointer events mid-flight.</li>
        <li><b>MARKERS</b>Named cues you can subscribe to from anywhere in the tree.</li>
      </ul>
    </div></div>
    <div class="slot"><div class="scard" style="--i:2" data-stack>
      <div><div class="big">03</div><h3>Bind the inputs</h3>
        <p>Scroll, pointer, media queries, reduced-motion, container size — all become timeline drivers.</p></div>
      <ul class="checks">
        <li><b>SMOOTHED</b>Lerped virtual playhead; no jank from raw scroll events.</li>
        <li><b>PASSIVE</b>Listeners registered passive by default, enforced by the linter.</li>
        <li><b>GRACEFUL</b>Reduced-motion compiles to an instant-jump variant, not a broken page.</li>
      </ul>
    </div></div>
    <div class="slot"><div class="scard" style="--i:3" data-stack>
      <div><div class="big">04</div><h3>Ship and watch it hold</h3>
        <p>CI records the scene, steps the frames, and fails the build if a lane drifts past tolerance.</p></div>
      <ul class="checks">
        <li><b>GOLDEN</b>Frame hashes committed alongside your snapshots.</li>
        <li><b>BUDGETED</b>Per-scene byte and ms ceilings, asserted at build time.</li>
        <li><b>OBSERVABLE</b>Optional runtime telemetry into your existing dashboards.</li>
      </ul>
    </div></div>
  </div>
</section>

<!-- ══════════════ EASING LIBRARY ══════════════ -->
<section id="curves">
  <div class="row-split" data-rv>
    <div>
      <div class="kicker"><em>03</em> The library <s></s> 48 presets · curves, springs, physics</div>
      <h2 class="split">Forty-eight curves,<br><u>each one</u> <i>opinionated.</i></h2>
    </div>
    <p class="lede">Click any row to load it into the keygraph above. Hover to preview the motion at 1× —

</section>

    <div>
      <div class="kicker"><em>04</em> Field notes <s></s> Built with Cadence</div>

  </div>
</section>

<!-- ══════════════ STATS ══════════════ -->
<section id="numbers">

<script>
(()=>{
"use strict";
const RM = matchMedia('(prefers-reduced-motion: reduce)').matches;
const $=(s,c=document)=>c.querySelector(s), $$=(s,c=document)=>[...c.querySelectorAll(s)];
const clamp=(v,a=0,b=1)=>v<a?a:v>b?b:v;
const lerp=(a,b,t)=>a+(b-a)*t;

/* ─────────── EASINGS ─────────── */
function bezier(x1,y1,x2,y2){
  const A=(a,b)=>1-3*b+3*a, B=(a,b)=>3*b-6*a, C=a=>3*a;
  const cx=t=>((A(x1,x2)*t+B(x1,x2))*t+C(x1))*t;
  const cy=t=>((A(y1,y2)*t+B(y1,y2))*t+C(y1))*t;
  const dx=t=>3*A(x1,x2)*t*t+2*B(x1,x2)*t+C(x1);
  return x=>{
    if(x<=0)return 0; if(x>=1)return 1;
    let t=x;
    for(let i=0;i<6;i++){const e=cx(t)-x, d=dx(t); if(Math.abs(e)<1e-6)break; if(Math.abs(d)<1e-6)break; t-=e/d;}
    return cy(clamp(t,0,1));
  };
}
const E = {
  linear:t=>t,
  quint:bezier(.22,1,.36,1),
  expo:bezier(.16,1,.3,1),
  inout:bezier(.76,0,.24,1),
  back:t=>{const c1=1.70158,c3=c1+1;return 1+c3*Math.pow(t-1,3)+c1*Math.pow(t-1,2);},
  elastic:t=>t===0?0:t===1?1:Math.pow(2,-11*t)*Math.sin((t*11-7.5)*(2*Math.PI)/3)+1,
  spring:t=>{const w=9.2,z=.42,wd=w*Math.sqrt(1-z*z);return 1-Math.exp(-z*w*t)*(Math.cos(wd*t)+(z*w/wd)*Math.sin(wd*t));},
  circ:bezier(.85,0,.15,1),
  quad:bezier(.25,.46,.45,.94),
  sine:bezier(.37,0,.63,1),
 antic:t=>{const c=1.2;return t<.5?(Math.pow(2*t,2)*((c+1)*2*t-c))/2:(Math.pow(2*t-2,2)*((c+1)*(2*t-2)+c)+2)/2;}
};
const LIB=[
  {k:'quint',   n:'out · quint',   fn:E.quint,   code:'cubic-bezier(.22,1,.36,1)', use:'Default entrances', shape:'M4 34C14 34 18 6 44 4'},
  {k:'expo',    n:'out · expo',    fn:E.expo,    code:'cubic-bezier(.16,1,.3,1)',  use:'Panel reveals, sheets', shape:'M4 34C8 34 10 6 44 4'},
  {k:'spring',  n:'spring · 9.2/0.42',fn:E.spring,code:'{stiffness:9.2,damping:.42}',use:'Physical objects', shape:'M4 34C10 34 12 2 18 12s6 18 10 12 8-6 12-8'},
  {k:'back',    n:'out · back',    fn:E.back,    code:'cubic-bezier(.34,1.56,.64,1)',use:'Overshoot, badges', shape:'M4 34C14 34 20 -2 30 6s10-2 10-2'},
  {k:'elastic', n:'out · elastic', fn:E.elastic, code:'/* analytic */',            use:'Playful, sparse use', shape:'M4 34C8 34 8 2 12 14s4 16 8 8 4-10 8-4 4-4 4-4'},
  {k:'inout',   n:'in · out cubic',fn:E.inout,   code:'cubic-bezier(.76,0,.24,1)', use:'Swaps, tabs, accordions', shape:'M4 34C16 34 18 4 30 4s10-2 10-2'},
  {k:'circ',    n:'in · out circ', fn:E.circ,    code:'cubic-bezier(.85,0,.15,1)', use:'Image masks, wipes', shape:'M4 34C20 30 20 8 44 4'},
  {k:'sine',    n:'in · out sine', fn:E.sine,    code:'cubic-bezier(.37,0,.63,1)', use:'Ambient, looping idle', shape:'M4 34C18 30 26 8 44 4'},
  {k:'quad',    n:'out · quad',    fn:E.quad,    code:'cubic-bezier(.25,.46,.45,.94)',use:'Hover, micro-states', shape:'M4 34C18 30 30 14 44 4'},
  {k:'antic',   n:'anticipate',    fn:E.antic,   code:'/* analytic, c=1.2 */',     use:'Wind-up before throw', shape:'M4 34C0 40 10 40 16 34s14-30 24-30'}
];
LIB.forEach(p=>{ if(!E[p.k]) E[p.k]=p.fn; });

/* ─────────── KEYGRAPH ENGINE ─────────── */
const G={W:480,H:236,padL:26,padR:26,padT:14,padB:36};
const svgNS='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg';
const graph=$('#graph'), curveP=$('#curve'), ghostP=$('#ghost'), areaP=$('#area'),
      handle=$('#handle circle'), phLine=$('#ph line'), cube=$('#cube'), rail=$('#rail'),
      lanePh=$('#lanePh'), tcode=$('#tcode'), vY=$('#v-y');
const LANES=[{s:0,d:1},{s:.1,d:.86},{s:0,d:.42},{s:.26,d:.74}];
const laneFills=$$('#lanes .bar i'), laneKeys=$$('#lanes .bar u'), laneVals=$$('#lanes b[data-v]');

let ease=E.quint, prevEase=E.quint, mix=1, T=0, playing=true, speed=1, DUR=2000, last=performance.now(), hold=0;
let fpsEl=$('#fps'), msEl=$('#ms'), frameAcc=[], msAcc=[];

// grid
(()=>{const g=$('#grid');
 for(let i=0;i<=8;i++){const x=G.padL+i*(G.W-G.padL-G.padR)/8;
   const l=document.createElementNS(svgNS,'line');l.setAttribute('class','gl');
   l.setAttribute('x1',x);l.setAttribute('x2',x);l.setAttribute('y1',G.padT);l.setAttribute('y2',G.H-G.padB);g.appendChild(l);}
 for(let i=0;i<=4;i++){const y=G.padT+i*(G.H-G.padT-G.padB)/4;
   const l=document.createElementNS(svgNS,'line');l.setAttribute('class','gl');
   l.setAttribute('x1',G.padL);l.setAttribute('x2',G.W-G.padR);l.setAttribute('y1',y);l.setAttribute('y2',y);g.appendChild(l);}
})();

const val=t=>{ const y=ease(t); return mix>=1?y:lerp(prevEase(t),y,mix); };
const X=t=>G.padL+t*(G.W-G.padL-G.padR);
const Y=v=>G.H-G.padB-v*(G.H-G.padT-G.padB);

function drawCurve(){
  let d='',a=`M${X(0)} ${G.H-G.padB} `;
  for(let i=0;i<=72;i++){const t=i/72,v=val(t),x=X(t).toFixed(2),y=Y(v).toFixed(2);
    d+=(i?'L':'M')+x+' '+y+' '; a+='L'+x+' '+y+' ';}
  a+=`L${X(1)} ${G.H-G.padB} Z`;
  curveP.setAttribute('d',d); areaP.setAttribute('d',a);
}
function setEase(fn,label){
  prevEase = mix<1 ? (t=>lerp(prevEase(t),ease(t),mix)) : ease;
  ease=fn; mix=0; $('#curveName').textContent=label;
  $$('.erow').forEach(r=>r.classList.toggle('sel', r.dataset.k===label));
}
function fmtTC(t){
  const total=t*DUR/1000, s=Math.floor(total), f=Math.floor((total-s)*24);
  return `00:00:${String(s).padStart(2,'0')}:${String(f).padStart(2,'0')}`;
}
function render(){
  const v=val(T);
  drawCurve();
  handle.setAttribute('cx',X(T)); handle.setAttribute('cy',Y(v));
  phLine.setAttribute('x1',X(T)); phLine.setAttribute('x2',X(T));
  lanePh.style.left=(T*100)+'%';
  rail.style.setProperty('--swipe',(T*100)+'%');
  tcode.textContent=fmtTC(T);
  vY.textContent=v.toFixed(3);

  const local=LANES.map(L=>val(clamp((T-L.s)/L.d)));
  const px=local[0]*168;
  cube.style.transform=`translate3d(${px}px,0,0) scale(${(.86+local[1]*.34).toFixed(3)}) rotate(${(local[3]*-14).toFixed(1)}deg)`;
  cube.style.opacity=clamp(local[2]*1.5).toFixed(3);
  $('#v-x').textContent=Math.round(px)+'px';
  $('#v-s').textContent=(.86+local[1]*.34).toFixed(2)+'×';
  $('#v-o').textContent=Math.round(clamp(local[2]*1.5)*100)+'%';
  $('#v-r').textContent=Math.round(local[3]*-14)+'°';
  laneFills.forEach((el,i)=>el.style.width=(T*100)+'%');
  laneKeys.forEach((el,i)=>{
    const L=LANES[i];
    el.style.left=`calc(${(L.s+ (L.d)*clamp((T-L.s)/L.d))*100}% - 3.5px)`;
    el.style.opacity = T>=L.s&&T<=L.s+L.d?1:.35;
  });
  laneVals.forEach((el,i)=>el.textContent=Math.round(clamp(local[i])*100)+'%');
}
// lane keyframe diamonds at start / end
LANES.forEach((L,i)=>{
  [L.s,L.s+L.d].forEach(p=>{
    const d=document.createElement('u');
    d.style.left=`calc(${p*100}% - 3px)`;d.style.top='4px';d.style.bottom='4px';d.style.width='5px';
    d.style.background='#8E8A83';d.style.position='absolute';d.style.transform='rotate(45deg)';d.style.borderRadius='1px';
    $$('#lanes .bar')[i].appendChild(d);
  });
});

let morphStart=0;
function loop(now){
  const dt=Math.min(now-last,64); last=now;
  if(!RM){
    frameAcc.push(1000/Math.max(dt,1)); if(frameAcc.length>30)frameAcc.shift();
    msAcc.push(dt); if(msAcc.length>30)msAcc.shift();
    if(now%500<20){
      const avg=frameAcc.reduce((a,b)=>a+b,0)/frameAcc.length;
      fpsEl.textContent=Math.min(120,Math.round(avg));
      msEl.textContent=(avg?1000/avg/8:0).toFixed(1);
    }
  }
  if(mix<1){ mix=clamp((now-morphStart)/420); ghostP.setAttribute('d',ghostD); ghostP.style.opacity=(1-mix)*.55; }
  if(playing && !RM){
    if(hold>0){ hold-=dt; if(hold<=0){T=0;} }
    else { T+=dt*speed/DUR; if(T>=1){T=1;hold=520;} }
  }
  render();
  requestAnimationFrame(loop);
}
let ghostD='';
$('#chips').addEventListener('click',e=>{
  const b=e.target.closest('.chip'); if(!b)return;
  const p=LIB.find(x=>x.k===b.dataset.ease)||{fn:E.quint,n:'out · quint'};
  ghostD=ghostP.getAttribute('d')||curveP.getAttribute('d');
  morphStart=performance.now();
  $$('.chip').forEach(c=>c.classList.toggle('on',c===b));
  setEase(p.fn,p.n); T=0; hold=0; playing=true; setPlayIcon();
});
$$('.speed button').forEach(b=>b.addEventListener('click',()=>{
  speed=parseFloat(b.dataset.speed);
  $$('.speed button').forEach(x=>x.classList.toggle('on',x===b));
}));
function setPlayIcon(){
  $('#play').innerHTML = playing
    ? '<svg width="11" height="12" viewBox="0 0 11 12"><path d="M0 0h4v12H0zM7 0h4v12H7z" fill="#EFEAE0"/></svg>'
    : '<svg width="11" height="12" viewBox="0 0 11 12"><path d="M0 0l11 6-11 6z" fill="#EFEAE0"/></svg>';
}
$('#play').addEventListener('click',()=>{playing=!playing;hold=0;setPlayIcon();});
$('#rew').addEventListener('click',()=>{T=0;hold=0;playing=true;setPlayIcon();});
// scrub
let scrub=false,wasP=true;
const setFromEvent=e=>{
  const r=graph.getBoundingClientRect();
  const x=((e.clientX??0)-r.left)/r.width;
  T=clamp((x*G.W-G.padL)/(G.W-G.padL-G.padR));
};
graph.addEventListener('pointerdown',e=>{scrub=true;wasP=playing;playing=false;setFromEvent(e);graph.setPointerCapture(e.pointerId);});
graph.addEventListener('pointermove',e=>{if(scrub)setFromEvent(e);});
graph.addEventListener('pointerup',()=>{scrub=false;playing=wasP;setPlayIcon();});
setPlayIcon();
if(RM){playing=false;setPlayIcon();T=.62;}
requestAnimationFrame(n=>{last=n;loop(n);});

/* ─────────── CURVE TABLE ─────────── */
$('#curveRows').innerHTML = LIB.map(p=>`
  <div class="erow${p.k==='quint'?' sel':''}" data-k="${p.k}" data-name="${p.n}" tabindex="0" role="button" aria-label="Load ${p.n} into the keygraph">
    <div class="en">${p.n}<small>${p.k}</small></div>
    <div class="esample"><i></i></div>
    <svg class="mini" viewBox="0 0 48 38" aria-hidden="true"><path d="${p.shape}"/></svg>
    <div class="ecode">${p.code}</div>
    <div class="eusage">${p.use}</div>
    <div class="eact">Load ↗</div>
  </div>`).join('');
$('#curveRows').addEventListener('click',e=>{
  const row=e.target.closest('.erow'); if(!row)return;
  const p=LIB.find(x=>x.k===row.dataset.k);
  ghostD=curveP.getAttribute('d'); morphStart=performance.now();
  setEase(p.fn,p.n); T=0;hold=0;playing=true;setPlayIcon();
  $$('.chip').forEach(c=>c.classList.toggle('on',c.dataset.ease===p.k));
  toast(`${p.n} loaded into keygraph`);
});
$('#curveRows').addEventListener('keydown',e=>{
  if(e.key==='Enter'||e.key===' '){const row=e.target.closest('.erow'); if(row){e.preventDefault();row.click();}}
});

/* ─────────── TOAST ─────────── */
let tt;
function toast(msg){
  $('#toastMsg').textContent=msg; $('#toast').classList.add('on');
  clearTimeout(tt); tt=setTimeout(()=>$('#toast').classList.remove('on'),2400);
}

/* ─────────── TICKER ─────────── */
const STUDIOS=['Halcyon Broadcast','Studio Meridian','Fathom Labs','Negative Space','Pallas Museum','Orbit & Ink','Kilnwork','Grandmaster','Tessellate','Bright Ravine'];
$('#tickRow').innerHTML=(STUDIOS.concat(STUDIOS)).map(s=>`<span>${s}</span>`).join('');

/* ─────────── TEXT SPLIT ─────────── */
$$('.split').forEach(el=>{
  const walk=node=>{
    [...node.childNodes].forEach(n=>{
      if(n.nodeType===3){
        const frag=document.createDocumentFragment();
        n.textContent.split(/(\s+)/).forEach(w=>{
          if(!w.trim()){frag.appendChild(document.createTextNode(w));return;}
          const m=document.createElement('span');m.className='w-mask';
          const i=document.createElement('span');i.textContent=w;
          m.appendChild(i);frag.appendChild(m);
        });
        n.replaceWith(frag);
      } else if(n.nodeType===1 && !n.classList.contains('w-mask')) walk(n);
    });
  };
  walk(el);
  $$('.w-mask>span',el).forEach((s,i)=>s.style.setProperty('--wd',(i*44)+'ms'));
});
$$('.split-mega').forEach(el=>{
  const out=[];
  el.childNodes.forEach(node=>{
    if(node.nodeType===3){
      node.textContent.split(/(\s+)/).forEach(w=>{
        if(!w.trim()){ if(w) out.push(' '); return; }
        [...w].forEach(c=>out.push(`<span><b>${c}</b></span>`));
      });
    } else {
      const cls=node.classList?node.classList.value:'';
      if(node.classList&&node.classList.contains('sp')){out.push('<span class="sp"></span>');return;}
      [...(node.textContent||'')].forEach(c=>out.push(`<span class="${cls}"><b>${c}</b></span>`));
    }
  });
  el.innerHTML=out.map((s,i)=>s.startsWith('<span')?s.replace('<b>',`<b style="--wd:${i*22}ms">`):s).join('').replace(/<span class="sp"><\/span>/g,'<span class="sp"> </span>');
});

/* ─────────── REVEAL OBSERVER ─────────── */
const io=new IntersectionObserver(es=>es.forEach(e=>{
  if(e.isIntersecting){e.target.classList.add('in');io.unobserve(e.target);}
}),{threshold:.12,rootMargin:'0px 0px -8% 0px'});
$$('[data-rv],.curtain,.mega').forEach(el=>io.observe(el));
$$('[data-rv]').forEach(el=>{
  const d=el.getAttribute('style')||'';
  const m=/--d:\s*(\d+)ms/.exec(d); if(m) el.style.setProperty('--d',m[1]+'ms');
});

/* ─────────── COUNT UP ─────────── */
const cio=new IntersectionObserver(es=>es.forEach(e=>{
  if(!e.isIntersecting)return; cio.unobserve(e.target);
  const el=e.target, target=parseFloat(el.dataset.count), dec=+(el.dataset.dec||0), suf=el.dataset.suffix||'';
  const em=el.querySelector('em'), pre=em?em.outerHTML:'';
  if(RM){el.innerHTML=pre+target.toLocaleString(undefined,{minimumFractionDigits:dec,maximumFractionDigits:dec})+suf;return;}
  const t0=performance.now(), D=1500;
  const step=n=>{
    const p=clamp((n-t0)/D), v=target*(1-Math.pow(1-p,5));
    el.innerHTML=pre+(dec?v.toFixed(dec):Math.round(v).toLocaleString())+suf;
    if(p<1)requestAnimationFrame(step);
  };
  requestAnimationFrame(step);
}),{threshold:.5});
$$('[data-count]').forEach(el=>cio.observe(el));

/* ─────────── BAR / LINE VIZ GENERATORS ─────────── */
$$('[data-bars]').forEach(box=>{
  const n=+box.dataset.bars;
  box.innerHTML=Array.from({length:n},(_,i)=>`<i style="--h:${20+((i*37)%78)}%"></i>`).join('');
});
$$('[data-lines]').forEach(box=>{
  const n=+box.dataset.lines;
  box.innerHTML=Array.from({length:n},(_,i)=>`<i style="top:${i*(100/n)}%;--sx:${.32+((i*23)%60)/100}"></i>`).join('');
});

/* ─────────── VOICES ROTATOR ─────────── */
const QUOTES=[
  {q:'We rebuilt eleven seconds of broadcast ident in an afternoon. The <em>retargeting model</em> is why — velocity survives every interruption.',n:'Ines Cardozo',r:'Motion director · Halcyon, London',img:'broadcast-director-portrait'},

  {q:'The inspector paid for the licence. We step frames in CI now, so a keyframe drift fails a build the same way a failing test does.',n:'Wren Okafor',r:'Principal · Studio Meridian, Lisbon',img:'design-principal-portrait'}
];

  <figure class="quote${i?'':' on'}" data-q="${i}">

      <div><b>${x.n}</b><span>${x.r}</span></div>
    </figcaption>
  </figure>`).join('');
$('#vDots').innerHTML=QUOTES.map((_,i)=>`<button data-go="${i}" class="${i?'':'on'}" aria-label="Quote ${i+1}">0${i+1}</button>`).join('');
let qi=0,qTimer;
function goQ(i){
  qi=i; $$('.quote').forEach(q=>q.classList.toggle('on',+q.dataset.q===i));
  $$('#vDots button').forEach(b=>b.classList.toggle('on',+b.dataset.go===i));
}
function autoQ(){clearInterval(qTimer);qTimer=setInterval(()=>goQ((qi+1)%QUOTES.length),6800);}
$('#vDots').addEventListener('click',e=>{const b=e.target.closest('[data-go]');if(b){goQ(+b.dataset.go);autoQ();}});
$('#vStage').addEventListener('pointerenter',()=>clearInterval(qTimer));
$('#vStage').addEventListener('pointerleave',autoQ);
autoQ();

/* ─────────── PLANS ─────────── */
const PLANS=[
  {n:'Solo',tag:'1 seat',m:24,y:19,d:'One motion designer, one repo. Everything you need to key, preview and ship scenes on personal and client work.',
   f:['Full sampler + 48 curves','Keygraph editor & scrub','Reduced-motion compiler','Community Discord','Weekly canary builds','MIT-style licence']},
  {n:'Studio',tag:'up to 12 seats',m:96,y:77,d:'The tier most agencies land on. Shared scene library, CI assertions and frame budgets enforced across every project.',popular:true,
   f:['Everything in Solo','Shared curve library','CI frame-hash assertions','Per-scene byte & ms budgets','Figma → scene importer','Priority support, 1 business day','Seat transfer & audit log']},
  {n:'Foundry',tag:'unlimited seats',m:249,y:199,d:'For platform teams shipping motion into products used by millions. On-prem, SSO, and a direct line to the sampler maintainers.',
   f:['Everything in Studio','Self-hosted inspector','SSO / SAML + SCIM','Custom physics modules','Quarterly motion audit','Named engineer, 4h SLA','Offline & air-gapped builds']}
];
$('#plansList').innerHTML=PLANS.map((p,i)=>`
  <div class="plan${p.popular?' open':''}" data-plan="${i}">
    <button class="p-head" aria-expanded="${!!p.popular}">
      <span class="p-name">${p.n}<small>${p.tag}${p.popular?' · most chosen':''}</small></span>
      <span class="p-price"><sup>$</sup><b data-m="${p.m}" data-y="${p.y}">${p.m}</b><em>per month</em></span>
      <span class="p-desc">${p.d}</span>
      <span class="p-plus"><i></i><i></i></span>
    </button>
    <div class="p-body"><div><div class="p-inner">
      <ul class="flist">${p.f.map(x=>`<li>${x}</li>`).join('')}</ul>
      <div class="p-cta">
        <p>${p.n} · billed ${'monthly'} · cancel anytime.<br>Includes all future 4.x releases.</p>
        <button class="btn mag" data-scroll="#end"><span>Start ${p.n}</span></button>
      </div>
    </div></div></div>
  </div>`).join('');
$('#plansList').addEventListener('click',e=>{
  const head=e.target.closest('.p-head');
  if(head){
    const plan=head.closest('.plan'); const open=plan.classList.contains('open');
    $$('.plan').forEach(p=>{p.classList.remove('open');$('.p-head',p).setAttribute('aria-expanded','false');});
    if(!open){plan.classList.add('open');head.setAttribute('aria-expanded','true');}
  }
});
let cycle='m';
$('#cycle').addEventListener('click',e=>{
  const b=e.target.closest('[data-cycle]'); if(!b||b.dataset.cycle===cycle)return;
  cycle=b.dataset.cycle;
  $$('#cycle button').forEach(x=>x.classList.toggle('on',x===b));
  $$('.p-price b').forEach(el=>{
    const from=parseFloat(el.textContent), to=+el.dataset[cycle], t0=performance.now();
    const run=n=>{const p=clamp((n-t0)/520);el.textContent=Math.round(lerp(from,to,E.inout(p)));if(p<1)requestAnimationFrame(run);};
    if(RM)el.textContent=to;else requestAnimationFrame(run);
  });
  $$('.p-price em').forEach(el=>el.textContent=cycle==='y'?'per mo · annual':'per month');
});

/* ─────────── FAQ ─────────── */
const FAQ=[
  ['Does Cadence replace CSS transitions?','No — and it will fight you if you try. CSS owns hover states and simple property swaps. Cadence starts where coordination begins: multiple elements, one clock, interruptible, measurable. <code>@media (prefers-reduced-motion)</code> still wins.'],
  ['What about hydration mismatches?','Scenes declare an initial state that matches server markup. The sampler only takes over after the first commit, so there is no flash, no double-render, and no <code>useEffect</code> waterfall.'],
  ['Can I bring my own curves?','Yes. Pass four numbers, a physics object, or a function <code>(t:number)=>number</code>. Anything pure gets baked into the same lookup table as the built-ins.'],
  ['How large is the runtime, honestly?','6.2kb gzipped for the sampler plus roughly 400 bytes per compiled scene. The inspector and recorder are dev-only and never reach production bundles.'],
  ['Does it work with View Transitions?','Where the browser supports them, Cadence drives the native API and adds interruption handling. Where it doesn’t, it falls back to a FLIP scheduler with identical cue sheets.'],
  ['We already have a design-token pipeline.','Import tokens as named curves. The codemod turns your existing <code>--ease-*</code> variables into typed presets so designers and engineers key against the same vocabulary.']
];
$('#faqList').innerHTML=FAQ.map(([q,a])=>`
  <div class="qa"><button aria-expanded="false">${q}</button><div class="qa-a"><div><p>${a}</p></div></div></div>`).join('');
$('#faqList').addEventListener('click',e=>{
  const b=e.target.closest('button'); if(!b)return;
  const qa=b.parentElement, open=qa.classList.contains('open');
  $$('.qa', $('#faqList')).forEach(x=>{x.classList.remove('open');$('button',x).setAttribute('aria-expanded','false');});
  if(!open){qa.classList.add('open');b.setAttribute('aria-expanded','true');}
});

/* ─────────── SIGNUP ─────────── */
$('#signup').addEventListener('submit',e=>{
  e.preventDefault();
  const input=$('#mail'), wrap=$('#mailWrap'), hint=$('#hint');
  const ok=/^[^\s@]+@[^\s@]+\.[a-z]{2,}$/i.test(input.value.trim());
  wrap.classList.toggle('err',!ok);
  hint.className='hint '+(ok?'ok':'bad');
  if(ok){
    hint.textContent='✓ Queued — release notes land the first Tuesday of the month.';
    toast('Access request received');
    input.value=''; input.blur();
    ghostD=curveP.getAttribute('d');morphStart=performance.now();
    setEase(E.back,'out · back');T=0;playing=true;setPlayIcon();
    $$('.chip').forEach(c=>c.classList.toggle('on',c.dataset.ease==='back'));
  } else {
    hint.textContent=input.value.trim()?'That address is missing something. Try you@studio.com.':'An email, please — it is the whole form.';
  }
});
$('#mail').addEventListener('input',()=>{$('#mailWrap').classList.remove('err');$('#hint').className='hint';$('#hint').textContent='We send one release note per month. Nothing else, ever.';});

/* ─────────── CLOCK ─────────── */
setInterval(()=>{const d=new Date();$('#clock').textContent=d.toISOString().slice(11,19);},1000);

/* ─────────── SMOOTH SCROLL LINKS ─────────── */
document.addEventListener('click',e=>{
  const a=e.target.closest('[data-scroll],a[href^="#"]');
  if(!a)return;
  const sel=a.dataset.scroll||a.getAttribute('href');
  const t=sel&&sel.length>1&&$(sel);
  if(!t)return;
  e.preventDefault();
  document.body.classList.remove('menu');
  window.scrollTo({top:t.getBoundingClientRect().top+window.scrollY-70,behavior:RM?'auto':'smooth'});
});
$('#toTop').addEventListener('click',()=>window.scrollTo({top:0,behavior:RM?'auto':'smooth'}));
$('#burger').addEventListener('click',()=>document.body.classList.toggle('menu'));

/* ─────────── NAV STATE ─────────── */
const SEC=[['#stage','Keygraph','#moves','Capabilities'],['#engine','Engine'],['#flow','Workflow'],['#curves','Library'],['#frames','Field notes'],['#voices','Studios'],['#plans','Licensing'],['#faq','Questions'],['#end','Access']];
const navIO=new IntersectionObserver(es=>es.forEach(e=>{
  if(!e.isIntersecting)return;
  const id='#'+e.target.id;
  $$('#navLinks a').forEach(a=>a.classList.toggle('on',a.dataset.link===id.slice(1)));
  const found=SEC.find(s=>s[0]===id);
  if(found){
    const i=SEC.findIndex(s=>s[0]===id);
    $('#railLabel').innerHTML=`<b>${String(Math.min(i+1,9)).padStart(2,'0')}</b> / ${found[1]}`;
  }
}),{rootMargin:'-45% 0px -50% 0px'});
SEC.forEach(s=>{const el=$(s[0]); if(el)navIO.observe(el);});

/* ─────────── RAF LOOP: lerp scroll, parallax, pin, stack ─────────── */
const pcs=$$('.pc'), notes=$$('.note');
const baseTop=new Map();
function measure(){
  [ ...pcs, ...notes ].forEach(el=>{
    const prev=el.style.transform; el.style.transform='none';
    baseTop.set(el, el.getBoundingClientRect().top+window.scrollY);
    el.style.transform=prev;
  });
}
measure(); addEventListener('resize',()=>{measure();});

const pinWrap=$('#engine'), panels=$$('.panel'), pinBars=$$('#pinNav i b');
const stackCards=$$('[data-stack]');
let target=window.scrollY, cur=target, raf;
addEventListener('scroll',()=>{target=window.scrollY},{passive:true});

const cursor=$('.cur'), ring=$('.cur-ring');
let mx=innerWidth/2,my=innerHeight/2,rx=mx,ry=my,dx=mx,dy=my;
addEventListener('pointermove',e=>{mx=e.clientX;my=e.clientY;},{passive:true});
$$('.mag, a, button, .erow, .pc, .cap').forEach(el=>{
  el.addEventListener('pointerenter',()=>document.body.classList.add('hot'));
  el.addEventListener('pointerleave',()=>document.body.classList.remove('hot'));
});
// magnetic
$$('.mag').forEach(el=>{
  el.addEventListener('pointermove',e=>{
    if(RM)return;
    const r=el.getBoundingClientRect();
    el.style.transform=`translate(${(e.clientX-(r.left+r.width/2))*.22}px,${(e.clientY-(r.top+r.height/2))*.32}px)`;
  });
  el.addEventListener('pointerleave',()=>el.style.transition='transform .6s var(--ease)',el.style.transform='');
  el.addEventListener('pointerenter',()=>el.style.transition='transform .12s linear');
});

let lastNav=0;
function frame(){
  cur=RM?target:lerp(cur,target,.11);
  const y=cur, vh=innerHeight, sy=window.scrollY;

  // progress
  const doc=document.documentElement.scrollHeight-vh;
  $('#railFill').style.width=(sy/Math.max(doc,1)*100)+'%';

  // nav shrink
  if(sy>40!==!!lastNav){lastNav=sy>40?1:0;$('#nav').classList.toggle('stuck',sy>40);}

  // parallax postcards + notes
  if(!RM){
    [...pcs,...notes].forEach(el=>{
      const sp=parseFloat(el.dataset.speed||0); if(!sp)return;
      const b=baseTop.get(el)??0;
      const rel=(y+vh/2-(b+ (el.offsetHeight/2)))/vh;
      const t=clamp(rel,-1.6,1.6);
      const rot=el.classList.contains('pc')?(getComputedStyle(el).getPropertyValue('--rot')||''):'';
      el.style.transform=`translate3d(0,${(t*sp*58).toFixed(2)}px,0)${el.classList.contains('pc')?'':''}`;
    });
  }

  // pinned crossfade
  if(!RM && pinWrap){
    const r=pinWrap.getBoundingClientRect();
    const span=pinWrap.offsetHeight-vh;
    const p=clamp(-r.top/Math.max(span,1));
    const f=p*(panels.length-1);
    panels.forEach((el,i)=>{
      const d=f-i, a=clamp(1-Math.abs(d)*1.5);
      if(a<=0.001){el.style.opacity=0;el.style.visibility='hidden';return;}
      el.style.visibility='visible';
      el.style.opacity=a.toFixed(3);
      el.style.transform=`translate3d(0,${(-d*46).toFixed(1)}px,0) scale(${(1-Math.abs(d)*.045).toFixed(3)})`;
      el.style.filter=`blur(${(Math.abs(d)*5).toFixed(2)}px)`;
    });
    pinBars.forEach((b,i)=>b.style.setProperty('--s',clamp(1-Math.abs(f-i))));
    $('#pinTag').textContent=`Scroll → ${String(Math.min(panels.length,Math.round(f)+1)).padStart(2,'0')} / 0${panels.length}`;
  }

  // stacked cards
  if(!RM){
    stackCards.forEach((card,i)=>{
      const next=stackCards[i+1];
      const topRef=84+i*14;
      if(!next){card.style.transform='none';card.style.filter='none';return;}
      const nr=next.getBoundingClientRect();
      const k=clamp((vh-nr.top)/Math.max(vh-topRef,1));
      card.style.transform=`translate3d(0,${(-20*k).toFixed(1)}px,0) scale(${(1-.055*k).toFixed(4)})`;
      card.style.filter=`brightness(${(1-.34*k).toFixed(3)})`;
    });
  }

  // cursor
  if(!RM){
    dx=lerp(dx,mx,.55); dy=lerp(dy,my,.55);
    rx=lerp(rx,mx,.16); ry=lerp(ry,my,.16);
    cursor.style.transform=`translate(${dx}px,${dy}px)`;
    ring.style.transform=`translate(${rx}px,${ry}px)`;
  }

  requestAnimationFrame(frame);
}
requestAnimationFrame(frame);

// keep postcard rotation after parallax translate
pcs.forEach(el=>{
  const rot=getComputedStyle(el).rotate||'';
  el.dataset.rot=rot;
});
const origFrame=frame;
// reapply rotation each frame via CSS var
pcs.forEach(el=>{ el.style.setProperty('--keep','0'); });
setInterval(()=>{ pcs.forEach(el=>{ if(el.dataset.rot&&el.dataset.rot!=='none'&&!el.style.rotate)el.style.rotate=el.dataset.rot; }); },80);
})();
</script>
</body>
</html>
